a: Yikkevuhu leom", veen leom ella ubbarin, shenneemar: "uleom milleom yeematz". veen kabbo ella kelala, shenneemar: "ma ekkov lo kabbo el". veen bar ella tora, shenneemar: "nashsheku var pen yeenaf".
Ulla bar yishmael omer: menakkevin oto kichvara. ketiv hacha: "yikkevuhu leom", uchetiv hatam: "vayyikkov chor bedalto". vaamar abbaye: ki uchela dekatztzare.

Veim limmedo, ma secharo? amar rava amar rav sheshet: zoche livrachot keyosef, shenneemar: "uveracha lerosh mashbir". veen mashbir ella yosef, shenneemar: "veyosef hu [hashshallit al haaretz hu] hammashbir lechol am haaretz".
Amar rav sheshet: kol hamelammed tora beolam hazze, zoche umelammedah laolam habba, shenneemar: "umarve gam hu yore".

Amar rava: minnayin litchiyyayt hammetim min hattora? shenneemar: "yechi reuven veal yamot". "yechi reuven" – baolam hazze, "veal yamot" – laolam habba. ravina amar mehacha: "verabbim miyyeshene admat afar yakitzu elle lechayye olam veelle lacharafot lediron olam". rav ashe amar mehacha: "veatta lech [lakketz] vetanuach vetaamod legoralcha leketz hayyamin".
Amar rabbi elazar: kol parnas shemmanhig et hatztzibbur benachat, zoche umanhigam laolam habba, shenneemar: "ki merachamam yenahagem veal mabbue mayim yenahalem".
Veamar rabbi elazar: gedola dea, shennittena ben shete otiyyot, shenneemar "ki el deot Adonai".

Veamar rabbi elazar: gadol mikdash shennittan ben shete otiyyot, shenneemar: "paalta Adonai mikkedash Adonai konnu yadecha". matkef la rav adda karchinaa: ella meatta, gedola nekama shennittena ben shete otiyyot, dichtiv: "el nekamot Adonai el nekamot hofiya"!
Amar leh: lemilleteh hachi name, kidulla. deamar ulla: shete hofaayot hallalu lamma? achat lemidda tova, veachat lemiddat pureanut.
Veamar rabbi elazar: kol adam sheyyesh bo dea, keillu nivna bet hammikdash beyamav, shezze nittan ben shete otiyyot, veze nittan ben shete otiyyot.
Veamar rabbi elazar: kol adam sheyyesh bo dea, lesof mitashsher, shenneemar: "uvedaat chadarim yimmalu kol hon yakar venaim".
Veamar rabbi elazar: kol adam sheen bo dea asur lerachem alav, shenneemar: "ki lo am binot hu al ken lo yerachamennu osehu veyotzro lo yechunnennu".

Veamar rabbi elazar: kol hannoten pitto lemi sheen bo dea, yissurin bain alav, shenneemar: "lachmecha yasimu mazor tachtecha en tevuna bo". veen mazor ella yissurin, shenneemar: "vayyar efrayim et cholyo vihuda et mezoro".
Veamar rabbi elazar: kol adam sheen bo dea, lesof gole, shenneemar: "lachen gala ammi mibbeli daat".

Veamar rabbi elazar: kol bayit sheen divre tora nishmaim bo ballayla, esh ochalto, shenneemar: "kol choshech tamun litzpunav teochlehu esh lo nuppach yera sarid beoholo". en sarid ella talmid chacham, shenneemar: "uvasseridim asher Adonai kore".

Veamar rabbi elazar: kol sheeno mehanne talmide chachamim minnechasav, eno roe siman beracha leolam, shenneemar: "en sarid leochlo al ken lo yachil tuvo". en "sarid" ella talmide chachamim, shenneemar: "uvasseridim asher Adonai kore".
Veamar rabbi elazar: kol sheeno meshayyer pat al shulchano, eno roe siman beracha leolam, shenneemar: "en sarid leochlo al ken lo yachil tuvo".

Vehaamar rabbi elazar: kol hameshayyayr petitim al shulchano keillu oved avoda zara, shenneemar: "haorchim laggad shulchan vehamemalim lamni mimsach"! la kashya: ha deikka shelema bahadeh, ha delekka shelema bahadeh.
Veamar rabbi elazar: kol hammachlif bedibburo keillu oved avoda zara. ketiv hacha: "vehayiti veenav kimtatea", uchetiv hatam: "hevel hemma maase tatuim".
Veamar rabbi elazar: kol hammistakkel beerva, kashto nineret, shenneemar: "erya teor kashtecha".
Veamar rabbi elazar: leolam have kavel vekayyaym. amar rabbi zera: af anan name tenena, bayit afel en potchin lo challonot lirot nigo. shema minna.
Amar rabbi tavi amar rabbi yoshiyya: may dichtiv "sheol veotzer racham eretz lo sava mayim"? vechi ma inyan sheol etzel rechem? ella lomar lecha: ma rechem machnis umotzi, af sheol machnis umotzi.

Vahalo devarim kal vechomer: uma rechem shemmachnisin bo bachashay, motziin mimmennu bekole kolot; sheol shemmachnisin bo bekolot, eno din shemmotziin mimmennu bekole kolot? mikkan teshuva laomrin: en techiyyayt hammetim min hattora.

Tana deve eliyyahu: tzaddikim sheatid hakkadosh baruch hu lehacheyotan enan chozrin laafaran, shenneemar: "vehaya hannishar betziyyon vehannotar birushalaym kadosh yeamer lo kol hakkatuv lachayyim birushalayim". ma kadosh leolam kayyaym – af hem leolam kayyaymin.
b: Veim tomar: otan shanim sheatid hakkadosh baruch hu lechaddesh bahen et olamo, shenneemar: "venisgav Adonai levaddo bayyom hahu", tzaddikim ma hen osin? hakkadosh baruch hu ose lahem kenafayim kinsharim, veshatin al pene hammayim, shenneemar: "al ken lo nira behamir aretz uvemot harim belev yammim". veshemma tomar: yesh lahem tzaar? talmud lomar: "vekoye Adonai yachalifu choach yaalu ever kannesharim yarutzu velo yigau yelchu velo yiafu".
Venelaf mimmetim shehechya yechezkel? savar la keman deamar: beemet mashal haya.

Detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: metim shehechya yechezkel amdu al raglehem veamru shira vametu. ma shira amru? "Adonai memit betzedek umechayye berachamim". rabbi yehoshua omer: shira zo amru "Adonai memit umechayye morid sheol vayyaal". rabbi yehuda omer, emet mashal haya.

Amar lo rabbi nechemya: im emet, lamma mashal? veim mashal, lamma emet? ella, beemet mashal haya. rabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili omer: metim shehechya yechezkel alu leeretz yisrael, venasu nashim veholidu banim uvanot. amad rabbi yehuda ben betera al raglav veamar: ani mibbene venehem, vehallalu tefillin shehinniach li avi abba mehem.
Uman ninhu metim shehechya yechezkel?

Amar rav: ellu bene efrayim shemmanu lakketz vetau, shenneemar: "uvene efrayim shutalach uvered beno vetachat beno veelada veno vetachat beno vezavad beno veshutelach beno veezer veelad vaharagum anshe gat hannoladim baaretz vegomer", uchetiv: "vayyitabbel efrayim avihem yamim rabbim vayyavou echav lenachamo".
Ushemuel amar: ellu bene adam shekkafru bitchiyyayt hammetim, shenneemar: "vayyomer elay ben adam haatzamot haelle kol bet yisrael hemma hinne omrim yavshu atzmotenu veavda tikvatenu nigzarnu lanu".
Rabbi yirmeya bar abba amar: ellu bene adam sheen bahen lachluchit shel mitzva, shenneemar "haatzamot hayeveshot shimu devar Adonai".

Rabbi yitzchak nappacha amar: ellu bene adam shechippu et hahechol kullo shekatzim uremasim, shenneemar: "vaavo vaere vehinne chol tavnit remes uvehema sheketz vechol gillule bet yisrael mechukke al hakkir saviv vegomer", uchetiv hatam: "veheevirani alehem saviv saviv".

Rabbi yochanan amar: ellu metim shebbevikat dura. veamar rabbi yochanan: minnehar eshel ad rabbat bikat dura, shebbeshaa shehigla nevuchadnetztzar harasha et yisrael hayu bahen bachurim shehayu megannin et hachamma beyofyayn, vehayu kasdiyyot root otan veshofot zavut. amru levaalehen, uvaalehen lammelech. tzivva hammelech vaharagum, vaadayin hayu shofot zavut. tzivva hammelech uremasum.

Tanu rabbanan: beshaa shehippil nevuchadnetztzar harasha et chananya mishael vaazarya lechivshan haesh, amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lichezkel: lech vehacheye metim bevikat dura. kevan shehechyay otan, bau atzamot vetafchu lo leoto rasha al panav. amar: ma tivan shel ellu? amru lo: chavrehen shel ellu mechayye metim bevikat dura. patach veamar: "atohi kema ravrevin vetimhohi kema takkifin malchuteh malchut alam vesholtane im dar vedar vegomer".
Amar rabbi yitzchak: yutzak zahav roteach letoch piv shel oto rasha, sheilmale (lo) ba malach usetaro al piv, bikkesh legannot kol shirot vetishbachot sheamar david besefer tehillim.

Tanu rabbanan: shishsha nissim naasu beoto hayyom, veellu hen: tzaf hakkivshan, venifratz hakkivshan, vehumak sodo, venehpach tzelem al panav, venisrefu arba malchiyyot, vehechya yechezkel et hammetim bevikat dura.

Vechullehu gemara, vearba malchiyyot kera. dichtiv: "unevuchadnetztzar malka shelach lemichnash laachashdarpenayya signayya ufachavata adargazrayya gedavrayya detavrayya tiftaye vechol shiltone medinata vegomer", uchetiv: "itay guvrin yehudain", uchetiv: "umitkanneshin achashdarpenayya signayya ufachavata vehaddavre malka chazayin leguvrayya illech vegomer".

Tane deve rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: afillu bishat hassakkana lo yeshanne adam et atzmo min harabbanut (shello), shenneemar: "bedayin guvrayya illech kefitu besarbalehon patteshehon vecharbelathon vegomer".
Amar rabbi yochanan:

a: Gedolim tzaddikim yoter mimmalache hashsharet, shenneemar: "ane veamar ha ana chaze guvrin arbea sherayin mahlechin bego nura vachaval la itay behon vereve di reviaa dame levar elahin".

Amar rabbi tanchum bar chanilay: beshaa sheyyatzu chananya mishael vaazarya mikkivshan haesh, bau kol ummot haolam vetafchu lesonehen shel yisrael al penehem. amru lahem: yesh lachem eloah kaze, veattem mishtachavim latztzelem?! miyyad patchu veamru: "lecha Adonai hatztzedaka velanu boshet happanim kayyom hazze".

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: may dichtiv "amarti eele vetamar ochaza besansinnav"? "amarti eele vetamar" – ellu yisrael, veachshav lo ala beyadi ella sansan echad shel chananya mishael vaazarya.

Amar rabbi yochanan: may dichtiv "raiti hallayla vehinne ish rochev al sus adom vehu omed ben hahadassim asher bammetzula [vegomer]"? may "raiti hallayla"? bikkesh hakkadosh baruch hu lahafoch et kol haolam kullo lelayla. "vehinne ish rochev" – en "ish" ella hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar "Adonai ish milchama Adonai shemo". "al sus adom" – bikkesh hakkadosh baruch hu lahafoch et haolam kullo ledam.

Kevan shennistakkel bachananya mishael vaazarya, nitkarra dato, shenneemar: "vehu omed ben hahadassim asher bammetzula". veen "hadassim" ella tzaddikim, shenneemar: "vayhi omen et hadassa". veen "metzula" ella bavel, shenneemar: "haomer latztzula choravi venaharotayich ovish". miyyad, meleim rogez naasim serukkim, vaadummim naasu levanim. amar rav pappa: shema minna suseya chivvara mealle lechelma.
Verabbanan, lehecha azalu? amar rav: beayin [hara] metu. ushemuel amar: berok tavu. verabbi yochanan amar: alu leeretz yisrael, venasu nashim veholidu banim uvanot.

Ketannae, rabbi eliezer omer: beayin [hara] metu. rabbi yehoshua omer: berok tavu. vachachamim omrim: alu leeretz yisrael venasu nashim veholidu banim uvanot, shenneemar: "shema na yehoshua hakkohen haggadol atta vereecha hayyoshvim lefanecha ki anshe mofet hemma". ezo hem anashim shennaasa lahen mofet? heve omer: ze chananya mishael vaazarya.

Vedaniyyel lehechan azal? amar rav: lemichre nahara rabba bitverya. ushemuel amar: leetoye bizra deaspasta. verabbi yochanan amar: leetoye chazire daalekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim. ini? vehatanya: todos harofe amar, en para vachazira yotze mealekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim sheen chotchin haem shellah bishvil shello teled! zutere ayyti bela datayyhu.
Tanu rabbanan: shelosha hayu beotah etza – hakkadosh baruch hu, vedaniyyel, unevuchadnetztzar. hakkadosh baruch hu amar: nezil daniyyel mehacha, dela lemru bizchuteh ittantzul.
Vedaniyyel amar: ezil mehacha, dela likayyaym bi "pesile elohehem tisrefun baesh".
Unevuchadnetztzar amar: yezil daniel mehacha, dela lemru "kalyeh leelaheh benura". uminnayin disgid leh? dichtiv: "bedayin malka nevuchadnetztzar nefal al anpohi uledaniyyel segid vegomer".

"Ko amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael el achav ben kolaya veel tzidkiyyahu ven maaseya hannibbeim lachem bishmi lashshaker vegomer". uchetiv: "velukkach mehem kelala lechol galut yehuda asher bevavel lemor yesimcha Adonai ketzidkiyyahu ucheechav asher kalam melech bavel baesh". "asher serafam" lo neemar, ella "asher kalam". amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: melammed sheasaan kiklayot.

"Yaan asher asu nevala beyisrael vaynaafu et neshe reehem". may avud? azul legabbe beratte dinvuchadnetztzar. achav amar la: "ko amar Adonai hishshamei el tzidkiyya". vetzidkiyya amar: "ko amar Adonai hishshamei el achav". azala vaamara leh laavu. amar la: elohehem shel ellu sone zimma hu. ki atu legabbach, shadderinhu legabbay.

Ki ato legabba, shaddartanhu legabbe avuha. amar lehu: man amar lechon? amaru: hakkadosh baruch hu. veha chananya mishael vaazarya sheeltinhu, vaamaru li: asur! amaru leh: anan name nevie kevavtayyhu. ledidhu la amar lehu, ledidan amar lan. amar lehu: ana baena deevdekinchu, ki hechi divdaktinhu lachananya mishael vaazarya.
Amaru leh: innun telata havo, vaanan teren. amar lehu: becharu lechon man devaetu bahadayychu. amaru: yehoshua kohen gadol. savri: lete yehoshua dinfish zechuteh umaggena alan.

Achteyu, shedinhu. inhu ikkelo, yehoshua kohen gadol icharuch icharoche maneh, shenneemar: "vayyareni et yehoshua hakkohen haggadol omed lifne malach Adonai vegomer", uchetiv: "vayyomer Adonai el hassatan yigar Adonai becha vegomer".

Amar leh: yadana detzaddika at, ella may tama ahneya bach pureta nura? chananya mishael vaazarya la ahneya behu kelal! amar leh: inhu telata havo, vaana chad. amar leh: veha avraham yachid hava? hatam la havo reshaim bahadeh, vela ityehiv reshuta lenura. hacha havo reshaim bahaday, veityehiv reshuta lenura. hayeynu deamri inashe: tere ude yabbishe vechad rattiva, okdu yabbishe lerattiva.

May tama ianash? amar rav pappa: shehayu banav nosin nashim sheenan hagunot lichhunna velo micha bahen. shenneemar: "vihoshua haya lavush begadim tzoim". vechi darko shel yehoshua lilbosh begadim tzoim? ella melammed shehayu banav nosim nashim sheenan hagunot lichhunna, velo micha bahen.

Amar rabbi tanchum: darash bar kappara betzippori, may dichtiv "shesh hasseorim haelle natan li"? may "shesh hasseorim"? illema shesh seorim mammash, vechi darko shel boaz litten mattana shesh seorim?
b: Ella shesh sein.

Vechi darkah shel ishsha littol shesh sein? ella remez [ramaz] lah, sheatidin shishsha banim latzet mimmenna shemmitbarchin beshesh [shesh] berachot. veellu hen: david umashiach, daniyyel, chananya, mishael vaazarya. david, dichtiv: "vayyaan echad mehannearim vayyomer hinne raiti ben leyishay bet hallachmi yodea naggen vegibbor chayil veish milchama unevon davar veish toar vaAdonai immo vegomer".

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav: kol happasuk hazze lo amaro doeg ella belashon hara. "yodea naggen" – sheyyodea lishshael, "gibbor" – sheyyodea lehashiv, "ish milchama" – sheyyodea lissa velitten bemilchamtah shel tora, "ish toar" – shemmare panim bahalacha, "unevon davar" – shemmevin davar mittoch davar, "vaAdonai immo" – shehalacha kemoto bechol makom.

Bechullehu amar lehu yehonatan beni kamohu. kevan daamar leh "vaAdonai immo", milleta divdideh name la hava beh, chalash dateh veikkanni beh. divshaul ketiv: "uvechol asher yifne yarshia", uvedavid ketiv: "uvechol asher yifne yatzliach".

Menalan dedoeg hava? ketiv hacha: "vayyaan echad mehannearim" – meyuchad shebbannearim, uchetiv hatam: "vesham ish meavde shaul bayyom hahu netzar lifne Adonai ushemo doeg haadomi abbir haroim asher leshaul".
Mashiach, dichtiv: "venacha alav ruach Adonai ruach chochma uvina ruach etza ugevura ruach daat veyirat Adonai vegomer", uchetiv: "vaharicho beyirat Adonai".

Amar rabbi alekkesanderi: melammed shehitino mitzvot veyissurin kerechayim. rava amar: demorach vedaen, dichtiv: "velo lemare enav yishpot", "veshafat betzedek dallim vehochiach bemishor leanve aretz".
Bar kozeva melach tarten shenin ufalga. amar lehu lerabbanan: ana mashiach. amaru leh: bemashiach ketiv demorach vedaen, nechze anan i morach vedaen. kevan dechazyu dela morach vedaen, katlu.

Daniyyel chananya mishael vaazarya, dichtiv behu: "asher en bahem kol meum vetove mare umaskilim bechol chochma veyode daat umevine madda vaasher koach bahem laamod behechal hammelech ulelammedam sefer uleshon kasdim".

May "asher en bahem kol mum"? amar rabbi chama bar chananya: afillu kerivda dechusilta la hava behu. may "vaasher koach bahem laamod behechal hammelech"? amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: melammed shehayu onsin et atzman min hassechok, umin hassicha, umin hashshena, umaamidin al atzman beshaa shennitzrachin lenikvehem mippene emat malchut.

"Vayhi vahem mibbene yehuda daniyyel chananya mishael vaazarya". amar rabbi eliezer: kullan mibbene yehuda hem. verabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: daniel mibbene yehuda, chananya mishael vaazarya mishshear shevatim.
"Umibbanecha asher yetzu mimmecha asher tolid yikkachu vehayu sarisim behechal melech bavel". may sarisim? rav amar: sarisim mammash, verabbi chanina amar: shennistarsa avoda zara bimehem.

Bishlama leman deamar shennistarsa avoda zara bimehem, hayeynu dichtiv "vachaval la itay behon". ella leman deamar sarisim mammash, may "vachaval la itay behon"? chavla denura. vehachtiv "vereach nur la adat behon"? la chavla vela recha.

Bishlama leman deamar shennistarsa avoda zara bimehem, hayeynu dichtiv: "ko amar Adonai lassarisim asher yishmeru et shabbetotay vegomer". ella leman deamar sarisim mammash, mishtae kera bignuta detzaddike? ha veha hava behu.

Bishlama leman deamar sarisim mammash, hayeynu dichtiv "beveti uvechomotay yad vashem tov mibbanim umibbanot". ella leman deamar shennistarsa avoda zara bimehem, may "tov mibbanim umibbanot"? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: mibbanim shehayu lahem kevar umetu. may "shem olam etten lo asher lo yikkaret"? amar rabbi tanchum: darash bar kappara betzippori, ze sefer daniyyel shennikra al shemo.

Mikkede kol mille deezra, nechemya ben chachalya amrinhu, unechemya ben chachalya may tama la ikkeri sifra al shemeh? amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba: mippene shehechzik tova leatzmo, shenneemar "zochra li elohay letova". david name memar amar "zochreni Adonai birtzon ammecha pokdeni bishuatecha"! david rachame hu dekavae.

Rav yosef amar: mippene shessipper bignutan shel rishonim, shenneemar: "vehappachot harishonim asher lefanay hichbidu al haam vayyikchu mehem belechem vayayin achar kesef shekalim arbaim vegomer". veaf al daniyyel, sheggadol mimmennu, sipper.

Umenalan degadol mimmennu? dichtiv: "veraiti ani daniyyel levaddi et hammara vehaanashim asher hayu immi lo rau et hammara aval charada gedola nafla alehem vayyivrechu behechave". "vehaanashim asher hayu immi lo rau et hammara" – uman ninhu anashim? amar rabbi yirmeya, veittema rabbi chiyyay bar abba: ze chaggay, zecharya, umalachi.

a: Inhu adifi minneh, veihu adif minnayyhu. inhu adifi minneh – deinhu nevie, veihu lav neviyya. veihu adif minnayyhu – deihu chaza, veinhu la chazo.
Vechi meachar dela chazo, may tama ibbeut? af al gav deinhu la chazo midde, mazzalayyhu chaze. amar ravina: shema minna hay man demibbeit, af al gav deihu la chaze, mazzaleh chaze.
May takkanteh? linshof midducheteh arbea garmide. i name, likre keriyyat shema. vei kae bimkom hattinnofet, lema hachi: "izza deve tabbacha shammina minnay".

"Lemarbe hammisra uleshalom en ketz vegomer". amar rabbi tanchum: darash bar kappara betzippori, mippene ma kol mem shebbeemtza teva patuach, veze satum? bikkesh hakkadosh baruch hu laasot chizkiyyahu mashiach, vesancheriv gog umagog.

Amra middat haddin lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, uma david melech yisrael sheamar kamma shirot vetishbachot lefanecha – lo asito mashiach, chizkiyya sheasita lo kol hannissim hallalu velo amar shira lefanecha – taasehu mashiach? lechach nistattem.

Miyyad patcha haaretz veamra lefanav: ribbono shel olam, ani omeret lefanecha shira tachat tzaddik ze, vaasehu mashiach. patcha veamra shira lefanav, shenneemar: "mikkenaf haaretz zemirot shamanu tzevi latztzaddik vegomer".

Amar sar haolam lefanav: ribbono shel olam, tzivyono ase latztzaddik ze! yatza bat kol veamra: razi li, razi li. amar navi: oy li, oy li, ad matay? yatza bat kol veamra: "bogdim bagadu uveged bogdim bagadu". veamar rava, veittema rabbi yitzchak: ad deatu bazoze uvazoze devazoze.

"Massa duma elay kore misseir shomer ma millayla shomer ma millel vegomer". amar rabbi yochanan: oto malach hamemunne al haruchot duma shemo. nitkabbetzu kol haruchot etzel duma, amru lo: "shomer, ma millayla? shomer, ma millel?" "amar shomer ata voker vegam layla im tivayun beayu shuvu etayu".

Tana mishshum rabbi pappeyays: genay hu lechizkiyya vesiyato shello amru shira, ad sheppatcha haaretz veamra shira, shenneemar: "mikkenaf haaretz zemirot shamanu tzevi latztzaddik vegomer". kayyotze baddavar atta omer: "vayyomer yitro baruch Adonai asher hitztzil etchem". tana mishshum rabbi pappeyays: genay hu lemoshe veshishshim ribbo shello amru "baruch" ad shebba yitro veamar "baruch Adonai".

"Vayyichad yitro" – rav ushemuel. rav amar: sheheevir cherev chadda al besaro, ushemuel amar: shennaasa chiddudim chiddudim kol besaro. amar rav: hayeynu deamri inashe, giyyora ad asra dare la tivze armay kammeh.

"Lachen yeshallach haadon Adonai tzevaot bemishmannav razon". may "bemishmannav razon"? amar hakkadosh baruch hu: yavo chizkiyyahu sheyyesh lo shemona shemot, veyippara missancheriv sheyyesh lo shemona shemot. chizkiyya, dichtiv: "ki yeled yullad lanu ben nittan lanu vattehi hammisra al shichmo vayyikra shemo pele yoetz el gibbor avi ad sar shalom". vehaikka "chizkiyya"? shechizzeko yah. davar acher: "chizkiyya" – shechizzek et yisrael laavihem shebbashshamayim.
Sancheriv, dichtiv beh: tiglat pileser, pilneeser, shalmaneser, pol, sargon, osnappar rabba veyakkira. vehaikka "sancheriv"? shessichato riv. davar acher: shessach venicher devarim kelappe mala.
Amar rabbi yochanan: mippene ma zacha oto rasha likroto "osnappar rabba veyakkira"? mippene shello sipper bignutah shel eretz yisrael, shenneemar: "ad boi velakachti etchem el eretz keartzechem".

Rav ushemuel: chad amar melech pikkeach haya, vechad amar melech tippesh haya. leman deamar melech pikkeach haya – i amena lehu "adifa mearayychu", amru "ka meshakkerat". uman deamar melech tippesh haya – im ken, may revuteh?

Lehecha aggeli lehu? mar zutera amar: leafriki, verabbi chanina amar: lehare selug. aval yisrael sipperu bignutah shel eretz yisrael. ki meto sos, amri: shavya ki arin. ki meto almin, amaru: kealmin. ki meto sos tere, amri: al chad teren.

"Vetachat kevodo [yekad] yekod kikod esh". amar rabbi yochanan: tachat kevodo, velo kevodo mammash. ki ha derabbi yochanan kare leh lemaneh "mechabbedotay". rabbi elazar amar: tachat kevodo mammash, kisrefat bene aharon. ma lehallan serefat neshama veguf kayyaym, af kan serefat neshama veguf kayyaym.
Tana mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben korcha: paro shecheraf beatzmo, nifra hakkadosh baruch hu mimmennu beatzmo. sancheriv shecheraf
b: Al yede shaliach, nifra hakkadosh baruch hu mimmennu al yede shaliach.

Paro, dichtiv beh: "mi Adonai asher eshma bekolo", nifra hakkadosh baruch hu mimmennu beatzmo, dichtiv: "vaynaer Adonai et mitzrayim betoch hayyam", uchetiv: "darachta bayyam susecha vegomer". sancheriv, dichtiv: "beyad malachecha cherafta Adonai", nifra hakkadosh baruch hu mimmennu al yede shaliach, dichtiv: "vayyetze malach Adonai vayyach bemachane ashshur mea shemonim vachamishsha elef vegomer".
Rabbi chanina bar pappa rame: ketiv "merom kitztzo", uchetiv "melon kitztzo". amar oto rasha: battechilla achriv dira shel matta, veachar kach achriv dira shel mala.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: may dichtiv "atta hamibbalade Adonai aliti al hammakom hazze lehashechito Adonai amar elay ale al haaretz hazzot vehashechitah". may hi? dishma linviyya dekaamar: "yaan ki maas haam hazze et me hashshiloach haholchim leat umesos et retzin uven remalyahu".

Amar rav yosef: ilmale targuma dehay kera, la hava yadana may kaamar. "chalaf dekatz amma haden bemalchuta devet david, dimdabbar lehon binyaych, keme shilocha denagdin binyaych, veitreiu birtzin uvar remalya".

Amar rabbi yochanan: may dichtiv "meerat Adonai bevet rasha uneve tzaddikim yevarech"? "meerat Adonai bevet rasha" – ze pekach ben remalyahu, shehaya ochel arbaim sea gozalot bekinnuach seuda. "uneve tzaddikim yevarech" – ze chizkiyya melech yehuda, shehaya ochel litra yarak bisuda.
"Velachen hinne Adonai maale alehem et me hannahar haatzumim veharabbim et melech ashshur", uchetiv: "vechalaf bihuda shataf veavar ad tzavvar yaggia".

Ella may tama ianish? neviyya aaseret hashshevatim itnabbi, ihu yehayv dateh al kulla yerushalem. ba navi veamar lo: "ki lo muaf laasher mutzak lah". amar rabbi elazar bar berechya: en nimsar am ayef battora beyad mi hammetzik lo.

May "kaet harishon hekal artza zevulun veartza naftali vehaacharon hichbid derech hayyam ever hayyarden gelil haggoyim"? lo karishonim shehekellu mealehem ol tora, aval acharonim shehichbidu alehen ol tora. ureuyin hallalu laasot lahem nes keovre hayyam uchedorche hayyarden. im chozer bo – mutav, veim lav – ani eese lo galil baggoyim.
"Achare haddevarim vehaemet haelle ba sancheriv melech ashshur vayyavo vihuda vayyichan al hearim habbetzurot vayyomer levikam elav". hay rishana lehay pardashna?

"Achare haddevarim vehaemet", achar may? amar ravina: leachar shekkafatz hakkadosh baruch hu venishba, veamar: i amena leh lechizkiyya mayytena leh lesancheriv umasarna leh bidach, hasheta amar: la hu baena vela biatuteh baena.

Miyyad kafatz hakkadosh baruch hu venishba: demayytena leh, shenneemar: "nishba Adonai tzevaot lemor im lo kaasher dimmiti ken hayata vechaasher yaatzti hi takum. lishbor ashshur beartzi veal haray avusennu vesar mealehem ullo vesubbolo meal shichmo yasur". amar rabbi yochanan: amar hakkadosh baruch hu: yavo sancheriv vesiato veyease evus lechizkiyyahu ulesiato.

"Vehaya bayyom hahu yasur subbolo meal shichmecha veullo meal tzavvarecha vechubbal ol mippene shamen". amar rabbi yitzchak nappacha: chubbal ol shel sancheriv mippene shamno shel chizkiyyahu, shehaya dolek bevatte chenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot.

Ma asa? naatz cherev al petach bet hammidrash, veamar: kol mi sheeno osek battora yiddaker becherev zo. badku middan vead beer sheva, velo matzu am haaretz. miggevat vead antifras, velo matzu tinok vetinoket, ish veishsha, shello hayu bekiin behilchot tumea vetohora.

Veal oto haddor hu omer: "vehaya bayyom hahu yechayye ish eglat bakar ushete tzon vegomer", veomer: "vehaya bayyom hahu yihye chol makom asher yihye sham elef gefen beelef kasef lashshamir velashshayit yihye". af al pi sheelef gefen beelef kasef, lashshamir velashshayit yihye.

"Veussaf shelalchem osef hechasil". amar lahem navi leyisrael: isfu shelalchem. amru lo: livzoz o lachlok? amar lahem: "keosef hechasil". ma osef hechasil – kol echad veechad leatzmo. af shelalchem – kol echad veechad leatzmo.

Amru lo: vahalo mamon aseret hashshevatim meorav bo? amar lahem: "kemashshak gevim shokek bo". ma gevim hallalu maalin et haadam mittumea letohora, af mamonam shel yisrael – kevan shennafal beyad ummot haolam, miyyad tihar. kidrav pappa, deamar rav pappa: ammon umoav taharu besichon.

Amar rav huna: eser massaot nasa oto rasha beoto hayyom, shenneemar: "ba al ayyat, avar bemigron, lemichmas yafkid kelav. avru mabara, geva malon lanu, charda harama, givat shaul nasa. tzahali kolech bat gallim, hakeshivi laysha, aniyya anatot. nadda madmena, yoshve haggevim heizu. od hayyom benov laamod, yenofef yado har bat tziyyon givat yerushalam".

Hane tuva havyayn? "tzahali kolech bat gallim" – navi hu dekaamar la lichneset yisrael: "tzahali kolech bat gallim", bitto shel avraham yitzchak veyaakov sheasu mitzvot kegalle hayyam. "hakeshivi laysha" – mehay la tistefay, ella istefay minnevuchadnetztzar harasha dimtil kearye, shenneemar: "ala arye missubbecho vegomer".
May

a: "Aniyya anatot" – atid yirmeya ben chilkiyya umitnabbe ala meanatot, dichtiv: "divre yirmeyahu ben chilkiyyahu min hakkohanim asher baanatot beeretz binyamin".
Mi dame? hatam ari, hacha layish! amar rabbi yochanan: shishsha shemot yesh laari, ellu hen: ari, kefir, lavi, layish, shachal, shachatz. i hachi, batzru lehu! avru mabara tarte ninhu.

May "od hayyom benov laamod"? amar rav huna: oto hayyom nishtayyer meavonah shel nov. amri leh kaldae: i azlat haiddana – yachlat la, vei la – la yachlat la. orcha diva lesaggoye beasra yome, sagge bechad yoma.

Ki meto lirushelem, shedo leh bistarke, ad dislek vitev meillave shura, ad dechazyav lechulla yerushelem. ki chazyay, izzutar beeneh. amar: hala da hi karta dirushelem daala argeshit kol mashyryatay, vaala kabbeshit kol medinata? hala hi zeera vechallasha mikkol karche ammayya dechabbeshit bitkof yeday? ala vekam umaned beresheh, movel umayyte bideh al tur bet makdesha divtziyyon veal azarta devirushelem.

Amri: nishde beh yeda haiddana. amar lehu: tamhitu, limchar ayyto li kol chad vechad minnayychu gulemo harag minneh. miyyad: "vayhi ballayla hahu vayyetze malach Adonai vayyach bemachane ashshur mea shemonim vachamishsha alef vayyashkimu vabboker vehinne chullam pegarim metim". amar rav pappa: hayeynu deamri inashe: bat dina – betal dina.

"Veyishbi benov asher bilide harafa umishkal keno shelosh meot mishkal nechoshet vehu chagur chadasha vayyomer lehakkot et david". may "veyishbi benov"? amar rav yehuda amar rav: ish shebba al iske nov. amar leh hakkadosh baruch hu ledavid: ad matay yihye avon ze tamun beyadcha? al yadcha neherga nov ir hakkohanim, veal yadcha nitrad doeg haadomi, veal yadcha nehergu shaul usheloshet banav.
Retzoncha yichle zarecha, o timmaser beyad oyev? amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, mutav emmaser beyad oyev velo yichle zari.

Yoma chad nefak lishchor bazae, ata satan veiddemi leh ketavya. petak beh gira vela matyeh. mashcheh ad deamteyeh leeretz pelishtim. kidchazyeh yishbi benov amar: hayeynu hay dekatleh legolyat achi. kafteh, kamteh, otveh veshadyeh tute be sadyay. itavid leh nissa, macha leh ara mittuteh. hayeynu dichtiv: "tarchiv tzaadi tachtay velo maadu karsullay".

Hahu yoma appanya demaale shabbeta hava. avishay ben tzeruya hava ka chayef resheh bearbea garve demayya. chazinhu kitme dema. ikka deamri: ata yona itterif kammeh. amar: keneset yisrael leyona immetila, shenneemar "kanfe yona nechpa vakkesef". shema minna david malka deyisrael betzaara shere. ata leveteh vela ashkecheh. amar, tenan: en rochvin al suso veen yoshvin al kiso veen mishtammeshin besharvito. bishat hassakkana may? ata sheel be midresha. amaru leh: bishat hassakkana shappir dame.

Rachveh lefirdeh vekam vaazal. kefatza leh ara. bahade deka mesagge, chazyay leorpa immeh dahavavt navvla. ki chazeteh, pesakte lefilka, shedateh illaveh, sevara lemikteleh. amara leh: ulem, ayyti li pelach! patkeh beresh mocha, vekatla.
Kad chazyeh yishbi benov, amar: hasheta havu be teren vekatlin li. patkeh ledavid leella, vedatz leh lerumecheh. amar: nippol ale venikketal. amar avishay shem, okmeh ledavid ben shemayya leara.
Venema leh ihu? en chavush motzi atzmo mibbet haasurin.
Amar leh: may baet hacha? amar leh: hachi amar li kudesha berich hu, vehachi ahdari leh. amar leh: efoch tzelotaych! bar berach kira lizbon, veat la titztaar.
Amar leh: i hachi, sayyay bahadan. hayeynu dichtiv: "vayyaazor lo avishay ben tzeruya". amar rav yehuda amar rav: sheazaro bitfilla. amar avishay shem veachateh.

Hava ka radef batrayyhu. ki meto kubbe, amri: kum beh. ki meto be tere, amri: bitre gureyavan katlu learya. amri leh: zil ishtechach leorpa immaych bekivra. ki adkaru leh shema deimmeh, kechash cheleh vekatlu. hayeynu dichtiv: "az nishbeu anshe david lo lemor lo tetze od ittanu lammilchama velo techabbe et ner yisrael".

Tanu rabbanan: shelosha kaftza lahem haaretz – eliezer eved avraham, veyaakov avinu, vaavishay ben tzeruya. avishay ben tzeruya – ha daamaran. eliezer eved avraham – dichtiv: "vaavo hayyom el haayin", lememra dehahu yoma nefak. yaakov avinu -
b: Dichtiv: "vayyetze yaakov mibbeer shava vayyelech charana", uchetiv: "vayyifga bammakom vayyalen sham ki va hashshemesh". ki meta lecharan amar: efshar avarti al mekom shehitpallelu bo avotay vaani lo hitpallalti bo? bae lemehdar. kevan deharhar bedateh lemihdar, kefatza leh ara. miyyad – "vayyifga bammakom".
Davar acher: en pegia ella tefilla, shenneemar: "veatta al titpallel bead haam hazze veal tissa vaadam rinna utefilla veal tifga bi".

"Vayyalen sham ki va hashshemesh". batar detzalli bae lemihdar, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: tzaddik ze ba levet meloni, yippater belo lina? miyyad ba hashshemesh. vehayeynu dichtiv: "vayyizrach lo hashshemesh". vechi lo bilvad zarcha? vahalo lechol haolam kullo zarcha! ella amar rabbi yitzchak: shemesh shebbaa baavuro, zarcha baavuro.

Umenalan dichla zareh dedavid? dichtiv: "vaatalya em achazyahu raata ki met benah vattakom vatteabbed et kol zera hammamlacha". veha ishteyayr leh yoash? hatam name ishteyayr evyatar, dichtiv: "vayyimmalet ben echad laachimelech ben achituv ushemo evyatar". amar rav yehuda amar rav: ilmale lo nishtayyer evyatar laachimelech ben achituv, lo nishtayyer mizzaro shel david sarid ufalit.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: ba alehem sancheriv harasha bearbaim vachamishsha elef ish bene melachim, yoshvim bikronot shel zahav, veimmahen shiglonot vezonot, uvishmonim elef gibborim levushe shiryon kelippa, uveshishshim elef achuze cherev ratzim lefanav, vehashshear parashim. vechen bau al avraham, vechen atidin lavo im gog umagog.

Bematnita tana: orech machanehu arba meot parsa, rochav tzavvar susav arbaim parsa. sach machanehu matayim veshishshim ribbo alafim chaser chad. bae abbaye: chaser chad ribboya, o chasar chad alpa, o chasar mea, o chasar chad? teku.

Tana: rishonim avru bischi, shenneemar: "vechalaf bihuda shataf veavar". emtzaiyyim avru bekoma, shenneemar: "ad tzavvar yaggia". acharonim heelu afar beraglehem velo matzu mayim bannahar lishtot, ad sheheviu mayim mimmakom acher veshatu, shenneemar: "ani karti veshatiti mayim vegomer".
Vehachtiv: "vayyetze malach Adonai vayyakke bemachane ashshur mea ushemonim vachamishsha alef, vayyashkimu vabboker vehinne chullam pegarim metim"? amar rabbi avahu: hallalu rashe geyaysot hen.

Amar rav ashe: dayka name, dichtiv "bemishmannav razon" – bishmenim deit behu. amar ravina: dayka name, dichtiv "vayyishlach Adonai malach vayyachched kol gibbor chayil venagid vesar bemachane vegomer vayyavo bet elohav umitzie meav sham hippiluhu vecharev". shema minna.

Bamme hikkam? rabbi eliezer omer: bayyad hikkam, shenneemar: "vayyar yisrael et hayyad haggedola". hayyad sheatida lippara missancheriv. rabbi yehoshua omer: beetzba hikkam, shenneemar: "vayyomru hachartummim el paro etzba elohim hi". hi etzba sheatida lippara missancheriv. rabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili omer: amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu legavriel: maggalcha netusha? amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, netusha veomedet mishsheshet yeme bereshit, shenneemar: "[mippene cherev netusha mippene keshet derucha mippene koved milchama] (vego)".

Rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: oto happerek zeman bishshul perot haya. amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu legavriel: kesheatta yotze levashshel perot, hizzakek lahem, shenneemar: "midde ovro yikkach etchem ki vabboker babboker yaavor bayyom uvallayla vehaya rak zevaa havin shemua vegomer". amar rav pappa: hayeynu deamri inashe, aggav orchach, livel devavach ishtema.

Veyesh omrim: bechotman nashaf bahen vametu, shenneemar: "vegam nashaf bahem vayyivashu". rabbi yirmeya bar abba amar: kappayim safak lahem vametu, shenneemar: "vegam ani akke chappi el kappi vahanichoti chamati". rabbi yitzchak nappacha amar: oznayim gala lahem veshamu shira mippi chayyot vametu, shenneemar: "merommutecha naftzu goyim".

Vechamma nishtayyer mehem? rav amar: asara, shenneemar: "ushear etz yaro mispar yihyu venaar yichtevem". kamma naar yachol lichtov? asara. ushemuel amar: tisha, shenneemar: "venishar bo olelot kenokef zayit shenayim shelosha gargerim berosh amir arbaa chamishsha bisifeha".

Rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: arbaa asar, shenneemar "shenayim shelosha [vechulei] arbaa vachamishsha". rabbi yochanan amar: chamishsha – sancheriv ushene banav, nevuchadnetztzar unevuzzaradan. nevuzaradan – gemara. nevuchadnetztzar – dichtiv: "vereve di reviaa dame levar elahin", vei lav dechazyeh mena hava yada? sancheriv ushene banav – dichtiv: "vayhi hu mishtachave bet nisroch elohav veadrammelech vesaretzer banav hikkuhu vacherev".
Amar rabbi avahu: ilmale mikra katuv, i efshar leomro, dichtiv: "bayyom hahu yegallach Adonai betaar hassechira beevre nahar bemelech ashshur et harosh vesaar haraglayim vegam et hazzakan tispe".

Ata kudesha berich hu, veiddemi leh kegavra sava. amar leh: ki azlat legabbe malche mizrach umaarav deayytitinhu livnayyhu uketaltinhu, may amrat lehu? amar leh: hahu gavra behahu pachda name yatev. amar leh: hechi naaved? amar leh: zil

a: Veshanni nafshach. bemay eshanne? amar leh: zil ayyti li maspera veegzeyaych ana. mehecha ayyte? amar leh: ul lehahu beta veayyte. azal, ashkechinhu lemalache sharet veiddemo leh kegavre, vahavo ka tachani kashyayta.

Amar lehu: havu li maspera. amaru leh: techon chad geriva dekashyayta venitten lach. techan chad geriva dekashyayta vihavu leh masparta. ad daata, ichashach. amaru leh: zil ayyti nura. azal veayyti nura. bahade deka nafach leh, itteli beh nura bedikneh. azal gazyeh leresheh vedikneh. (amaru): hayeynu dichtiv "vegam et hazzakan tispe". amar rav pappa, hayeynu deamri inashe: "garerteh learmaa shefar leh, aytle leh nura bedikneh vela savat chucha minneh".

Azal, ashkach dappa mittevuta denoach. amar: hayeynu elaha rabba deshezveh lenoach mittofana. amar: i azel hahu gavra umatzlach, mekarev lehu litren benohi kammach. shemau benohi vekatlu. hayeynu dichtiv: "vayhi hu mishtachave bet nisroch elohav veadrammelech vesaretzer banav hikkuhu vacherev vegomer".

"Vayyechalek alehem layla hu vaavadav vayyakkem vegomer". amar rabbi yochanan: oto malach shennizdammen lo leavraham, "layla" shemo, shenneemar: "vehallayla amar hora gaver". verabbi yitzchak nappacha amar: sheasa immo maase layla, shenneemar: "min shamayim nilchamu hakkochavim mimmesillotam nilchamu im sisra". amar resh lakish: tava denappacha middevar nappacha.

"Vayyirdof ad dan". amar rabbi yochanan: kevan shebba oto tzaddik ad dan, tashash kocho. raa bene banav sheatidin laavod avoda zara bedan, shenneemar: "vayyasem et haechad bevet el veet haechad natan bedan". veaf oto rasha lo nitgabber ad shehiggia ledan, shenneemar: "middan nishma nachrat susav".

Amar rabbi zera: "af al gav deshalach rabbi yehuda ben betera minnetzivin: hizzaharu bezaken sheshshachach talmudo mechamat onso, vehizzaharu bavvevridin kerabbi yehuda, vehizzaharu bivne amme haaretz shemmehen tetze tora – ki ha milleta modinan lehu.

"Tzaddik atta Adonai ki ariv elecha ach mishpatim adabber otach maddua derech reshaim tzalecha shalu kol bogde vaged. netatam gam shorashu yelchu gam asu feri". may ahdaru leh? "ki et raglim ratzta vayyalucha veech tetachare et hassusim uveeretz shalom atta voteach veech taase bigon hayyarden".

Mashal leadam echad sheamar: yachol ani larutz shalosh parsaot lifne hassusim ben bitze hammayim. nizdammen lo ragli echad, ratz lefanav shelosha milin bayyabbasha venila. amru lo: uma lifne ragli kach, lifne hassusim – al achat kamma vechamma. uma sheloshet milin kach, shalosh parsaot – al achat kamma vechamma. uma bayyabbasha kach, ben bitze hammayim – al achat kamma vechamma.

Af atta: uma bischar arba pesiot sheshshillamti leoto rasha, sheratz achar kevodi, atta tameah? kesheani meshallem sachar leavraham yitzchak veyaakov sheratzu lefanay kesusim – al achat kamma vechamma! hayeynu dichtiv: "lanneviim nishbar libbi vekirbi rachafu kol atzmotay hayiti keish shikkor uchegever avaro yayin mippene Adonai umippene divre kodsho".

Hane arba pesiot may hi? dichtiv: "baet hahi shalach merodach baladan ben baladan melech bavel sefarim vegomer". mishshum "ki chala chizkiyyahu vayyechezak" shaddar leh sefarim umincha? in, lidrosh "(et) hammofet asher haya vaaretz". deamar rabbi yochanan: oto hayyom shemmet bo achaz shete shaot haya.

Vechi chala chizkiyyahu veittefach, ahderinhu kudesha berich hu lehanach asar shae nihaleh, dichtiv: "hinni meshiv et tzel hammaalot asher yarda vemaalot achaz bashshemesh achorannit eser maalot vattashov hashshemesh eser maalot bammaalot asher yarada". amar lehu: may hay? amaru leh: chizkiyyahu chalash veittefach. amar: ikka gavra ki hay vela baena leshaddore leh shelama? ketavu leh: "shelama lemalka chizkiyya, shelam lekarta dirushelem, shelam leelaha rabba".

Nevuchadnetztzar safreh devaladan hava. hahi shata la hava hatam. ki ata, amar lehu: hechi katvitu? amaru leh: hachi katvinan. amar lehu: keretu leh "elaha rabba" vechatvitu leh levassof? amar: ella hachi ketuvu: "shelam leelaha rabba, shelam lekarta dirushelem, shelam lemalka chizkiyya". amri leh: karyayna deiggarta ihu leheve parvavnka.
Rehat batreh, kidrahet arba pesiot, ata gavriel veokmeh. amar rabbi yochanan: ilmale lo ba gavriel veheemido, lo haya takkana lesonehem shel yisrael.

May "baladan ben baladan"? amri: baladan malka hava, veishtanni appeh vahava ki dechalba. hava yatev bereh al malchuta. ki hava katev, hava katev shemeh ushemeh daavu "baladan malka". hayeynu dichtiv: "ben yechabbed av veeved adonav".

"Ben yechabbed av" – ha daamaran, "veeved adonav" – dichtiv: "uvachodesh hachamishi beasor lachodesh hi shenat tesha esre shana lammelech nevuchadnetztzar melech bavel ba nevuzaradan rav tabbachim amad lifne melech bavel birushalam vayyisrof et bet Adonai veet bet hammelech".
b: Umi selek nevuchad netztzar lirushalayim? vehachtiv: "vayyaalu oto el melech bavel rivlata", veamar rabbi avahu: zo antochya! rav chisda verav yitzchak bar avudimi, chad amar: demut deyokno hayta chakuka lo al merkavto, vechad amar: ema yetera hayta lo mimmennu vedome kemi sheomed lefanav.

Amar rava: teon telat mea kudanyayta narga defarzela deshalet befarzela shaddar leh nevuchadnetztzar linvuzaradan. kullehu belatinhu chad dashsha dirushelem, shenneemar: "pittucheha yachad bechashshil vechelappot yahalomun". bae lemihdar, amar: mistefena dela libedu bi ki hechi daavadu besancheriv.

Nafka kala veamar: "shavavr bar shavavr, nevuzaradan, shevavr dimta zimna demakdesha chariv vehechla mikkele". pash leh chad narga. ata machyeh bekofa, veippetach, shenneemar: "yivvada kemevi lemala bisvoch etz kardummot".

Hava katel veazel, ad dimta lehechla. adlek beh nura. geva hechla. derachu beh min shemayya, shenneemar: "gat darach Adonai livtulat bat yehuda". ka zicha dateh. nefaka bat kala vaamara leh: amma ketila katlat, hechla kalya kelet, kimcha techina techent, shenneemar: "kechi rechayim vetachani kamach galli tzammatech chespi shovel galli shok ivri neharot". "chittim" lo neemar, ella "kemach".

Chaza demeh dizcharya dahava ka ratach. amar lehu: may hay? amaru leh: dam zevachim hu deishtefich. amar lehu: ayyte vaanasse i middemu. kassi vela iddemo. amar lehu: gallo li, vei la sarekna lechu levisrayychu bemasreka defarzela.

Amaru leh: hay kohen venavi hu, deinnabbi lehu leyisrael bechurebana dirushelem, vekatlu. amar lehu: ana mefayyesna leh. ayyti rabbanan, katel illaveh, vela nach. ayyti dardakke deve rav, katel illaveh, vela nach. ayyti pirche chehunna, katel illaveh, vela nach. ad di ketal illaveh tishin vearbea ribbo, vela nach.

Kerav legabbeh, amar: zecharya, zecharya, tovim shebbahen ibbadtim. nicha lach deektelinhu lechullehu? miyyad nach. harehar teshuva bedateh, amar: ma hem shello ibbedu ella nefesh achat kach, hahu gavra ma tehve aleh? arak, shaddar pureteta leveteh, veitgayyayr.

Tanu rabbanan: naaman - ger toshav haya, nevuzar adan - ger tzedek haya. mibbene vanav shel sisra limmedu tora birushalayim, mibbene vanav shel sancheriv limmedu tora barabbim. uman ninhu? shemaya veavtalyon.

Mibbene banav shel haman limmedu tora bivne berak. veaf mibbene banav shel oto rasha bikkesh hakkadosh baruch hu lehichnisan tachat kanfe hashshechina. amru malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, mi shehecheriv et betcha vesaraf et hechalecha tachnis tachat kanfe hashshechina? hayeynu dichtiv: "rippinu et bavel velo nirpata". ulla amar: ze nevuchadnetztzar. rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: ellu naharot bavel, vetarguma: tzinyayta tzeridata devavlae.

Amar ulla: ammon umoav shivave bishe dirushelem havo. kevan deshaminhu linvie deka mitnabbei lechurebana dirushelem, shelachu linvuchadnetztzar: pok veta. amar: mistefena dela libedu li kedaavadu bekammae.

Shelachu leh: "ki en haish beveto halach bederech merachok", veen ish ella hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: "Adonai ish milchama". shelach lehu: bekariva hu veate. shelachu leh: "halach bederech merachok". shelach lehu: it lehu tzaddike devau rachame umayytu leh.
Shelachu leh: "tzeror hakkesef lakach beyado", veen kesef ella tzaddikim, shenneemar: "vaekkereha li bachamishsha asar kasef vechomer seorim veletech seorim".

Shelach lehu: hadri rashshie bitshuva, uvau rachame umayytu leh. shelachu leh: kevar kava lahen zeman, shenneemar "leyom hakkese yavo beto". en kese ella zeman, shenneemar "bakkese leyom chaggenu". shelach lehu: sitvav hu, vela matzena deate mittalga umimmitra.

Shelachu leh: ta ashshinna detura, shenneemar: "shilchu char moshel eretz missela midbara el har bat tziyyon". shelach lehu: i atena, let li ducheta deyatevna beh. shelachu leh: kevarot shellahem meullin mippalterin shellecha, dichtiv: "baet hahi neum Adonai yotziu et atzmot malche yehuda veet atzmot sarav veet atzmot hakkohanim veet atzmot hanneviim veet atzmot yoshve yerushalaym mikkivrehem ushetachum lashshemesh velayyareach ulechol tzeva hashshamayim asher ahevum vaasher avadum vaasher halchu acharehem".
Amar leh rav nachman lerabbi yitzchak: mi shemia lach emat ate bar nafle? amar leh: man bar nafle? amar leh: mashiach. mashiach bar nafle karet leh? amar leh: in, dichtiv "bayyom hahu akim

a: Et sukkat david hannofelet". amar leh: hachi amar rabbi yochanan: dor shebben david ba bo, talmide chachamim mitmaatim, vehashshear enehem kalot beyagon vaanacha, vetzarot rabbot ugezerot kashot mitchaddeshot, ad sheharishona pekuda, sheniyya memaheret lavo.

Tanu rabbanan: shavua shebben david ba bo, shana rishona mitkayyem mikra ze "vehimtarti al ir echat veal ir achat lo amtir". sheniyya, chitztze raav mishtallechim. shelishit, raav gadol, umetim anashim venashim vataf, chasidim veanshe maase, vetora mishtakkachat millomdeha. birviit, sova veeno sova. bachamishit, sova gadol, veochlin veshotin usemechin, vetora chozeret lelomdeha. beshishshit, kolot. bishviit, milchamot. bemotzae sheviit, ben david ba.
Amar rav yosef: ha kamma shavue dahava ken, vela ata! amar abbaye: beshishshit kolot, bishviit milchamot – mi hava? veod, kesidran mi hava?

"Asher cherfu oyvecha Adonai asher cherfu ikkevot meshichecha". tanya: rabbi yehuda omer, dor shebben david ba bo – bet havvavad yihye liznut, vehaggalil yecherav, vehaggavlan yesham, veanshe gevul yesovvu meir lair velo yechonanu, vechochmat hassofrim tisrach, veyire chet yimmaesu, ufene haddor kifne chelev.

"Vehaemet nederet", shenneemar: "vattehi haemet nederet vesar mera mishtolel". may "vattehi haemet nederet"? amri deve rav: melammed shennaaset adarim adarim veholechet lah. may "vesar mera mishtolel"? amri deve rabbi shela: kol mi shessar mera mishtolel al habberiyyot.

Amar rava: meresh hava amena, lekka kusheta bealma. amar li hahu merabbanan, verav tavut shemeh – veamri la rav tavyome shemeh – dei havo yahavi leh kol chalale dealma la hava meshanne bedibbureh. zimna chada ikkelai lehahu atra, vekusheta shemeh, vela havo meshanne bedibburayyhu, vela hava mayet inish mehatam bela zimneh. nesevi itteta minnehon, vahavo li teren benin minna.

Yoma chad hava yatva devethu veka chayyfa resha. atay shivavta, terafa addashsha. sevari: lav orach ara. amari la: leta hacha. shechivu leh teren beneh. ato inashe deatra lekammeh, amaru leh: may hay? amar lehu: hachi hava maase. amaru leh: bematuta minnach, pok meatrin vela tegare behu motana behanach inashe.

Tanya: rabbi nehoray omer, dor shebben david ba bo – nearim yalbinu pene zekenim, uzekenim yaamdu lifne nearim, uvat kama beimmah, vechalla bachamotah, ufene haddor kifne chelev, veen habben mitbayyesh meaviv.

Tanya: rabbi nechemya omer, dor shebben david ba bo, haazzut tirbe, vehayyokar yeavvet, vehaggefen yitten piryo vehayyayin beyoker, venehefacha kol hammalchut leminut, veen tochecha. mesayyay leh lerabbi yitzchak, deamar rabbi yitzchak: en ben david ba ad shettithappech kol hammalchut leminut. amar rava: may kera? "kullo hafach lavan tahor hu".

Tanu rabbanan: "ki yadin Adonai ammo [vegomer] ki yire ki azlat yad veefes atzur veazuv". en ben david ba ad sheyyirbu hammasorot. davar acher: ad sheyyitmaatu hattalmidim. davar acher: ad shettichle peruta min hakkis. davar acher: ad sheyyityayashu min haggeulla, shenneemar: "veefes atzur veazuv" – kivyachol en somech veozer leyisrael.
Ki ha derabbi zera, ki hava mashkach rabbanan demiasseki beh, amar lehu: bematuta, baena minnayychu la terachaku, ditnena: shelosha bain behessach haddaat, ellu hen: mashiach, metzia, veakrav.

Amar rav kattina: shet alfe shene have alma, vechad charuv, shenneemar: "venisgav Adonai levaddo bayyom hahu". abbaye amar: tere charuv, shenneemar: "yechayyenu miyyomayim bayyom hashshelishi yekimenu venichye lefanav".

Tanya kevateh derav kattina: keshem shehashsheviit meshammetet shana achat lesheva shanim, kach haolam meshammet elef shanim leshivat alafim shana, shenneemar: "venisgav Adonai levaddo bayyom hahu", veomer: "mizmor shir leyom hashshabbat" – yom shekkullo shabbat. veomer: "ki elef shanim beenecha keyom etmol ki yaavor".
Tana deve eliyyahu: sheshet alafim shana have alma, shene alafim tohu, shene alafim tora, shene alafim yemot hammashiach.
b: Uvaavonotenu sherabbu, yatzu mehem ma sheyyetzu.

Amar leh eliyyahu lerav yehuda achu derav salla chasida: en haolam pachot mishshemonim vachamishsha yovlot, uvayyovel haacharon ben david ba. amar leh: bitchillato o besofo? amar leh: eni yodea. kale o eno kale? amar leh: eni yodea. rav ashe amar: hachi amar leh: ad hacha la tistakke leh, mikkan veelach istakke leh.

Shelach leh rav chanan bar tachlifa lerav yosef: matzati adam echad uveyado megilla achat ketuva ashshurit uleshon kodesh. amarti lo: zo minnayin lach? amar li: lachayaylot shel romi niskarti uven ginze romi metzatiha. vechatuv bah: leachar arbaat alafim umatayim vetishim veechad shana livriato shel olam, haolam yittom. mehen milchamot tanninim, mehen milchamot gog umagog, ushear yemot hammashiach. veen hakkadosh baruch hu mechaddesh et olamo ella leachar shivat alafim shana. rav acha bereh derava amar: leachar chameshet alafim shana ittemar.
Tanya: rabbi natan omer, mikra ze nokev veyored ad tehom: "ki od chazon lammoed veyafeach lakketz velo yechazzev im yitmahmah chakke lo ki vo yavo lo yeacher".
Lo kerabbotenu shehayu dorshin: "ad iddan iddanin ufelag iddan".
Vela kerabbi simlay, shehaya doresh: "heechaltam lechem dima vattashkemo bidmaot shelish".
Vela kerabbi akiva, shehaya doresh: "od achat meat hi vaani marish et hashshamayim veet haaretz".
Ella malchut rishona – shivim shana, malchut sheniyya – chamishshim ushetayim, umalchut ben kozeva – shete shanim umechetza.

May "veyafeach lakketz velo yechazzev"? amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: tippach atzman shel mechashsheve kitztzin, shehayu omrim kevan shehiggia (et) hakketz velo ba – shuv eno ba. ella chakke lo, shenneemar: "im yitmahmah chakke lo". shemma tomar: anu mechakkin vehu eno mechakke? talmud lomar: "velachen yechakke Adonai lachananchem velachen yarum lerachemchem".
Vechi meachar sheanu mechakkim, vehu mechakke, mi meakkev? middat haddin meakkevet. vechi meachar shemmiddat haddin meakkevet, anu lamma mechakkin? lekabbel sachar, shenneemar: "ashre kol choche lo".

Amar abbaye: la pachet alma mittelatin veshitta tzaddike dimkabbeli appe shechina bechol dara, shenneemar "ashre kol choche lo" – "lo" begimatriyya telatin veshitta havu. ini? vehaamar rava: dara dekamme kudesha berich hu tamne sere alfe parsa havey, shenneemar "saviv shemona asar alef"! la kashya: ha demistakkeli beispaklarya hammeira, ha demistakkeli beispaklarya sheenah meira.

Umi nefishi kulle hay? vehaamar chizkiyya amar rabbi yirmeya mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: raiti bene aliyyay vehen muatin. im elef hem – ani uveni mehem, im mea hem – ani uveni mehem, im shenayim hem – ani uveni hem.
La kashya, ha deayyli bevar, ha deayyli bela bar.

Amar rav: kalu kol hakkitztzin, veen haddavar taluy ella bitshuva umaasim tovim. ushemuel amar: dayyo laavel sheyyaamod beevlo. ketannae: rabbi eliezer omer: im yisrael osin teshuva – nigalin, veim lav – en nigalin. amar lo rabbi yehoshua: im en osin teshuva en nigalin? ella hakkadosh baruch hu maamid lahen melech sheggezerotav kashot kehaman, veyisrael osin teshuva umachziran lemutav.

Tanya iddach: rabbi eliezer omer, im yisrael osin teshuva – nigalin, shenneemar: "shuvu banim shovavim erpa meshuvotechem". amar lo rabbi yehoshua: vahalo kevar neemar: "chinnam nimkartem velo vechesef tiggaelu"? "chinnam nimkartem" – baavoda zara, "velo bechesef tiggaelu" – lo bitshuva umaasim tovim.

Amar lo rabbi eliezer lerabbi yehoshua: vahalo kevar neemar "shuvu elay veashuva alechem"? amar lo rabbi yehoshua: vahalo kevar neemar "ki anochi baalti vachem velakachti etchem echad meir ushenayim mimmishpacha veheveti etchem tziyyon"?

Amar lo rabbi eliezer: vahalo kevar neemar "beshuva vanachat tivvasheun"? amar lo rabbi yehoshua lerabbi eliezer: vahalo kevar neemar "ko amar Adonai goel yisrael kedosho livzo nefesh limtaev goy leeved moshlim

a: Melachim yiru vakamu sarim veyishtachavu"?

Amar lo rabbi eliezer: vahalo kevar neemar "im tashuv yisrael neum Adonai elay tashuv"? amar lo rabbi yehoshua: vahalo kevar neemar "vaeshma et haish levush habbaddim asher mimmaal lememe hayeor vayyarem yemino usemolo el hashshamayim vayyishshava beche haolam ki lemoed moadim vachetzi uchechallot nappetz yad am kodesh tichlena chol elle vegomer"? veshatak rabbi eliezer.

Veamar rabbi abba: en lecha ketz megulle mizze, shenneemar: "veattem hare yisrael anpechem tittenu uferyechem tisu leammi yisrael vegomer". rabbi eliezer omer: af mizze, shenneemar: "ki lifne hayyamim hahem sechar haadam lo nihya usechar habbehema enenna velayyotze velabba en shalom min hatztzar".

May "layyotze velabba en shalom min hatztzar"? rav amar: af talmide chachamim, shekkatuv bahem shalom, dichtiv "shalom rav leohave toratecha", en shalom mippene tzar. ushemuel amar: ad sheyyihyu kol hashshearim kullan shekulin.

Amar rabbi chanina: en ben david ba ad sheyyitbakkesh dag [katan] lechole velo yimmatze, shenneemar: "az ashkia memehem venaharotam kashshemen olich", uchetiv batreh: "bayyom hahu atzmiach keren levet yisrael".

Amar rabbi chama bar chanina: en ben david ba ad shettichle malchut hazzala miyyisrael, shenneemar: "vecharat hazzalzallim bammazmerot", uchetiv batreh: "baet hahi yuval shay laAdonai tzevaot am memushshach umorat".

Amar zeeri amar rabbi chanina: en ben david ba ad sheyyichlu gasse haruach miyyisrael, shenneemar: "ki az asir mikkirbech allize gaavatech", uchetiv: "vehisharti vekirbech am ani vadal vechasu beshem Adonai".

Amar rabbi simlay mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi shimon: en ben david ba ad sheyyichlu kol shoftim veshotrim miyyisrael, shenneemar: "veashiva yadi alayich veetzrof kabbor sigayich vegomer veashiva shoftayich".

Amar ulla: en yerushalayim nifdet ella bitzdaka, shenneemar: "tziyyon bemishpat tippade veshaveha bitzdaka". amar rav pappa: i batli yehire – batli amgushe, i batli dayyayne – batli gezirpate. i batli yehire batli amgushe, dichtiv: "veetzrof kabbor sigayich veasira kol bedilayich". vei batli dayyayne batli gezirpate, dichtiv: "hesir Adonai mishpatayich pinna oyvech".

Amar rabbi yochanan: im raita dor shemmitmaet veholech, chakke lo, shenneemar: "veet am ani toshia vegomer". amar rabbi yochanan: im raita dor shetztzarot rabbot baot alav kannahar, chakke lo, shenneemar: "ki yavo channahar tzar ruach Adonai nossa vo", usemich leh: "uva letziyyon goel".

Veamar rabbi yochanan: en ben david ba ella bedor shekkullo zakkay, o kullo chayyayv. bedor shekkullo zakkay – dichtiv: "veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz". bedor shekkullo chayyayv – dichtiv: "vayyar ki en ish vayyishtomem ki en mafgia", uchetiv: "lemaani eese".
Amar rabbi alekkesanderi: rabbi yehoshua ben levi rame, ketiv "beittah" uchetiv "achishenna". zachu – achishenna, lo zachu – beittah.

Amar rabbi alekkesanderi: rabbi yehoshua ben levi rame, ketiv: "vaaru im anane shemayya kevar enash ate", uchetiv: "ani verochev al chamor". zachu – im anane shemayya, lo zachu – ani verochev al chamor.
Amar leh shabbur malka lishmuel: amritu mashiach al chamra ate? eshaddar leh suseya barka deit li! amar leh: mi it lach bar chevar gavvne?

Rabbi yehoshua ben levi ashkach leeliyyahu dahava kae appitcha dimarta derabbi shimon ben yochay. amar leh: atena lealma deate? amar leh: im yirtze adon hazze. amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: shenayim raiti vekol shelosha shamati.

Amar leh: emat ate mashiach? amar leh: zil shayyleh ledideh. vehecha yatev? appitcha deromi. umay simaneh? yatev bene anye sovle cholaim, vechullan sharu veasyri bechad zimna, ihu share chad veasayr chad. amar: dilma mibbeena dela iakkav.

Azal legabbeh. amar leh: shalom alecha rabbi umori! amar leh: shalom alecha bar levay. amar leh: leemat ate mar? amar leh: hayyom. ata legabbe eliyyahu. amar leh: may amar lach? amar leh: shalom alecha bar levay. amar leh: avtechach lach velaavuch lealma deate. amar leh: shakkore ka shakkar bi, daamar li "hayyom atena" vela ata. amar leh: hachi amar lach: "hayyom im bekolo tishmau".
Shaalu talmidav et rabbi yose ben kisma: ematay ben david ba? amar: mityayre ani shemma tevakkeshu mimmenni ot. amru lo: en anu mevakkeshin mimmecha ot.

Amar lahem: lichsheyyippol hashshaar hazze, veyibbane, veyippol veyibbane, veyippol, veen maspikin livnoto ad shebben david ba. amru lo: rabbenu, ten lanu ot! amar lahem: velo kach amartem li sheen attem mevakkeshin mimmenni ot?
Amru lo: veaf al pi chen. amar lahem: im kach, yehafchu me mearat pamyays ledam. venehefchu ledam.
Bishat petirato, amar lahen: haamiku li aroni,
b: Sheen kol dekel vadekel shebbevavel, sheen sus shel parsiyyim nikshar bo, veen lach kol aron vearon shebbeeretz yisrael, sheen sus madi ochel bo teven.
Amar rav: en ben david ba ad shettitpashshet malchut harshaa al yisrael tisha chodashim, shenneemar: "lachen yittenem ad et yoleda yalada veyeter echav yeshuvun al bene yisrael".
Amar ulla: yete vela ichmineh. vechen amar [rabba]: yete vela ichmineh. rav yosef amar: yete veezke deetev betulla dechufita dachamareh.

Amar leh abbaye lerabba: may tama? illema mishshum chevlo shel mashiach? vehatanya: shaalu talmidav et rabbi elazar: ma yaase adam veyinnatzel mechevlo shel mashiach? yaasok betora uvigmilut chasadim. umar – ha tora veha gemilut chasadim!
Amar leh: shemma yigrom hachet, kidrabbi yaakov bar idi, derabbi yaakov bar idi rame: ketiv "vehinne anochi immach ushemarticha bechol asher telech", uchetiv "vayyira yaakov meod vayyetzer lo".
Shehaya mityayre shemma yigrom hachet, kidtanya: "ad yaavor ammecha Adonai" – zo bia rishona, "ad yaavor am zu kanit" – zo bia sheniyya.
Emor meatta: reuyim hayu yisrael laasot lahem nes bevia sheniyya kevia rishona, ella sheggaram hachet.

Vechen amar rabbi yochanan: yete vela ichmineh. amar leh resh lakish: may tama? illema mishshum dichtiv "kaasher yanus ish mippene haari ufegao haddov [uva habbayit] vesamach yado al hakkir uneshacho hannachash"? bo vearekka dugemato baolam hazze: bizman sheadam yotze lassade ufaga bo santar – dome kemi sheppaga bo ari. nichnas lair, paga bo gabbay – dome kemi sheppegao dov. nichnas leveto umatza banav uvenotav mutalin baraav – dome kemi shenneshacho nachash.
Ella mishshum dichtiv: "shaalu na ureu im yoled zachar maddua raiti chol gever yadav al chalatzav kayyoleda venehefchu chol panim leyerakon".

May "raiti kol gever"? amar rava bar yitzchak amar rav: mi shekkol gevura shello. umay "venehefchu chol panim leyerakon"? amar rabbi yochanan: pamalya shel mala ufamalya shel matta, beshaa sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu: hallalu maase yaday vehallalu maase yaday, heach aabbed ellu mippene ellu?
Amar rav pappa: hayeynu deamri inashe, rahet venafel tora, veazel veshade leh suseya beureyeh.

Amar rav giddel amar rav: atidin yisrael deachli shene mashiach. amar rav yosef: peshita! veella man achel lehu? chilak uvilak achli lehu? leappoke midderabbi hillel, deamar: en mashiach leyisrael, shekkevar achaluhu bime chizkiyya.
Amar rav: la ibberi alma ella ledavid. ushemuel amar: lemoshe. verabbi yochanan amar: lemashiach.

Ma shemo? deve rabbi shela amri: shilo shemo, shenneemar: "ad ki yavo shilo". deve rabbi yannay amri: yinnon shemo, shenneemar: "yehi shemo leolam lifne shemesh yinnon shemo". deve rabbi chanina amri: chanina shemo, shenneemar: "asher lo etten lachem chanina". veyesh omrim: menachem ben chizkiyya shemo, shenneemar: "ki rachak mimmenni menachem meshiv nafshi". verabbanan amri: chiuora deve rabbi shemo, shenneemar: "achen cholayenu hu nasa umachovenu sevalam vaanachnu chashavnuhu nagua mukke elohim umeunne".

Amar rav nachman: i min chayyayya hu, kegon ana, shenneemar: "vehaya addiro mimmennu umoshlo mikkirbo yatza". amar rav: i min chayyayya hu, kegon rabbenu hakkadosh. i min mitayya hu, kegon daniyyel ish chamudot.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehaamid lahem david acher, shenneemar: "veavdu et Adonai elohehem veet david malkam asher akim lahem". "hekim" lo neemar, ella "akim". amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: vehachtiv: "vedavid avdi nasi lahem leolam"? kegon kesar ufalge kesar.

Darash rabbi simlay: may dichtiv "hoy hammitavvim et yom Adonai lamma ze lachem yom Adonai hu choshech velo or"? mashal letarnegol vaatallef shehayu metzappin laor. amar leh tarnegol laatallef: ani metzappe laora sheora shelli hi, veatta lamma lecha ora?

a: Vehayeynu daamar leh hahu mina lerabbi avahu: ematay ate mashiach? amar leh: lechi chafe lehu chashocha lehanhu inashe. amar leh: melat ka layytat li? amar leh: kera ketiv, "ki hinne hachoshech yechasse eretz vaarafel leummim vealayich yizrach Adonai uchevodo alayich yerae".

Tanya: rabbi eliezer omer, yemot hammashiach arbaim shana, shenneemar "arbaim shana akut bedor". rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, shivim shana, shenneemar "vehaya bayyom hahu venishkachat tzor shivim shana kime melech echad". ezehu melech meyuchad? heve omer: ze mashiach.
Rabbi omer: shelosha dorot, shenneemar: "yiraucha im shamesh velifne yareach dor dorim". rabbi hillel omer: en lahem mashiach leyisrael, shekkevar achaluhu bime chizkiyya.

Amar rav yosef: shera leh mareh lerabbi hillel. chizkiyya emat hava? bevayit rishon! veillu zecharya ka mitnabbe bevayit sheni, veamar: "gili meod bat tziyyon harii bat yerushalim hinne malkech yavo lach tzaddik venosha hu ani verochev al chamor veal ayir ben atonot".
Tanya iddach: rabbi eliezer omer, yemot hammashiach arbaim shana. ketiv hacha: "vayannecha vayyarivecha vayyaachilcha", uchetiv hatam: "sammechenu kimot innitanu shenot rainu raa".
Rabbi dosa omer: arba meot shana. ketiv hacha: "vaavadum veinnu otam arba meot shana", uchetiv hatam: "sammechenu kimot innitanu".
Rabbi omer: shelosh meot veshishshim vechamesh shana, keminyan yemot hachamma, shenneemar: "ki yom nakam belibbi ushenat geulay baa".
May "yom nakam belibbi"? amar rabbi yochanan: lelibbi gilliti, leevarayy lo gilliti. rabbi shimon ben lakish amar: lelibbi gilliti, lemalache hashsharet lo gilliti.
Tane avimi bereh derabbi avahu: yemot hammashiach leyisrael shivat alafim shana, shenneemar: "umesos chatan al kalla ken yasis alayich elohecha".
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: yemot hammashiach kemiyyom shennivra haolam vead achshav, shenneemar: "kime hashshamayim al haaretz".
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: kime noach ad achshav, shenneemar: "ki me noach zot li asher nishbati".

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol hanneviim kullan lo nitnabbeu ella limot hammashiach, aval laolam habba – "ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha elohim yaase limchakke lo". ufeliga dishmuel, deamar shemuel: en ben haolam hazze limot hammashiach ella shibud malchiyyot bilvad.

Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol hanneviim lo nitnabbeu ella levaale teshuva, aval tzaddikim gemurim – "ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha". ufeliga derabbi avahu, deamar rabbi avahu amar rav: makom shebbaale teshuva omdin sham – tzaddikim enan omdin sham, shenneemar: "shalom shalom larachok velakkarov". beresha rachok vahadar karov. may "rachok" – rachok demeikkara. umay "karov" – karov demeikkara udehashta.
Verabbi yochanan amar: "larachok" – shehu rachok meavera, "karov" – shehu karov meavera venitrachek mimmenna.

Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol hanneviim kullan lo nitnabbeu ella lemassi bitto letalmid chacham, uleose perakmatya letalmid chacham, velimhanne talmid chacham minnechasav. aval talmide chachamim atzman – "ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha".

May "ayin lo raata"? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: ze yayin hameshummar baanavav mishsheshet yeme bereshit. resh lakish amar: ze eden, shello raata ayin meolam. veim tomar: adam hechan dar? baggan. veim tomar: gan hu eden? talmud lomar: "venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan".

Vehaomer: en tora min hashshamayim vechulei. tanu rabbanan: "ki devar Adonai baza umitzvato hefar hikkaret tikkaret" – ze haomer: en tora min hashshamayim. davar acher: "ki devar Adonai baza" – ze eppikoros.

Davar acher: "ki devar Adonai baza" – ze hamegalle panim battora. "veet mitzvato hefar" – ze hammefer berit basar. "hikkaret tikkaret" – "hikkaret" baolam hazze, "tikkaret" laolam habba. mikkan amar rabbi elazar hammodai: hamechallel et hakkodashim, vehamevazze et hammoadot, vehammefer berito shel avraham avinu, vehamegalle panim betora shello kahalacha, vehammalbin pene chavero barabbim, af al pi sheyyesh beyado tora umaasim tovim en lo chelek laolam habba.

Tanya iddach: "ki devar Adonai baza" – ze haomer en tora min hashshamayim. vaafillu amar kol hattora kullah min hashshamayim, chutz mippasuk ze shello amaro hakkadosh baruch hu ella moshe mippi atzmo – zehu "ki devar Adonai baza". vaafillu amar kol hattora kullah min hashshamayim, chutz middikduk ze, mikkal vachomer ze, miggezera shava zo – ze hu "ki devar Adonai baza".

Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: hallomed tora veeno melammedah – ze hu "devar Adonai baza". rabbi natan omer: kol mi sheeno mashgiach al hammishna. rabbi nehoray omer: kol sheefshar laasok battora veeno osek.

Rabbi yishmael omer: ze haoved avoda zara. may mashmaa? detana deve rabbi yishmael: "ki devar Adonai baza" – ze hamevazze dibbur shenneemar lo lemoshe missinay: "anochi Adonai elohecha", "lo yihye lecha elohim acherim vegomer".
Rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: kol hallomed tora veeno chozer aleha, dome leadam shezzorea veeno kotzer. rabbi yehoshua omer: kol hallomed tora umeshakkechah, dome leishsha sheyyoledet vekoveret.
Rabbi akiva omer:
b: Zammer bechol yom, zammer bechol yom. amar rav yitzchak bar avudimi: may kera? shenneemar: "nefesh amel amla lo ki achaf alav pihu". hu amel bimkom ze, vetorato omelet lo bemakom acher.

Amar rabbi elazar: kol adam leamal nivra, shenneemar "ki adam leamal yullad". eni yodea im laamal pe nivra im laamal melacha nivra. keshehu omer "ki achaf alav pihu", heve omer laamal pe nivra. vaadayin eni yodea im laamal tora im laamal sicha. keshehu omer "lo yamush sefer hattora hazze mippicha", heve omer laamal tora nivra. vehayeynu deamar rava: kullehu gufe derufetke ninhu. tuveh lidzache dehave derufetke deorayyta.
"Noef ishsha chasar lev". amar resh lakish: ze hallomed tora lifrakim, shenneemar "ki naim ki tishmerem bevitnecha yikkonu yachdav al sefatecha".
Tanu rabbanan: "vehannefesh asher taase beyad rama" – ze menashshe ben chizkiyya, shehaya yoshev vedoresh behaggadot shel dofi.

Amar: vechi lo haya lo lemoshe lichtov ella "vaachot lotan timna", "vetimna hayta filegesh leelifaz", "vayyelech reuven bime ketzir chittim vayyimtza dudaim bassade"? yatza bat kol veamra lo: "teshev beachicha tedabber beven immecha titten dofi. elle asita vehecherashti dimmita heyot ehye chamocha ochichacha veeercha leenecha".

Vealav meforash bakkabbala: "hoy moshche heavon bechavle hashshav vechaavot haagala chattaa". may "kaavot haagala"? amar rabbi assi: yetzer hara battechilla dome lechut shel kuveya, ulevassof dome laavot haagala.
Daatan ala, mihat, "achot lotan timna" may hi? timna bat melachim havay, dichtiv: "alluf lotan", "alluf timna", vechol alluf – malchuta bela taga hi.

Baaya leiggayyore. bata etzel avraham, yitzchak veyaakov, velo kibbeluha. halcha vehayta filegesh leelifaz ben esav. amra: mutav tehe shifcha leumma zo velo tehe gevira leumma acheret. nefak minna amalek, detzaarinhu leyisrael. may tama? dela ibbei lehu lerachoka.

"Vayyelech reuven bime ketzir chittim". amar rava berabbi yitzchak amar rav: mikkan letzaddikim sheen poshtin yedehen begazel. "vayyimtza dudaim bassade". may dudaim? amar rav: yavruche. levi amar: sigle. rabbi yonatan amar: seviske.
Amar rabbi alekkesanderi: kol haosek betora lishmah mesim shalom befamalya shel mala uvefamalya shel matta, shenneemar: "o yachazek bemauzzi yaase shalom li shalom yaase li".

Rav amar: keillu bana palterin shel mala veshel matta, shenneemar: "vaasim devaray beficha uvetzel yadi kissiticha lintoa shamayim velisod aretz". rabbi yochanan amar: af megen al kol haolam kullo, shenneemar: "uvetzel yadi kissiticha". velevi amar: af mekarev et haggeulla, shenneemar: "velemor letziyyon ammi atta".

Amar resh lakish: kol hamelammed et ben chavero tora, maale alav hakkatuv keillu asao, shenneemar: "veet hannefesh asher asu vecharan". rabbi elazar omer: keillu asaan ledivre tora, shenneemar: "ushemartem et divre habberit hazzot vaasitem otam". rava amar: keillu asao leatzmo, shenneemar: "vaasitem otam" – al tikre "otam" ella "attem".

Amar rabbi avahu: kol hameasse et chavero lidvar mitzva, maale alav hakkatuv keillu asaah, shenneemar: "umattecha asher hikkita bo et hayeor". vechi moshe hikkahu? vahalo aharon hikkahu! ella lomar lach: kol hameasse et chavero lidvar mitzva, maale alav hakkatuv keillu asaah.
Eppikoros: rav verabbi chanina amri tarvayyhu, ze hamevazze talmid chacham. rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi amri, ze hamevazze chavero bifne talmid chacham.

Bishlama leman deamar: hamevazze chavero bifne talmid chacham eppikoros have, mevazze talmid chacham atzmo – megalle panim battora shello kahalacha have. ella leman deamar: mevazze talmid chacham atzmo eppikoros have, megalle panim battora kegon may? kegon menashshe ben chizkiyya.
Veikka dematne la assefa: megalle panim battora. rav verabbi chanina amri: ze hamevazze talmid chacham. rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi amri: ze hamevazze et chavero bifne talmid chacham.

Bishlama leman deamar hamevazze talmid chacham atzmo – megalle panim battora have, mevazze chavero bifne talmid chacham – eppikoros have, ella leman deamar mevazze chavero bifne talmid chacham – megalle panim battora have, eppikoros kegon man? amar rav yosef: kegon hane deamri may ahano lan rabbanan? ledidhu karu, ledidhu tanu.

Amar leh abbaye: hay megalle panim battora name hu, dichtiv "im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti". amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: mehacha name shema minna, shenneemar "venasati lechol hammakom baavuram".

Ella, kegon deyatev kammeh rabbeh, venafla leh shemata beducheta achariti, veamar: hachi amrinan hatam, vela amar: hachi amar mar. rava amar: kegon hane deve binyamin asya, deamri: may ahano lan rabbanan meolam?

a: La shero lan orva, vela asaru lan yona.

Rava, ki havo mayyti terefta deve vinyamin kammeh, ki hava chaze ba tama lehettera, amar lehu: techezo deka sharena lechu orva. ki hava chaze la tama leissura, amar lehu: techezo deka asarna lechu yona.
Rav pappa amar: kegon deamar "hane rabbanan". rav pappa ishteli veamar: "kegon hane rabbanan", veittiv betaanita.

Levi bar shemuel verav huna bar chiyyay havo ka metakkeni mitpechot sifre deve rav yehuda. ki matu megillat ester amri: ha [megillat ester] la bae mitpachat. amar lehu: ki hay gavvna name michze ki afkeruta.

Rav nachman amar: ze hakkore rabbo bishmo, deamar rabbi yochanan: mippene ma neenash gechazi? mippene shekkara lerabbo bishmo, shenneemar: "vayyomer gechazi adoni hammelech zot haishsha veze benah asher hecheya elisha".

Yatev rabbi yirmeya kammeh derabbi zera, veyatev vekaamar: atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehotzi nachal mibbet kodshe hakkodashim, vealav kol mine megadim, shenneemar: "veal hannachal yaale al sefato mizze umizze kol etz maachol lo yibbol alehu velo yittom piryo lochodashav yevakker ki memav min hammikdash [hemma] yotzim vehaya firyo lemaachol vealehu litrufa". amar leh hahu sava: "yishar", vechen amar rabbi yochanan: "yishar". amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera: ki hay gavna michze afkeruta?

Amar leh: ha [hay] sayyoe ka mesayyay leh [lach]! ella i shemia lach ha, shemia lach: ki ha deyatev rabbi yochanan veka daresh: atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehavi avanim tovot umargaliyyot shehen sheloshim al sheloshim ammot, vechokek bahem eser berum esrim, umaamidan beshaare yerushalayim, shenneemar "vesamti kadchod shimshotayich ushearayich leavne ekdach vegomer". ligleg alav oto talmid, amar: hasheta keveata detziltzela la mashkechinan, kulle hay mashkechinan?

Leyamim hifliga sefinato bayyam. chazinhu lemalache hashsharet deka menasseri avanim tovot umargaliyyot. amar lehu: hane leman? amri: atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehaamidan beshaare yerushalayim. ki hadar ashkecheh lerabbi yochanan deyatev veka daresh. amar leh: rabbi, derosh ulecha nae lidrosh. keshem sheamarta kach raiti. amar lo: reka! im lo raita lo heemanta? melagleg al divre chachamim atta! yehav beh eneh vaasao gal shel atzamot.

Metivi: "vaolech etchem kommiyyut" – rabbi meir omer: matayim amma, kishte komot shel adam harishon. rabbi yehuda omer: mea amma, keneged hechol uchetalav, shenneemar: "asher banenu kintiim meguddalim binurehem benotenu chezaviyyot mechuttavot tavnit hechol vegomer".
Ki kaamar rabbi yochanan, lechavve deve zika.
May "vealehu litrufa"? rabbi yitzchak bar avudimi verav chisda: chad amar, lehattir pe shel mala; vechad amar, lehattir pe shel matta.

Ittemar name: chizkiyya amar lehattir pe illemin, bar kappara amar lehattir pe akarot, rabbi yochanan amar litrufa mammash. may litrufa? rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: letoar panim shel baale happe.
Daresh rabbi yehuda berabbi simon: kol hammashchir panav al divre tora baolam hazze, hakkadosh baruch hu mavhik zivav laolam habba, shenneemar: "marehu kallevanon bachur kaarazim".
Amar rabbi tanchum berabbi chanilay: kol hammariv atzmo al divre tora baolam hazze, hakkadosh baruch hu masbio laolam habba, shenneemar: "yirveyun middeshen betecha venachal adanecha tashkem".

Ki ata rav dimi amar: atid hakkadosh baruch hu litten lechol tzaddik vetzaddik melo omso, shenneemar: "baruch Adonai yom yom yaamas lanu hael yeshuatenu sela". amar leh abbaye: vechi efshar lomar ken? vahalo kevar neemar: "mi madad beshoolo mayim veshamayim bazzeret tikken"?

Amar: may tama la shechichat beaggadta? deamri bemareva mishshemeh derava bar mari: atid hakkadosh baruch hu litten lechol tzaddik vetzaddik shelosh meot vaasara olamot, shenneemar: "lehanechil ohavay yesh veotzrotehem amalle". "yesh" begimatriyya telat mea veasra have.
Tanya: rabbi meir omer, bemidda sheadam moded – moddin lo, dichtiv: "besassea beshallechah terivenna".

Amar rabbi yehoshua: vechi efshar lomar ken? adam noten melo omso leani baolam hazze, hakkadosh baruch hu noten lo melo omso laolam habba? vehachtiv "shamayim bazzeret tikken"! veatta i omer ken? ezo hi midda merubba: midda tova merubba o middat pureanut?
b: Heve omer: midda tova merubba mimmiddat pureanut. bemidda tova ketiv: "vaytzav shechakim mimmaal vedalte shamayim patach vayyamter alehem man leechol", uvemiddat pureanut hu omer: "vaarubbot hashshamayim niftachu".

Bemiddat pureanut ketiv: "veyatzu verau befigre haanashim happoshim bi ki tolatam lo tamut veishsham lo tichbe vehayu deraon lechol basar". vahalo adam moshit etzbao baur baolam hazze – miyyad nichve! ella, keshem shennoten hakkadosh baruch hu koach barshaim lekabbel pureanutam, kach noten hakkadosh baruch hu koach batztzaddikim lekabbel tovatan.

Rabbi akiva omer: af hakkore bassefarim hachitzonim vechulei. tana: besifre minim. rav yosef amar: besefer ben sira name asur lemikre. amar leh abbaye: may tama? illema mishshum dichtiv [beh]: la tintosh gildana meudeneh, dela lezil mashcheh lachavala, ella tzeli yateh benura veechol beh tarten geritzim.
I mippeshateh, beorayyta name ketiv: "lo tashchit et etzah". i midderasha, orach ara ka mashma lan, dela livol shello kedarkah.

Veella, mishshum dichtiv: "bat leaviha matmonet shav, mippachdah lo yishan ballayla: bekatnutah – shemma titpatte, benaarutah – shemma tizne, bagra – shemma lo tinnase, nisset – shemma lo yihyu lah banim, hizkina – shemma taase keshafim". ha rabbanan name amruha: i efshar leolam belo zecharim uvelo nekevot. ashre mi shebbanav zecharim, oy lo lemi shebbanav nekevot.

Ella, mishshum dichtiv: "la tael devaya belibbach, degavre gibbarin ketal devaya". ha shelomo amra: "deaga velev ish yashchenna". rabbi amme verabbi assi – chad amar: yassichenna middato, vechad amar: yesichenna laacherim.

Veella, mishshum dichtiv: "mena rabbim mittoch betecha, velo hakkol tavi el betecha"? veha rabbi name amra, detanya: rabbi omer: leolam lo yarbe adam reim betoch beto, shenneemar: "ish reim lehitroea".

Ella, mishshum dichtiv: "zaldekan – kuretman, avdekan – sichsan, denafach bechaseh – la tzache, amar 'bemay echol lachma – lachma sav minneh, man deit leh mabarta bedikneh – kulle alma la yachli leh".

Amar rav yosef: mille meallayyta deit beh, darshinan lehu. "ishsha tova – mattana tova, bechek yere elohim tinnaten. ishsha raa – tzaraat levalah". may takkanteh? "yegarshenna mibbeto veyitrappe mitztzarato. ishsha yafa – ashre balah, mispar yamav kiflayim".

"Haelem enecha meeshet chen, pen tillached bimtzudatah. al tet etzel balah limsoch immo yayin veshechar, ki betoar ishsha yafa rabbim hushechatu, vaatzumim kol harugeha. rabbim hayu pitze rochel hammargilim lidvar erva. kenitzotz mavir gachelet, kichluv male of, ken battehem meleim mirma. mena rabbim mittoch betecha, velo hakkol tavi betecha. rabbim yihyu dorshe shelomecha, galle sodcha leechad mealef. mishshochevet chekecha shemor pitche ficha. al tetzar tzarat machar, ki lo teda ma yeled yom. shemma lemachar enennu, venimtza mitztaer al olam sheeno shello".
"Kol yeme ani raim". ben sira omer: "af lelot. bishfal gaggim gaggo, uvimrom harim karmo. mimmetar gaggim legaggo, umeafar karmo lichramim".
[Siman: zera, rava, mesharsheya, chanina toviyya, yannay yafe, yochanan merachem, yehoshua mekatztzer].
Amar rabbi zera amar rav: may dichtiv "kol yeme ani raim" – ellu baale talmud, "vetov lev mishte tamid" – ellu baale mishna.
Rava amar ippecha, vehayeynu deamar rav mesharsheya mishshemeh derava: may dichtiv "massia avanim yeatzev bahem"? ellu baale mishna. "uvokea etzim yissachen bam"? ellu baale talmud.

Rabbi chanina omer: "kol yeme ani raim" – ze mi sheyyesh lo ishsha raa. "vetov lev mishte tamid" – ze sheyyesh lo ishsha tova. rabbi yannay omer: "kol yeme ani raim" – ze istenis. "vetov lev mishte tamid" – ze sheddato yafa. rabbi yochanan amar: "kol yeme ani raim" – ze rachmani. "vetov lev mishte tamid" – ze achzari. rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: "kol yeme ani raim" – ze

a: Sheddato ketzara. "vetov lev mishte tamid" – ze sheddato rechava. veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: "kol yeme ani raim". vehaikka shabbatot veyamim tovim? kedishmuel, deamar shemuel: shinnuy veset techillat choli meayim.

Tanu rabbanan: hakkore pasuk shel shir hashshirim veose oto kemin zemer, vehakkore pasuk bevet mishtaot belo zemanno – mevi raa laolam, mippene shehattora chogeret sak veomedet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu veomeret lefanav: ribbono shel olam, asauni banecha kechinnor shemmenaggenin bo letzim.

Amar lah: bitti, beshaa sheochlin veshotin bamme yitasseku? amra lefanav: ribbono shel olam, im baale mikra hen – yaasku battora uvanneviim uvakketuvim. im baale mishna hen – yaasku bammishna, bahalachot uvehaggadot. veim baale talmud hen – yaasku behilchot pesach bappesach, behilchot atzeret baatzeret, behilchot chag bechag. heid rabbi shimon ben elazar mishshum rabbi shimon ben chananya: kol hakkore pasuk bizmanno mevi tova laolam, shenneemar: "vedavar beitto ma tov".

Vehallochesh al hammakka vechulei. amar rabbi yochanan: uverokek bah, lefi sheen mazkirin shem shamayim al harkika. ittemar: rav amar, afillu "nega tzaraat". rabbi chanina amar: afillu "vayyikra el moshe".
