Tanu rabbanan: sachin umemashmeshin bivne meayim beshabbat, velochashin lechishat nechashim veakrabbim beshabbat, umaavirin keli al gav haayin beshabbat. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: bamme devarim amurim? bichli hannittal, aval bichli sheeno nittal – asur. veen shoalin bidvar shedim beshabbat. rabbi yose omer: af bachol asur.
Amar rav huna: (en) halacha kerabbi yose. veaf rabbi yose lo amarah ella mishshum sakkana, ki ha derav yitzchak bar yosef deibbela bearza, veitavid leh nissa – peka arza ufalteh.

Tanu rabbanan: sachin umemashmeshin bivne meayim beshabbat, uvilvad shello yaase kederech shehu ose bachol. hechi aved? rabbi chama berabbi chanina amar: sach veachar kach memashmesh. rabbi yochanan amar: sach umemashmesh bevat achat.

Tanu rabbanan: sare shemen vesare vetzim muttarin lishol bahen, ella mippene shemmechazzevin. lochashin al shemen shebbichli, veen lochashin al shemen shebbayyad. lefichach sachin mishshemen shebbayyad, veen sachin mishshemen shebbichli.

Rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta ikkela lehahu ushepiza. ayyti leh mishcha bemana. shaf, nefaku leh tzimche beappeh. nefak leshuka. chazeteh hahi itteta, amara: zika dechemet ka chazena hacha. avada leh milleta veittassi.

Amar leh rabbi abba lerabba bar mari: ketiv "kol hammachala asher samti vemitzrayim lo asim alecha ki ani Adonai rofecha", vechi meachar shello sam, refua lamma? amar leh: hachi amar rabbi yochanan: mikra ze meatzmo nidrash, shenneemar "vayyomer im shamoa tishma lekol Adonai elohecha" – im tishma lo asim, veim lo tishma asim. af al pi chen, "ki ani Adonai rofecha".

Amar rabba bar bar chana: keshechala rabbi eliezer, nichnesu talmidav levakkero. amar lahen: chema azza yesh baolam. hitchilu hen bochin, verabbi akiva mesachek. amru lo: lamma atta mesachek? amar lahen: vechi mippene ma attem bochim? amru lo: efshar sefer tora sharuy betzaar velo nivke?

Amar lahen: lechach ani mesachek, kol zeman sheani roe rabbi sheen yeno machmitz veen pishtano loke veen shamno mavish veen duveshano madbish, amarti shemma chas veshalom kibbel rabbi olamo. veachshav sheani roe rabbi betzaar, ani sameach. amar lo: akiva, kelum chissarti min hattora kullah? amar lo: limmadtanu rabbenu, "ki adam en tzaddik baaretz asher yaase tov velo yecheta".
Tanu rabbanan: keshechala rabbi eliezer, nichnesu arbaa zekenim levakkero: rabbi tarfon, verabbi yehoshua, verabbi elazar ben azarya, verabbi akiva.
Naana rabbi tarfon veamar: tov atta leyisrael mittippa shel geshamim, shettippa shel geshamim baolam hazze, verabbi baolam hazze uvaolam habba.
Naana rabbi yehoshua veamar: tov atta leyisrael yoter miggalgal chamma, sheggalgal chamma baolam hazze, verabbi baolam hazze uvaolam habba.
Naana rabbi elazar ben azarya veamar: tov atta leyisrael yoter meav vaem, sheav vaem baolam hazze, verabbi baolam hazze uvaolam habba.

Naana rabbi akiva veamar: chavivin yissurin. amar lahem: sammechuni veeshmea divre akiva talmidi sheamar chavivin yissurin. amar lo: akiva, zo minnayin lach? amar: mikra ani doresh: "ben shetem esre shana menashshe vemolcho vachamishshim vechamesh shana malach birushalaym [vegomer] vayyaas hara beene Adonai", uchetiv:
b: "Gam elle mishle shelomo asher hetiku anshe chizkiyya melech yehuda". vechi chizkiyya melech yehuda lechol haolam kullo limmed tora, velimnashshe beno lo limmed tora? ella, mikkol torach shettarach bo umikkol amal sheamel bo, lo heelahu lemutav ella yissurin, shenneemar: "vaydabber Adonai el menashshe veel ammo velo hikshivu. vayyave Adonai alehem et sare hatztzava asher lemelech ashshur vayyilkedu et menashshe bachochim vayyaasruhu banchushtayim vayyolichuhu bavela".

Uchetiv: "uchehatzer lo chilla et pene Adonai elohav vayyikkana meod millifne elohe avotav. vayyitpallel elav vayyeater lo vayyishma techinnato vayshivehu yerushalaym lemalchuto vayyeda menashshe ki Adonai hu haelohim". ha lamadta shechavivin yissurin.

Tanu rabbanan: shelosha bau baalila, ellu hen: kayin, esav umenashshe. kayin, dichtiv: "gadol avoni minneso". amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, kelum gadol avoni mishshishshim ribbo sheatidin lachto lefanecha veatta soleach lahem? esav, dichtiv: "haveracha achat hi lach avi". menashshe – battechilla kara leelohot harebe, ulevassof kara lelohe avotav.
Abba shaul omer: af hahoge et hashshem beotiyyotav vechulei. tana: uvaggevulin, uvilshon aga.

Shelosha melachim vearbaa hedyotot vechulei. tanu rabbanan: yarovam – sheribbea am. davar acher: yarovam – sheasa meriva baam. davar acher: yarovam – sheasa meriva ben yisrael laavihem shebbashshamayim. ben nevat – ben shennibbat velo raa.
Tanna: hu nevat, hu micha, hu sheva ben bichri. nevat – shennibbat velo raa. micha – shennitmachmech bevinyan. uma shemo? sheva ben bichri shemo.
Tanu rabbanan: shelosha nibbetu velo rau, veellu hen – nevat, vaachitofel, veitztagnine paro.
Nevat raa esh sheyyotzet meammato. hu savar ihu malech, vela hi. yarovam hu dinfak minneh.
Achitofel raa tzaraat shezzarcha lo al ammato. hu savar ihu malech, vela hi. bat sheva bitto hu dinfak minna shelomo.

Itztagnine paro, deamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: may dichtiv "hemma me meriva"? hemma sherau itztagnine paro vetau. rau shemmoshian shel yisrael bemayim hu loke, amar: "kol habben hayyillod hayeora tashlichuhu". vehen lo yadu sheal iske me meriva loke.
Umena lan dela ate lealma deate? dichtiv: "vayhi baddavar hazze lechattat bet yarovam ulehachchid ulehashmid meal pene haadama". "lehachechid" – baolam hazze, "ulehashmid" – laolam habba.

Amar rabbi yochanan: mippene ma zacha yarovam lammalchut? mippene shehochiach et shelomo. umippene ma neenash? mippene shehochicho barabbim, shenneemar: "veze haddavar asher herim yad bammelech shelomo bana et hammillo sagar et peretz ir david aviv". amar lo: david avicha paratz peratzot bachoma kede sheyyaalu yisrael laregel, veatta gadarta otam kede laasot angarya levat paro.

Umay "veze asher herim yad bammelech"? amar rav nachman: shechalatz tefillav befanav. amar rav nachman: gassut haruach shehaya bo beyarovam teradattu min haolam, shenneemar: "vayyomer yarovam belibbo atta tashuv hammamlacha levet david. im yaale haam hazze laasot zevachim bevet Adonai birushalaym veshav lev haam hazze el adonehem el rechavam melech yehuda vaharaguni veshavu el rechavam melech yehuda".

Amar: gemiri deen yeshiva baazara ella lemalche bet yehuda bilvad. kevan dechazu leh lirchavam deyatev vaana kaemna, savri: ha malka veha avda. vei yatevna, mored bammalchut hu, vekatlin li veazlu batreh. miyyad "vayyivvaatz hammelech vayyaas shene egle zahav vayyomer alehem rav lachem mealot yerushalaym hinne elohecha yisrael asher heelucha meeretz mitzrayim vayyasem et haechad bevet el veet haechad natan bedan".

May "vayyivvaatz"? amar rabbi yehuda: shehoshiv rasha etzel tzaddik. amar lehu: chatmitu al kol deavedna? amaru leh: hin. amar lehu: malka baena lemihve. amaru leh: hin. kol deamena lechu avedtu? amaru leh: hin. afillu lemiflach laavoda zara? amar leh tzaddik: chas vechalila! amar leh rasha letzaddik: salka datach degavra keyarovam palach laavoda zara? ella lemensinhu hu deka bae, i kabbelitu lememreh.

a: Veaf achiyya hashshiloni taa vechatam, deha yehu tzaddika rabba hava, shenneemar: "vayyomer Adonai el yehu yaan asher hetivota laasot hayyashar beenay kechol asher bilvavi asita levet achav bene reviim yeshvu lecha al kisse yisrael", uchetiv: "veyehu lo shamar lalechet betorat Adonai elohe yisrael bechol levavo lo sar meal chattovt yarovam asher hecheti et yisrael".
May gerama leh? amar abbaye: berit keruta lassefatayim, shenneemar "achav avad et habbaal meat yehu yaavdennu harebe". rava amar: chotamo shel achiyya hashshiloni raa, vetaa.

Dichtiv: "veshachata setim hemiku vaani musar lechullam". amar rabbi yochanan: amar hakkadosh baruch hu, hem haamiku mishshelli. ani amarti: kol sheeno ole laregel over baase, vehem amru: kol haole laregel yiddaker bacherev.
"Vayhi baet hahi veyarovam yatza mirushalaym vayyimtza oto achiyya hashshiloni hannavi badderech vehu mitkasse besalma chadasha". tana mishshum rabbi yose: et hi mezummenet lefureanut.

"Beet pekuddatam yovedu", tana mishshum rabbi yose: et mezummenet lefureanut. "beet ratzon aniticha", tana mishshum rabbi yose: et mezummenet letova. "uveyom pokdi ufakadti alehem chattatam", tana mishshum rabbi yose: et hi mezummenet lefureanut. "vayhi baet hahi vayyered yehuda meet echav", tana mishshum rabbi yose: et mezummenet lefureanut.

"Vayyelech rechavam shechem ki shechem ba chol yisrael lehamelich oto". tana mishshum rabbi yose: makom mezumman lefureanut. bishchem innu et dina, bishchem machru echav et yosef, bishchem nechleka malchut bet david.
"Veyarovam yatza mirushalayim", amar rabbi chanina bar pappa: sheyyatza mippitkah shel yerushalayim.

"Vayyimtza oto achiyya hashshiloni hannavi badderech vehu mitkasse besalma chadasha ushenehem levaddam bassade". may "besalma chadasha"? amar rav nachman: kesalma chadasha. ma salma chadasha en bah shum dofi – af torato shel yarovam lo haya bah shum dofi. davar acher: "salma chadasha" – shechiddeshu devarim shello shama ozen meolam.
May "ushenehem levaddam bassade"? amar rav yehuda amar rav: shekkol talmide chachamim domin lifnehem keisve hassade. veikka deamar: shekkol taame tora megullin lahem kassade.

"Lachen titteni shilluchim al moreshet gat batte achziv leachzav lemalche yisrael". amar rabbi chanina bar pappa: yatza bat kol veamra lahen, mi sheharag et happelishti vehorish etchem gat, tittenu shilluchim levanav? "batte achziv leachzav lemalche yisrael".

Amar rabbi chanina bar pappa: kol hannehene min haolam hazze belo beracha, keillu gozel lehakkadosh baruch hu ucheneset yisrael, shenneemar: "gozel aviv veimmo veomer en pasha chaver hu leish mashchit". veen aviv ella hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: "halo hu avicha kanecha". veen immo ella keneset yisrael, shenneemar: "shema beni musar avicha veal tittosh torat immecha".
May "chaver hu leish mashchit"? chaver hu leyarovam ben nevat, shehishchit yisrael laavihem shebbashshamayim.
"Veyaddach yarovam (ben nevat) et yisrael meachare Adonai vehechetiam chataa gedola". amar rabbi chanin: "kishte maklot hammattizot zo et zo".

"Vedi zahav". amru deve rabbi yannay, amar moshe lifne hakkadosh baruch hu, ribbono shel olam, bishvil kesef vezahav shehishpata lahen leyisrael ad sheyyomru 'dayy, garam lahem laasot lahem elohe zahav. mashal: en ari dores venohem mittoch kuppa shel teven, ella mittoch kuppa shel basar.

Amar rabbi oshaya: ad yarovam hayu yisrael yonkim meegel echad, mikkan veelach mishshenayim ushelosha agalim. amar rabbi yitzchak: en lach kol pureanut ufureanut shebbaa leolam sheen bah echad meesrim vearbaa behechrea litra shel egel harishon, shenneemar: "uveyom pokdi ufakadti alehem chattotam".
Amar rabbi chanina: leachar esrim vearbaa dorot nigba pasuk ze, shenneemar: "vayyikra veoznay kol gadol lemor karvu pekuddot hair veish keli mashcheto beyado".

"Achar haddavar hazze lo shav yarovam middarko haraa". may "achar"? amar rabbi abba: achar shettefaso hakkadosh baruch hu leyarovam bevigdo, veamar lo: chazor becha, vaani veatta uven yishay netayyel began eden. amar lo: mi barosh? ben yishay barosh. i hachi, la baena.
Rabbi avahu hava regil dahava ka daresh bishlosha melachim. chalash, kabbel aleh dela daresh. kevan
b: Deittefach, hadar ka daresh. amri: la kabbelt alach dela darshat behu? amar: inhu mi hadaru behu, daana ehdar bi?
Rav ashe oke ashshelosha melachim. amar: limchar niftach bechavrin. ata menashshe, itchazi leh bechelmeh. amar: chaverach vachavere daavuch karet lan?

Mehecha baet lemishre hammotzi? amar leh: la yadana. amar leh: mehecha devaet lemishre hammotzi la gemirat, vachaverach karet lan? amar leh: agmereh li, velimchar dareshna leh mishshemach befirka. amar leh: mehecha dekarem bishshula.

Amar leh: meachar dechakkimat kulle hay, may tama ka palchitu laavoda zara? amar leh: i havet hatam, havet naketat beshippule gelima verahatat abbatray. limchar amar lehu lerabbanan: niftach berabbevota.
Achav: ach lashshamayim, av laavoda zara. ach lashshamayim, dichtiv: "ach letzara yivvaled". av laavoda zara, dichtiv: "kerachem av al banim".

"Vayhi hanakel lechto bechattovt yarovam ben nevat". amar rabbi yochanan: kallot sheasa achav – kachamurot sheasa yarovam. umippene ma tala hakkatuv beyarovam? mippene shehu haya techilla lakkalkala. "gam mizbechotam kegallim al talme saday". amar rabbi yochanan: en lach kol telem vatelem beeretz yisrael shello heemid alav achav avoda zara vehishtachava lah.
Umena lan dela ate lealma deate? dichtiv: "vehichratti leachav mashtin bekir veatzur veazuv beyisrael". "atzur" – baolam hazze, "veazuv" – laolam habba.

Amar rabbi yochanan: mippene ma zacha omri lammalchut? mippene shehosif kerach echad beeretz yisrael, shenneemar: "vayyiken et hahar shomron meet shemer bechikkerayim kasef vayyiven et hahar vayyikra [et] shem hair asher bana al shem shemer adone hahar shomron".
Amar rabbi yochanan: mippene ma zacha achav lammalchut esrim ushetayim shana?

Mippene shekkibbed et hattora, shennittena beesrim ushetayim otiyyot, shenneemar: "vayyishlach malachim el achav melech yisrael haira. vayyomer lo ko amar ben hadad kaspecha uzehavcha li hu venashecha uvanecha hattovim li hem". "ki im kaet machar eshlach et avaday elecha vechippesu et betcha veet batte avadecha vehaya kol machmad enecha yasimu veyadam velakachu". "vayyomer lemalache ven hadad imru ladoni hammelech kol asher shalachta el avdecha varishona eese vehaddavar hazze lo uchal laasot".
May "machmad enecha"? lav sefer tora?

Dilma avoda zara? la salka datach, dichtiv: "vayyomru elav kol hazzekenim vechol haam lo tove velo tishma". vedilma save devahata havo? mi la ketiv: "vayyishar haddavar beene avshalom uveene kol zikne yisrael"? veamar rav yosef: save devahata.

Hatam la ketiv "vechol haam", hacha ketiv "vechol haam", dei efshar dela havo behon tzaddike. uchetiv: "vehisharti veyisrael shivat alafim kol habbirkayim asher lo charu labbaal vechol happe asher lo nashak lo".

Amar rav nachman: achav shakul haya, shenneemar: "vayyomer Adonai mi yefatte et achav veyaal veyippol beramot gilad vayyomer ze becho veze omer becho". matkef la rabbi yosef: man dichtiv beh "rak lo haya cheachav asher hitmakker laasot hara beene Adonai asher hesatta oto izevel ishto", utenena: bechol yom hayta shokelet shikle zahav laavoda zara, veat amrat shakul haya?! ella, achav vavtran bemamono haya, umittoch shehehena talmide chachamim minnechasav kipperu lo mechetza.

"Vayyetze haruach vayyaamod lifne Adonai vayyomer ani afattennu vayyomer Adonai elav bamma. vayyomer etze vehayiti ruach sheker befi kol neviav vayyomer tefatte vegam tuchol tze vaase chen". may ruach? amar rabbi yochanan: rucho shel navot hayyizreeli.
May "tze"? amar ravina: "tze mimmechitzati", shekken ketiv: "dover shekarim lo yikkon leneged enay". amar rav pappa: hayeynu deamri inashe: defara kinneh machrev beteh.

"Vayyaas achav et haashera vayyosef achav laasot lehacheis et Adonai elohe yisrael mikkol malche yisrael asher hayu lefanav". amar rabbi yochanan: shekkatav al daltot shomron achav kafar belohe yisrael, lefichach en lo chelek belohe yisrael.
"Vayvakkesh et achazyahu vayyilkeduhu vehu mitchabbe veshomron". amar rabbi levi: shehaya koder azkarot, vechotev avoda zara tachtehen.

Menashshe – shennasha yah. davar acher: menashshe – shehinshi et yisrael laavihem shebbashshamayim. umenalan dela ate lealma deate? dichtiv: "ben shetem esre shana menashshe vemolcho vachamishshim vechamesh shana malach birushalaym vayyaas ashera kaasher asa achav melech yisrael". ma achav en lo chelek laolam habba, af menashshe en lo chelek laolam habba.

Rabbi yehuda omer: menashshe yesh lo chelek laolam habba, shenneemar: "vayyitpallel menashshe el Adonai vayyeater lo vegomer". amar rabbi yochanan: ushenehem mikra echad darshu, shenneemar: "unetattim lezaava lechol mamlechot haaretz biglal menashshe ven yechizkiyyahu". mar savar: biglal menashshe sheasa teshuva veinhu la avud, umar savar:

a: Biglal menashshe, dela avad teshuva.

Amar rabbi yochanan: kol haomer menashshe en lo chelek laolam habba merappe yedehen shel baale teshuva. detane tanna kammeh derabbi yochanan: menashshe asa teshuva (lishloshim) [sheloshim] veshalosh shanim, dichtiv: "ben shetem esre shana menashshe vemolcho vachamishshim vechamesh shana malach birushalaym vayyaas (hara) [ashera] vechulei kaasher asa achav melech yisrael". kamma malach achav? esrin vetarten shenin. menashshe kamma malach? chamishshim vechamesh. dal minnayyhu esrim vetarten, pashu lehu telatin utelat.

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: may dichtiv "vayyishma elav vayyechater lo"? "vayyeater lo" mibbee leh! melammed sheasa lo hakkadosh baruch hu kemin machteret barakia, kede lekabbelo bitshuva, mippene middat haddin.
Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: may dichtiv "bereshit mamlechet yehoyakim ben yoshiyyahu", uchetiv "bereshit mamlechet tzidkiyya"? vechi ad haiddana la havo malche?
Ella, bikkesh hakkadosh baruch hu lehachezir et haolam kullo letohu vavohu bishvil yehoyakim. nistakkel bedoro, venitkarra dato.

Bikkesh hakkadosh baruch hu lehachezir et haolam kullo letohu vavohu bishvil doro shel tzidkiyya. nistakkel betzidkiyya venitkarra dato. betzidkiyya name ketiv: "vayyaas hara beene Adonai". shehaya beyado limchot velo micha.

Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: may dichtiv "ish chacham nishpat et ish evil veragaz vesachak veen nachat"? amar hakkadosh baruch hu: kaasti al achaz unetattiv beyad malche dammesek, zibbach vekitter [lelohehem], shenneemar: "vayyizbach lelohe darmesek hammakkim bo vayyomer [ki] elohe malche aram hem mazerim otam lahem azabbeach veyazeruni vehem hayu [lo] lehacheshilo ulechol yisrael".

Sachakti im amatzya venatatti malche edom beyado. hevi elohehem vehishtachava lahem, shenneemar: "vayhi achare vo amatzyahu mehakkot et adomim vayyave et elohe bene seir vayyaamidem [lo] lelohim velifnehem yishtachave velahem yekatter". amar rav pappa: hayeynu deamri inashe, bechayy leh lemar vela yada, chayaychi lemar vela yada, vavy leh lemar dela yada ben tav levish.

"Vayyavou kol [sare] melech bavel (vayyavou) [vayyeshvu] beshaar hattavech". amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: makom shemmechattechin bo halachot. amar rav pappa: hayeynu deamri inashe, beatra demareh tela leh zeyayneh, tamman kuleba raaya kulleteh tela.
Siman: al sede, (vattim) [kittim], lo teunne.

Amar rav chisda amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba: may dichtiv "al sede ish atzel avarti veal kerem adam chasar lev vehinne ala chullo kimmesonim kossu fanav charullim vegeder avanav neherasa"? "al sede ish atzel avarti" – ze achaz, "veal kerem adam chasar lev" – ze menashshe, "vehinne ala chullo kimmesonim" – ze amon, "kossu fanav charullim" – ze yehoyakim, "vegeder avanav neherasa" – ze tzidkiyyahu shennechrav bet hammikdash beyamav.

Veamar rav chisda amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba: arba kittot en mekabbelot pene shechina: kat letzim, kat shakranim, kat chanefim, kat mesappere lashon hara. kat letzim – dichtiv: "mashach yado et lotztzim". kat shakranim – dichtiv: "dover shekarim lo yikkon leneged enay". kat chanefim – dichtiv: "ki lo lefanav chanef yavo". kat mesappere lashon hara – dichtiv: "ki lo el chafetz resha atta lo yegurcha ra", tzaddik atta velo yihye bimgurecha ra.

Veamar rav chisda amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba: may dichtiv "lo teunne elecha raa venega lo yikrav beoholecha"? "lo teunne elecha raa" – shello yishlot bahen yetzer hara, "venega lo yikrav beoholecha" – shello timtza ishtecha sefek nidda beshaa shettavo min hadderech.

Davar acher: "lo teunne elecha raa" – shello yevaatucha chalomot raim vehirhurim raim. "venega lo yikrav beoholecha" – shello yehe lecha ben o talmid shemmakdiach tavshilo barabbim, kegon yeshu hannotzri.
Ad kan bercho aviv, mikkan veelach berchattu immo. "ki malachav yetzavve lach lishmorcha bechol derachecha. al kappayim yissaunecha vegomer. al shachal vafeten tidroch vegomer".
Ad kan berchattu immo, mikkan veelach berchattu shamayim.
b: "Ki vi chashak vaafalletehu asaggevehu ki yada shemi. yikraeni veeenehu immo anochi vetzara achalletzehu vaachabbedehu. orech yamim asbiehu vearehu bishuati".
Amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: may dichtiv "veyimmana mershaim oram uzeroa rama tishshaver"? mippene ma ayin shel reshaim teluya? kevan shennaase adam rash millematta, naase rash millemala.
Vela nichtevay kelal? rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar: chad amar, mippene kevodo shel david; vechad amar, mishshum kevodo shel nechemya ben chachalya.
Tanu rabbanan: menashshe haya shone chamishshim vachamishsha panim betorat kohanim, keneged shene malchuto. achav – shemonim vachamishsha, yarovam – mea ushelosha.

Tanya: haya rabbi meir omer, avshalom en lo chelek laolam habba, shenneemar "vayyakku et avshalom vaymituhu". "vayyakkuhu" – beolam hazze, "vaymituhu" – laolam habba. tanya: rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum rabbi meir, achaz vaachazya vechol malche yisrael shekkatuv bahen "vayyaas hara beene Adonai" – lo chayyin velo niddonin.

"Vegam dam naki shafach menashshe harebe meod ad asher mille et yerushalaym pe lafe levad mechattato asher hecheti et yehuda laasot hara beene Adonai". hacha targimu: sheharag yeshaya. bemareva amri: sheasa tzelem massooy elef bene adam, uvechol yom vayom horeg (et) kullam. keman azla ha deamar rabba bar bar chana: shekula neshama shel tzaddik echad keneged kol haolam kullo? keman deamar yeshaya harag.
Ketiv "pesel", uchetiv "pesilim". amar rabbi yochanan: battechilla asa lo partzuf echad, ulevassof asa lo arbaa partzufim, kede shettire shechina vetichos.

Achaz heemido baaliyyay, shenneemar: "veet hammizbechot asher al haggag aliyyat achaz vegomer". menashshe heemido bahechol, shenneemar: "vayyasem et pesel haashera asher asa babbayit asher amar Adonai el david veel shelomo [veno] babbayit hazze uvirushalaym asher bacharti mikkol shivte yisrael asim et shemi leolam". amon hichniso levet kodshe hakkodashim, shenneemar: "ki katzar hammatztza mehistarea vehammassecha tzara kehitkannes".

May "ki katzar hammatztza mehistarea"? amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: [ki] katzar hammatztza ze millehistarer alav shene reim keechad. may "vehammassecha tzara vegomer"? amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani: rabbi yonatan ki hava mate lehay kera hava ka vache, mi shekkatav bo "kones kanned me hayyam" tease lo massecha tzara?

[Achaz bittel et haavoda], vechatam et hattora, shenneemar: "tzor teuda chatom tora belimmuday". menashshe kadar et haazkarot, veharas et hammizbeach. amon saraf et hattora, veheela semamit al gabbe hammizbeach. achaz hittir et haerva. menashshe ba al achoto.

Amon ba al immo, shenneemar: "ki hu amon hirba ashma". rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar, chad amar: shessaraf et hattora, vechad amar: shebba al immo. amra lo immo: kelum yesh lecha hanaa mimmakom sheyyatzata mimmennu? amar lah: kelum ani ose ella lehacheis et bori.

Ki ata yehoyakim amar: kammae la yadi leargoze, kelum anu tzerichin ella leoro? yesh lanu zehav parvayim sheanu mishtammeshin bo, yittol oro. amru lo: vahalo kesef vezahav shello hu, shenneemar: "li hakkesef veli hazzahav neum Adonai tzevaot"? amar lahem: kevar netano lanu, shenneemar: "hashshamayim shamayim laAdonai vehaaretz natan livne adam".

Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari: mippene ma lo manu et yehoyakim? mishshum dichtiv beh: "veyeter divre yehoyakim vetoavotav asher asa vehannimtza alav". may "vehannimtza alav"? rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar – chad amar: shechakak shem avoda zara al ammato, vechad amar: shechakak shem shamayim al ammato.
Amar leh: bimlachim lo shamati, behedyotot shamati. mippene ma lo manu et micha? mippene sheppitto metzuya leovre derachim, shenneemar: "kol haover veshav el haleviyyim".

"Veavar bayyam tzara vehikka vayyam gallim". amar rabbi yochanan: ze pislo shel micha. tanya, rabbi natan omer: miggarev leshilo shelosha milin, vehaya ashan hammaaracha vaashan pesel micha mitarvin ze baze.

Bikkeshu malache hashsharet ledochfo. amar lahen hakkadosh baruch hu: hannichu lo, sheppitto metzuya leovre derachim. veal davar ze neneshu anshe pilegesh baggiva. amar lahen hakkadosh baruch hu: bichvodi lo mechitem, al kevodo shel basar vadam mechitem!

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose ben kisma: gedola legima, shehirchika shete mishpachot miyyisrael, shenneemar: "al devar asher lo kiddemu etchem ballechem uvammayim". verabbi yochanan dideh amar: meracheket et hakkerovim, umekarevet et harchokim, umaalemet enayim min harshaim, umashra shechina al nevie habbaal, veshiggato ola zadon.
Meracheket et hakkerovim –

a: Meammon umoav.

Umekarevet et harchokim – miyyitro, deamar rabbi yochanan: bischar "kiren lo veyochal lachem", zachu bene vanav veyashvu belishkat haggazit, shenneemar: "umishpechot sofrim yoshve yabetz tiratim shimatim suchatim hemma hakkinim habbaim mechammat avi vet rechav", uchetiv hatam: "uvene keni choten moshe alu meir hattemarim et bene yehuda midbar yehuda asher benegev arad vayyelech vayyeshev et haam".
Umaalemet enayim min harshaim – mimmicha.
Umashra shechina al nevie habbaal – mechavero shel iddo hannavi, dichtiv: "vayhi hem yoshvim el hashshulchan vayhi devar Adonai el hannavi asher heshivo".

Veshiggatah ola zadon, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: ilmale hilvavhu yehonatan ledavid shete kikkerot lechem, lo neherga nov ir hakkohanim, velo nitrad doeg haadomi, velo neherag shaul usheloshet banav.

Umippene ma lo manu et achaz? amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba: mippene shemmutal ben shene tzaddikim, ben yotam lechizkiyyahu. rav yosef amar: mippene shehaya lo boshet panim mishayahu, shenneemar: "vayyomer Adonai el yeshayahu tze na likrat achaz atta ushear yashuv benecha el ketze tealat habberecha haelyona el mesillat sede choves". may "koves"? ikka deamri: dechavshinhu leappeh vachalaf, veikka deamri: uchela dekatztzare sechaf aresheh vachalaf.

Mippene ma lo manu et amon? mippene kevodo shel yoshiyyahu. menashshe name la nimne mippene kevodo shel chizkiyyahu? bera mezakke abba, abba la mezakke bera. dichtiv: "veen miyyadi matztzil". en avraham matztzil et yishmael, en yitzchak matztzil et esav. hasheta deatet lehachi, achaz name la immeni mishshum kevodo shel chizkiyyahu.

Umippene ma lo manu et yehoyakim? mishshum derabbi chiyyay berabbi avuya, deamar rabbi chiyyay berabbi avuya: ketiv al gulegolto [shel] yehoyakim "zot veod acheret". zekeno derabbi perida ashkach gulegulta dahava ka shadya beshaare yerushalayim, uchetiv bah "zot veod acheret". kavra vela ikkevara, kavra vela ikkevara.

Amar: gulegolto shel yehoyakim hi, dichtiv beh "kevurat chamor yikkaver sachov vehashelech vegomer". amar: malka hu, vela ifshar lezalzole beh. karcha beshirae veotva besifta. chazeta devethu, sevara: ha deitteta kammayyta hava, deha la ka minneshe la. shegara tannura vekalta. hayeynu dichtiv: "zot veod acheret".

Tanya, amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: bishvil "vehattov beenecha asiti" – "ma ot". bishvil "ma ot" – goyim achlu al shulechano. bishvil sheggoyim achlu al shulechano – garam galut levanav. mesayyay leh lechizkiyya, deamar chizkiyya: kol hamezammen goy letoch beto umeshammesh alav gorem galut levanav, shenneemar: "umibbanecha asher yetzu mimmecha [asher tolid] yikkachu vehayu sarisim behechal melech bavel".

"Vayyismach alehem chizkiyyahu vayyarem et bet nechoto et hakkesef veet hazzahav veet habbesamim veet hashshemen hattov vegomer". amar rav: may "bet nechoto"? ishto hishketa alehem. ushemuel amar: bet genazav hera lahem. verabbi yochanan amar: zayin ochel zayin hera lahen.
"Echa yashva badad". amar rava amar rabbi yochanan: mippene ma laku yisrael beecha? mippene sheavru al sheloshim vashesh karetot shebbattora.
Amar rabbi yochanan: mippene ma laku bealef bet? mippene sheavru al hattora shennittena bealef bet.

"Yashva badad". amar rava amar rabbi yochanan: amar hakkadosh baruch hu, ani amarti "vayyishkon yisrael betach badad en yaakov el eretz dagan vetirosh af shamav yaarfu tal", achshav yihye badad moshavam. "hair rabbati am", amar rava amar rabbi yochanan: shehayu massiin ketanna legadol ugedola lekatan, kede sheyyehu lahem banim harebe.

"Hayta kealmana" – amar rav yehuda amar rav: kealmana, velo almana mammash, ella keishsha shehalach balah limdinat hayyam vedato lachazor eleha. "rabbati vaggoyim sarati bammedinot" – amar rava amar rabbi yochanan: kol makom shehen holchin, naasin sarim laadonehen.
Tanu rabbanan: maase bishne bene adam shennishbu behar hakkarmel, vehaya shabbay mehallech acharehem.
b: Amar lo echad mehem lachavero: gamal shemhallechet lefanenu soma beachat meeneha, uteuna shete nodot, achat shel yayin veachat shel shemen, ushene bene adam hammanhigim otah, echad yisrael veechad goy. amar lahen [shabbay]: am keshe oref! meen attem yodin?

Amru lo: gamal measavim shellefaneha, mitztzad sheroa ochelet, mitztzad sheenah roa enah ochelet. uteuna shete nodot, achat shel yayin veachat shel shemen; shel yayin metaftef veshokea, veshel shemen metaftef vetzaf. ushene bene adam hammanhigim otah, echad goy veechad yisrael; goy nifne ladderech, veyisrael nifne litzdadin.

Radaf acharehem umatza kedivrehem. ba uneshakan al roshan, vehevian leveto veasa lahen seuda gedola. vehaya merakked lifnehem veamar: baruch shebbachar bezaro shel avraham venatan lahem mechochmato, uvechol makom shehen holchin naasin sarim laadonehem. ufetaran [vehalchu] levattehem leshalom.

"Bacho tivke ballayla" – shete bechiyyot hallalu lamma? amar rabba amar rabbi yochanan: echad al mikdash rishon veechad al mikdash sheni. "ballayla" – al iske layla, shenneemar: "vattissa kol haeda vayyittenu et kolam vayyivku haam ballayla hahu".
Amar rabba amar rabbi yochanan: oto hayyom lel tisha beav haya. amar lahen hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael: attem bechitem bechiyya shel chinnam, vaani ekba lachem bechiyya ledorot.

Davar acher: "ballayla" – shekkol habboche ballayla, kolo nishma. davar acher: "ballayla" – shekkol habboche ballayla, kochavim umazzalot bochin immo. davar acher: "ballayla" – shekkol habboche ballayla, hashshomea kolo boche kenegdo. maase beishsha achat, shechento shel rabban gamliel, shemmet benah vehayta bocha alav ballayla. shama rabban gamliel kolah uvacha kenegdah, ad shennashru rise enav. lemachar hikkiru bo talmidav vehotziuha mishshechunato.

"Vedimatah al lecheyah", amar rava amar rabbi yochanan: keishsha shebbocha al baal neureha, shenneemar "eli kivtula chagurat sak al baal neureha". "hayu tzareha lerosh", amar rava amar rabbi yochanan: kol hammetzer leyisrael naasa rosh, shenneemar "ki lo muaf laasher mutzak lah kaet harishon hekal artza zevulun veartza naftali vehaacharon hichbid derech hayyam ever hayyarden gelil haggoyim". amar rava amar rabbi yochanan: kol hammetzik leyisrael eno ayef.

"Lo alechem kol ovre derech", amar rava amar rabbi yochanan: mikkan lekuvelana min hattora. "kol ovre derech", amar rav amram amar rav: asauni keovre al dat. deillu bisdom ketiv: "vaAdonai himtir al sedom", veillu birushalayim ketiv: "mimmarom shalach esh beatzmotay vayyirdenna vegomer". uchetiv: "vayyigdal avon bat ammi mechattat sedom".

Vechi masso panim yesh baddavar? amar rava amar rabbi yochanan: midda yetera hayta birushalayim shello hayta bisdom, deillu bisdom ketiv: "hinne ze haya avon sedom achotech gaon sivat lechem veyad ani veevyon lo hechezika vegomer", veillu birushalayim ketiv: "yede nashim rachamaniyyot bishshelu yaldehen".
"Silla chol abbiray Adonai bekirbi", keadam sheomer lachavero: nifsela matbea zo.
"Patzu alayich pihem" – amar rava amar rabbi yochanan: bishvil ma hikdim pe leayin? bishvil meraggelim sheamru befihem ma shello rau beenehem.

"Ochle ammi achlu lechem Adonai lo karau". amar rava amar rabbi yochanan: kol haochel millachman shel yisrael toem taam lechem, vesheeno ochel millachman shel yisrael eno toem taam lechem. "Adonai lo karau" – rav amar: ellu haddayyaynin, ushemuel amar: ellu melammede tinokot.

Mi menaan? amar rav ashe: anshe keneset haggedola menaum. amar rav yehuda amar rav: bikkeshu od limnot echad. baa demut deyokno shel aviv venishtattecha lifnehem, velo hishgichu aleha. baa esh min hashshamayim velichacha (esh) besafselehem, velo hishgichu aleha.

Yatza bat kol veamra lahem: "chazita ish mahir bimlachto lifne melachim yityatztzav bal yityatztzev lifne chashukkim". mi shehikdim beti leveto, velo od ella shebbeti bana besheva shanim uveto bana bishlosh esre shana. "lifne melachim yityatztzav [bal yityatztzev] lifne chashukkim". velo hishgiach aleha. yatza bat kol veamra: "hameimmecha yeshalmenna ki maasta ki atta tivchar velo ani vegomer".

Dorshe reshumot hayu omrim: kullan bain laolam habba, shenneemar: "li gilad veli menashshe veefrayim maoz roshi yehuda mechokki. moav sir rachtzi al edom ashlich naali alay peleshet hitroai". "li gilad (veli menashshe)" – ze achav shennafal beramot gilad. "menashshe" – kemashmao. "efrayim maoz roshi" – ze yarovam dekaate meefrayim. "yehuda mechokki" – ze achitofel

a: Dekaate mihuda. "moav sir rachtzi" – ze gechazi, shellaka al iske rechitza. "al edom ashlich naali" – ze doeg haadomi. "alay peleshet hitroai" – amru malache hashsharet lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, im yavo david sheharag et happelishti vehorish et banecha gat, ma atta ose lo? amar lahen: alay laasotan reim ze laze.

"Maddua shovva haam hazze yerushalaym meshuva nitztzachat vegomer". amar rav: teshuva nitztzachat heshiva keneset yisrael lannavi. amar lahen navi leyisrael: chizru bitshuva! avotechem shechatu hechan hem? amru lo: uneviechem shello chatu hechan hem? shenneemar: "avotechem ayye hem vehanneviim haleolam yichyu". amar lahen: (avotechem) chazru vehodu, shenneemar: "ach devaray vechukkay asher tzivviti et avaday hanneviim vegomer".

Shemuel amar: "bau asara bene adam veyashvu lefanav. amar lahen: chizru bitshuva! amru lo: eved shemmecharo rabbo, veishsha sheggershah balah, kelum yesh laze al ze kelum? amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lannavi: lech emor lahen: "e ze sefer keritut immechem asher shillachtiha o mi minnoshay asher macharti etchem lo hen baavonotechem nimkartem uvefishechem shullecha immechem".

Vehayeynu deamar resh lakish: may dichtiv "david avdi", "nevuchadnetztzar avdi"? galuy veyadua lifne mi sheamar vehaya haolam sheatidin yisrael lomar kach, lefichach hikdim hakkadosh baruch hu ukerao avdo. eved shekkana nechasim – eved lemi? nechasim lemi?

"Vehaola al ruchachem hayo lo tihye asher attem omrim nihye chaggoyim kemishpechot haaratzot lesharet etz vaaven. chay ani neum Adonai elohim im lo beyad chazaka uvizroa netuya uvechema shefucha emloch alechem". amar rav nachman: kol ki hay ritcha lirtach rachmana alan velifrokinan.

"Veyissero lammishpat elohav yorennu" – amar rabba bar bar chana: amar lahen navi leyisrael: chizru bitshuva! amru lo: en anu yecholin, yetzer hara sholet banu. amar lahem: yasseru yitzrechem! amru lo: "elohav yorennu".
Arbaa hedyotot: bilam, vedoeg, vaachitofel, vegechazi. bilam – belo am. davar acher: bilam – shebbilla am. ben beor – shebba al beir.

Tana: hu beor, hu kushan rishatayim, hu lavan haarammi. beor – shebba al beir. kushan rishatayim – daavad shete rishayot beyisrael: achat bime yaakov, veachat bime shefot hashshoftim. uma shemo? lavan haarammi shemo.
Ketiv: "ben beor", uchetiv: "beno veor". amar rabbi yochanan: aviv beno hu lo binviut.
Bilam hu dela ate lealma deate, ha acharine atu. matnitin manni?

Rabbi yehoshua hi, detanya: rabbi eliezer omer, "yashuvu reshaim lishola kol goyim shecheche elohim". "yashuvu reshaim lishola" – ellu poshe yisrael, "kol goyim shecheche elohim" – ellu poshe goyim, divre rabbi eliezer. amar lo rabbi yehoshua: vechi neemar "bechol goyim"? vahalo lo neemar ella "kol goyim shecheche elohim"! ella "yashuvu reshaim lishola" – man ninhu? "kol goyim shecheche elohim".
Veaf oto rasha natan siman beatzmo. amar: "tamot nafshi mot yesharim". im tamot nafshi mot yesharim – "tehe achariti kamohu", veim lav – "hinni holech leammi".

"Vayyelchu zikne moav vezikne midyan". tana: midyan umoav lo haya lahem shalom meolam. mashal lishne kelavim shehayu baeder, vehayu tzehubbin ze laze. ba zeev al haechad. amar haechad: im eni ozro, hayyom horeg oto, ulemachar ba alay. halchu shenehem vehargu hazzeev. amar rav pappa: hayeynu deamri inashe: karkusheta veshunnara avadu hillula mittarba devish gadda.
"Vayyeshvu sare moav im bilam". vesare midyan lehechan azul? kevan daamar lehu: "linu fo hallayla vahashivoti etchem davar", amru: kelum yesh av shessone et beno?

Amar rav nachman: chutzepa afillu kelappe shemayya mahane. meikkara ketiv: "lo telech immahem", ulevassof ketiv: "kum lech ittam". amar rav sheshet: chutzepa malchuta bela taga hi, dichtiv: "veanochi hayyom rach umashuach melech vehaanashim haelle bene tzeruya kashim mimmenni vegomer".

Amar rabbi yochanan: bilam chigger beraglo achat haya, shenneemar: "vayyelech shefi". shimshon bishte raglav, shenneemar: "shefifon ale orach hannoshech ikkeve sus". bilam some beachat meenav haya, shenneemar: "shetum haayin".

Kosem beammato haya. ketiv hacha: "nofel ugeluy enayim", uchetiv hatam: "vehaman nofel al hammitta vegomer". ittemar, mar zutera amar: kosem beammato haya. mar bereh deravina amar: shebba al atono. man deamar kosem beammato haya – kedaamaran, uman deamar ba al atono haya – ketiv hacha: "kara shachav", uchetiv hatam: "ben ragleha
b: Kara nafal shachav vegomer".
"Veyodea daat elyon". hasheta daat behemto la hava yada, daat elyon hava yada? may daat behemto? deamri leh: may tama la rachvat suseya? amar lehu: sheday leho birtiva.
Amara leh: "halo anochi atoncha"! litina bealma. "asher rachavta alay"! akray bealma. "meodcha ad hayyom hazze"!
Velo od, ella sheani osa [lecha] maase ishut ballayla. ketiv hacha: "hahasken hiskanti", uchetiv hatam: "vattehi lo sochenet".
Ella may "veyodea daat elyon"? shehaya yodea lechavvevn otah shaa shehakkadosh baruch hu koes bah.

Vehayeynu dekaamar lehu navi leyisrael: "ammi zechar na ma yaatz balak melech moav ume ana oto bilam ben beor min hashshittim ad haggilgal lemaan daat tzidkot Adonai". may "lemaan daat tzidkot Adonai"? amar lahen hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael: deu na kamma tzedakot asiti immachem, shello kaasti kol otan hayyamim bime bilam harasha, sheilmale kaasti kol otan hayyamim lo nishtayyer missonehen shel yisrael sarid ufalit.

Hayeynu dekaamar leh bilam levalak: "ma ekkov lo kabbo el vegomer" (otan hayyom [hayyamim] lo zaam Adonai). "el zoem bechol yom", vechamma zamo? rega, shenneemar: "ki rega beappo chayyim birtzono vegomer".

Ibbaet ema: "lech ammi bo vachadarecha usegor delatcha baadecha chavi chimat rega ad yaavor zaam". emat ratach? bitlat shae kammayayta, ki chavvra karbalta detarnegola. kol shata veshata name chavvra! kol shata veshata it beh sureyake summake, hahi shata let beh sureyake summake.

Hahu mina dahava beshivavuteh derabbi yehoshua ben levi, dahava ka metzaar leh. yoma chad nekat tarnugela, vaasar leh bechareh, veotev. amar: ki meta hahu shata – elteyeh. ki meta hahu shata, namnem. amar: shema minna lav orach ara, dichtiv "gam anosh latztzaddik lo tov". afillu bemine la ibbei leh lememar hachi.
Tana mishshemeh derabbi meir: beshaa shehachamma zorachat, vehammelachim mannichin kitrehen al rashehen umishtachavim lachamma, miyyad koes.

"Vayyakom bilam babboker vayyachavosh et atono". tana mishshum rabbi shimon ben elazar: ahava mevattelet shura shel gedulla meavraham, dichtiv: "vayyashkem avraham babboker". sina mevattelet shura shel gedulla mibbilam, shenneemar: "vayyakom bilam babboker vayyachavosh et atono".

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: leolam yaasok adam betora uvemitzva, afillu shello lishmah, shemmittoch shello lishmah ba lishmah. shebbischar arbaim ushetayim korbanot shehikriv balak, zacha veyatza mimmennu rut. amar rabbi yose bar huna: rut bitto shel eglon, ben beno shel balak melech moav hayta.
Amar leh rava lerabba bar mari: ketiv "yetev elohim et shem shelomo mishshemecha vigaddel [et] kiso mikkisecha". orach ara lememra leh lemalka hachi? amar leh: meen kaamra leh.

Dei la tema hachi, "tevorach minnashim yael eshet chever hakkeni minnashim baohel tevorach". nashim baohel man ninhu? sara, rivka, rachel, velea. orach ara lememar hachi? ella meen kaamar. hachi name, meen kaamar.

Ufeliga derav yose bar choni, deamar rav yose bar choni: bakkol adam mitkanne, chutz mibbeno vetalmido. beno – mishshelomo, vetalmido – ibbaet ema: "vihi na pi shenayim beruchacha elay", veibbaet ema: "vayyismoch et yadav alav vaytzavvehu".
"Vayyasem davar befi bilam", rabbi elazar omer – malach, rabbi yonatan amar – chakka.

Amar rabbi yochanan: mibbirchato shel oto rasha atta lamed ma haya belibbo. bikkesh lomar shello yehu lahem batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot – "ma tovu ohalecha yaakov". lo tishre shechina alehem – "umishkenotecha yisrael". lo tehe malchutan nimshechet – "kinchalim nittayu". lo yehe lahem zetim ucheramim – "kegannot ale nahar". lo yehe rechan nodef – "kaahalim nata Adonai".

Lo yihyu lahem melachim baale koma – "kaarazim ale mayim". lo yihye lahem melech ben melech – "yizzal mayim middalyav". lo tehe malchutan sholetet baummot – "vezaro bemayim rabbim". lo tehe azza malchutan – "veyarom meagag malko". lo tehe emat malchutan – "vetinnasse malchuto".

Amar rabbi abba bar kahana: kullam chazru liklala, chutz mibbatte chenesiyyot umibbatte midrashot, shenneemar: "vayyahafoch Adonai elohecha lecha et hakkelala livracha ki ahevcha Adonai elohecha". kelala, velo kelalot.

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: may dichtiv "neemanim pitze ohev venatarot neshikot sone"? tova kelala shekkillel achiyya hashshiloni et yisrael yoter mibberacha shebbercham bilam harasha. achiyya hashshiloni killel et yisrael bekane, shenneemar: "vehikka Adonai et yisrael kaasher yanud hakkane bammayim vegomer". ma kane ze omed bimkom mayim, vegizo

a: Machlif, veshorashav merubbin. vaafillu kol ruchot shebbaolam baot venoshvot bo, en mezizot oto mimmekomo, ella hu holech uva immahen. kevan sheddommu haruchot, amad kane bimkomo.

Aval bilam harasha berchan beerez. ma erez ze? eno omed bimkom mayim, veshorashav muatin, veen gizo machlif. afillu kol haruchot shebbaolam baot venoshvot bo, en mezizot oto mimmekomo. kevan shennashva bo ruach deromit, miyyad okarto vehofachto al panav. velo od, ella shezzacha kane littol mimmennu kulemos lichtov mimmennu sifre tora, neviim uchetuvim.
"Vayyar et hakkeni vayyissa meshalo". amar lo bilam leyitro: keni, lo hayita immanu beotah etza? mi hoshivcha etzel etane olam?

Vehayeynu deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi simay: shelosha hayu beotah etza, ellu hen: bilam, iyyov veyitro. bilam sheyyaatz – neherag, iyyov sheshshatak – niddon beyissurin, veyitro shebbarach – zachu bene vanav leshev belishkat haggazit, shenneemar: "umishpechot sofrim yoshve yabetz tiratim shimatim suchatim hemma hakkinim habbaim mechammat avi vet rechav", uchetiv: "uvene keni choten moshe alu meir hattemarim".

"Vayyissa meshalo vayyomar oy mi yichye missumo el". amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: oy mi shemmechayye atzmo beshem el. amar rabbi yochanan: oy lah laumma shettimmatze beshaa shehakkadosh baruch hu ose pidyon levanav. mi metil kesuto ben lavi lilvia beshaa shennizkakin ze im ze?
"Vetzim miyyad kittim", amar rav: libbon aspir. "veinnu ashshur veinnu ever" – ad ashshur katli miktal, mikkan veelach meshabedi shaybode.
"Hinni holech leammi lecha iatzcha asher yaase haam hazze leammecha". "ammecha leam hazze" mibbee leh! amar rabbi abba bar kahana: keadam shemmekallel et atzmo vetole killato baacherim.

Amar lahem: elohehem shel ellu sone zimma hu, vehem mitavvim lichle fishtan. bo veassiacha etza: ase lahen kelaim, vehoshev bahen zonot, zekena mibbachutz veyalda mibbifnim, veyimkeru lahen kele fishtan.

Asa lahen kelaim mehar sheleg ad bet hayeshimot, vehoshiv bahen zonot, zekena mibbachutz veyalda mibbifnim. uveshaa sheyyisrael ochlin veshotin usemechin veyotzin letayyel beshuk, omeret lo hazzekena: i atta mevakkesh kele fishtan? zekena omeret lo beshave, veyalda omeret lo befachot, shetayim veshalosh peamim.

Veachar kach omeret lo: hare at keven bayit, shev beror leatzmecha. vetzartzuroy shel yayin ammoni munnach etzlah, vaadayin lo neesar yayin shel ammoni velo yayin shel goyim. amra lo: retzonecha shettishte kos shel yayin? kevan sheshshata, baar bo.

Amar lah: hishshamei li. hotzia yiratah mittoch chekah, amra lo: avod laze! amar lah: halo yehudi ani? amra lo: uma ichpat lecha? kelum mevakkeshim mimmecha ella piur? [vehu eno yodea sheavodatah bechach]. velo od ella sheeni mannachtecha ad shettichpor betorat moshe rabbecha, shenneemar: "hemma bau baal peor vayyinnazru labboshet vayyihyu shikkutzim keohovam".
"Vayyeshev yisrael bashshittim". rabbi eliezer omer: shittim shemah. rabbi yehoshua omer: shennitasku bedivre shetut.
"Vattikrena laam lezivche elohehen", rabbi eliezer omer: arummot pagu bahen. rabbi yehoshua omer: shennaasu kullan baale kerayin.
May leshon "refidim"? rabbi eliezer omer: refidim shemah. rabbi yehoshua omer: sherippu atzman middivre tora, shenneemar: "lo hifnu avot el banim merifyon yadayim".

Amar rabbi yochanan: kol makom shenneemar "vayyeshev" eno ella leshon tzaar, shenneemar: "vayyeshev yisrael bashshittim vayyachel haam liznot el benot moav". "vayyeshev yaakov beeretz megure aviv beeretz kenaan", "vayyave yosef et dibbatam raa el avihem". veneemar: "vayyeshev yisrael beeretz goshen", "vayyikrevu yeme yisrael lamut". "vayyeshev yehuda veyisrael lavetach ish tachat gafno vetachat teenato", "vayyakem Adonai satan lishlomo et hadad haadomi mizzera hammelech hu beedom".

"Veet malche midyan hargu al challehem vegomer veet bilam ben beor hargu becharev". bilam may bae hatam? amar rabbi yochanan: shehalach littol sechar esrim vearbaa elef [shehippil miyyisrael]. amar mar zutera bar toviyya amar rav, hayeynu deamri inashe: gamla azala lemive karne, udene dahavo leh gezizan minneh.
"Veet bilam ben beor hakkosem". kosem? navi hu! amar rabbi yochanan: battechilla navi, ulevassof kosem. amar rav pappa hayeynu deamri inashe: missegane veshilti havay, iyyayzan legavre naggare.
b: "Hargu vene yisrael [bacherev] el challehem", amar rav: shekkiyyeymu bo arba mitot – sekila, userefa, hereg, vachenek.

Amar leh hahu mina lerabbi chanina: mi shemia lach bilam bar kamma hava? amar leh: michtav la ketiv, ella middichtiv "anshe damim umirma lo yechetzu yemehem", bar telatin utelat shenin o bar telatin vearba. amar leh: shappir kaamrat, ledidi chaze li pinkaseh devilam, vahava ketiv beh: bar telatin utelat shenin bilam chagira kad katel yateh pinchas listaa.
Amar leh mar bereh deravina livreh: bechullehu la tappesh lemidrash, levar mibbilam harasha, dechamma demashkachat beh derosh beh.
Ketiv "doeg", uchetiv "doyeg". amar rabbi yochanan: battechilla yoshev hakkadosh baruch hu vedoeg, shemma yetze ze letarbut raa. leachar sheyyatza, amar: vavy sheyyatza ze!
(Siman: gibbor, rasha, vetzaddik, chayil, vesofer).

Amar rabbi yitzchak, may dichtiv: "ma tithallel beraa haggibbor chesed el kol hayyom"? amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu ledoeg: lo gibbor battora atta? ma tithallel beraa? lo chesed el natuy alecha kol hayyom?

Veamar rabbi yitzchak: may dichtiv "velarasha amar elohim ma lecha lesapper chukkay"? amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu ledoeg harasha: ma lecha lesapper chukkay? kesheatta maggia lefarashat meratztzechim ufarashat mesappere lashon hara, ma atta doresh bahem? "vattissa veriti ale ficha". amar rabbi amme: en torato shel doeg ella missafa velachutz.
Veamar rabbi yitzchak: may dichtiv "veyiru tzaddikim veyirau vealav yischaku"? battechilla yirau, ulevassof yischaku.

Veamar rabbi yitzchak: may dichtiv "chayil bala vaykiennu mibbitno yorishennu el"? amar david lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, yamut doeg! amar lo: "chayil bala vaykiennu". amar lefanav: "mibbitno yorishennu el"!

Veamar rabbi yitzchak: may dichtiv "gam el yittotzcha lanetzach"? amar hakkadosh baruch hu ledavid: nete doeg lealma deate. amar lefanav: "gam el yittotzcha lanetzach". may dichtiv "yachtecha veyissachacha meohel veshereshcha meeretz chayyim sela"? amar hakkadosh baruch hu: lemru shemata be midresha mishshemeh. amar lefanav: "yachtecha veyissachacha meohel". leheve leh benin rabbanan: "veshereshcha meeretz chayyim sela".

Veamar rabbi yitzchak, may dichtiv: "ayye sofer ayye shokel ayye sofer et hammigdalim"? "ayye sofer" – kol otiyyot shebbattora, "ayye shokel" – sheshshokel kol kallim vachamurim shebbattora, "ayye sofer et hammigdalim" – shehaya sofer shelosh meot halachot pesukot bemigdal happoreach baavir.

Amar rabbi: arba mea baye beo doeg vaachitofel bemigdal happoreach baavir, (vela ippeshat lehu chad). amar rava: revuta lemive baye? bishne derav yehuda kulle tannoye binzikin, vaanan ka matnenan tuva beuketzin!

Vechi hava mate rav yehuda "ishsha shekkoveshet yarak bikdera", veamri la "zetim shekkevashan betarfehen tehorim", amar: havayot derav ushemuel ka chazena hacha, vaanan ka matnenan beuketzin telat sere metivata!
Verav yehuda shalef mesane veate mitra, vaanan tzavchinan velekka demashgach ban. ella hakkadosh baruch hu libba bae, dichtiv: "vaAdonai yire lallevav".

Amar rav mesharsheya: doeg vaachitofel la [havo] savri shemata. matkef la mar zutera: man dichtiv beh "ayye sofer ayye shokel ayye sofer et hammigdalim", veat amrat la havo savri shemata?! ella dela hava salka lehu shemata allibba dehilcheta, dichtiv: "sod Adonai lireav".
Amar rabbi amme: lo met doeg ad sheshshachach talmudo, shenneemar: "hu yamut been musar uverov ivvalto yishge". rav ashe amar: nitztara, shenneemar: "hitzmatta kol zone mimmekka".
Ketiv hatam: "latztzemitut", umetargeminan: "lachalutin". utenan: en ben musegar umuchelat ella peria uferima.
(Siman: shelosha, rau, vechatzu, vekaru)
Amar rabbi yochanan: shelosha malache chabbala nizdammenu lo ledoeg, echad sheshshikkach talmudo, veechad shessaraf nishmato, veechad sheppizzer afaro bevatte chenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot.
Amar rabbi yochanan: doeg vaachitofel lo rau ze et ze. doeg bime shaul, vaachitofel bime david.

Veamar rabbi yochanan: doeg vaachitofel lo chatzu yemehem. tanya name hachi: "anshe damim umirma lo yechetzu yemehem". kol shenotav shel doeg lo hayu ella sheloshim vearba, veshel achitofel enan ella sheloshim veshalosh.

Veamar rabbi yochanan: battechilla kara david laachitofel rabbo, ulevassof kerao chavero, ulevassof kerao talmido. battechilla kerao rabbo – "veatta enosh keerki allufi umeyuddai". ulevassof kerao chavero – "asher yachdav namtik sod bevet elohim nehallech beragesh". ulevassof kerao talmido – "gam ish shelomi asher batachti vo

a: Ochel lachmi higdil alay akev".

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: leolam al yavi adam atzmo lide nissayon, shehare david melech yisrael hevi atzmo lide nissayon venichshal. amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, mippene ma omrim "elohe avraham, elohe yitzchak velohe yaakov", veen omrim "elohe david"? amar: inhu minnesu li veat la minnasset li. amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, bechaneni venasseni, shenneemar: "bechaneni Adonai venasseni vegomer".
Amar: meynassena lach, veavedna milleta bahadach, dildidhu la hodatinhu, veillu ana ka modana lach dimnassena lach bidvar erva. miyyad, "vayhi leet haerev vayyakom david meal mishkavo vegomer".
Amar rav yehuda: shehafach mishkavo shel layla lemishkavo shel yom, venitallema mimmennu halacha. ever katan yesh baadam, masbio – raev, umarivo – savea.

"Vayyithallech al gag bet hammelech vayyar ishsha rochetzet meal haggag vehaishsha tovat mare meod". bat sheva hava ka chayyfa resha tute challeta. ata satan, iddemi leh ketzipparta. petak beh gira, patka lechalleta, iggallay vechazyay.

Miyyad: "vayyishlach david vayyidrosh laishsha vayyomer halo zot bat sheva bat eliam eshet uriyya hachitti. vayyishlach david malachim vayyikkacheha vattavo elav vayyishkav immah vehi mitkaddeshet mittumatah vattashov el betah". vehayeynu dichtiv: "bachanta libbi pakadta layla tzeraftani val timtza zammoti bal yaavor pi". amar: ikko zemama nefal befummeh deman desane li, vela amar ki ha milleta!

Daresh rava: may dichtiv "lamnatztzeach ledavid baAdonai chasiti ech tomru lenafshi nudi harechem tzippor"? amar david lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, mechol li al oto avon shello yomru "har shebbachem tzippor niddedattu".

Daresh rava, may dichtiv: "lecha levaddecha chatati vehara beenecha asiti lemaan titzdak bedovrecha tizke veshoftecha"? amar david lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: galya vidia kammach, dei beay lemichpeyeh leyitzray hava kayefyna, ella amena dela lemru "avda zachye lemareh".

Daresh rava: may dichtiv "ki ani letzela nachon umachovi negdi tamid"? reuya hayta bat sheva bat eliam ledavid mishsheshet yeme bereshit, ella shebbat alav bemachov. vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael: reuya hayta ledavid bat sheva bat eliam, ella sheachalah pagga.

Daresh rava: may dichtiv, "uvetzali samchu veneesafu neesfu alay nechim [velo yadati] karu velo dammu"? amar david lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, galuy veyadua lefanecha sheim hayu korin besari lo haya dami shotet.

Velo od, ella beshaa shehem oskin bearba mitot bet din, poskin mimmishnatan veomrim li: david, habba al eshet ish mitato bamme? amarti lahem: habba al eshet ish mitato bechenek, veyesh lo chelek laolam habba. aval hammalbin pene chavero barabbim en lo chelek laolam habba.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: afillu bishat cholyo shel david kiyyem shemone esre onot, shenneemar: "yagati beanchati asche vechol layla mittati bedimati arsi amse". veamar rav yehuda amar rav: bikkesh david laavod avoda zara, shenneemar: "vayhi david ba ad harosh asher yishtachave sham lelohim", veen "rosh" ella avoda zara, shenneemar: "vehu tzalma resheh di dehav tav".

"Vehinne likrato chushay haarki karua kuttonto vaadama al rosho". amar lo ledavid: yomru melech shekkemotcha yaavod avoda zara? amar lo: melech shekkemoti yahargennu beno? mutav yaavod avoda zara veal yitchallel shem shamayim befarhesya.

Amar: may tama kansivat yefat toar? amar leh: yefat toar rachamana sharyay. amar leh: la darshat semuchin, dismich leh "ki yihye leish ben sorer umore"? kol hannose yefat toar yesh lo ben sorer umore.

Daresh rabbi dostay demin bere: lema david dome? lesocher kuti. amar david lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, "shegiot mi yavin"! [amar leh:] sheviki lach. "uminnistarot nakkeni"! sheviki lach. "gam mizzedim chasoch avdecha"! sheviki lach. "al yimshelu vi az etam", dela lishtao bi rabbanan. sheviki lach.

"Venikketi mippesha rav", shello yikkatev sirchoni. amar lo: i efshar. uma yod shennatalti missaray omed vetzoveach kamma shanim, ad shebba yehoshua vehosafti lo, shenneemar: "vayyikra moshe lehoshea bin nun yehoshua". kol happarasha kullah – al achat kamma vechamma!

"Venikketi mippesha rav". amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, mechol li al oto avon kullo! amar, kevar atid shelomo bincha lomar bechochmato: "hayachte ish esh becheko uvegadav lo tissarafna. im yehallech ish al haggechalim veraglav lo tikkavena. ken habba al eshet reehu lo yinnake kol hannogea bah". amar leh: kol hachi nitrad hahu gavra? amar lo: kabbel alecha yissurin. kibbel alav.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: shishsha chodashim nitztara david, venistalleka hemennu shechina, ufershu mimmennu sanhedrin. nitztara – dichtiv: "techatteeni veezov veethar techabbeseni umishsheleg albin". nistalleka hemennu shechina – dichtiv: "hashiva li seson yishecha veruach nediva tismecheni". ufershu mimmennu sanhedrin – dichtiv: "yashuvu li yereecha vegomer". shishsha chodashim menalan? dichtiv: "vehayyamim asher malach david al yisrael arbaim shana".
b: "Bechevron malach sheva shanim uvirushalaym malach sheloshim veshalosh shanim", uchetiv: "bechevron malach al yehuda sheva shanim veshishsha chodashim vegomer", vehane shishsha chodashim la kachashev. shema minna nitztara.

Amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, mechol li al oto avon! machul lach. "ase immi ot letova veyiru sonay veyevoshu ki atta Adonai azartani venichamtani". amar leh: bechayyecha eni modia, aval ani modia bechayye shelomo bincha.

Beshaa shebbana shelomo et bet hammikdash, bikkesh lehachenis aron levet kodshe hakkodashim. davku shearim ze baze. amar esrim vearbaa renanot velo naana. amar: "seu shearim rashechem vehinnasu pitche olam veyavo melech hakkavod. mi ze melech hakkavod Adonai izzuz vegibbor Adonai gibbor milchama". veneemar: "seu shearim rashechem useu pitche olam veyavo melech hakkavod vegomer", velo naana.

Kevan sheamar: "Adonai elohim al tashev pene meshichecha zachra lechasde david avdecha", miyyad naana. beotah shaa nehpechu pene sone david keshule kedera, veyadu kol yisrael shemmachal lo hakkadosh baruch hu al oto heavon.

Gechazi, dichtiv: "vayyelech elisha dammesek". lehecha azal? amar rabbi yochanan: shehalach lehachazir gechazi bitshuva, velo chazar. amar lo: chazor bach. amar lo: kach mekubbelani mimmecha: hachote umachti et harabbim en maspikin beyado laasot teshuva.
May avad? ikka deamri: even shoevet tala lechattat yarovam, veheemidah ben shamayim laaretz. veikka deamri: shem chakak befiha, vehayta machrezet veomeret "anochi" velo yihye lecha".
Veikka deamri: rabbanan decha mikkammeh, shenneemar: "vayyomru vene hanneviim el elisha hinne [na] hammakom asher anachnu yoshvim sham lefanecha tzar mimmennu", mikkelal dead hasheta la havo payyshi.
Tanu rabbanan: leolam tehe semol docha veyamin mekarevet, lo keelisha sheddechafo legechazi bishte yadayim, velo kihoshua ben perachya sheddechafo leyeshu hannotzri bishte yadayim.

Gechazi, dichtiv: "vayyomer naaman hoel vekach kikkarayim vayyifrotz bo vayyatzar kikkerayim kesef vegomer". "vayyomer elav elisha meayin gechazi vayyomer lo halach avdecha ane vaana. vayyomer elav lo libbi halach kaasher hafach ish meal merkavto likratecha haet lakachat et hakkesef velakachat begadim vezetim ucheramim vetzon uvakar vaavadim ushefachot". umi shekal kulle hay? kesef uvegadim hu dishkal!

Amar rabbi yitzchak: beotah shaa haya elisha yoshev vedoresh bishmona sheratzim. naaman sar tzeva melech aram haya metzora. amara leh hahi ravita deishtevay meara yisrael: i azlat legabbay elisha masse lach. ki ata, amar leh: zil tevol beyarden. amar leh: achoche ka mechayyeychat bi? amri leh hanhu dahavo bahadeh: may nafka lach minna? zil nassi. azal uteval beyardena veittassi. ata ayyti leh kol hane denaket. la tzeva lekabbole minneh. gechazi ippetar mikkammeh elisha, azal shekal may dishkal veafked.

Ki ata, chazyay elisha letzaraat dahava parcha illave resheh. amar leh: rasha! higgia et littol sechar shemona sheratzim. "vetzaraat naaman tidbak becha uvezaracha leolam vayyetze millefanav metzora kashshaleg". "vearbaa anashim hayu metzoraim petach hashshaar" – amar rabbi yochanan: gechazi usheloshet banav.

Yehoshua ben perachya may hi? kidkatlinhu yannay malka lerabbanan, azal yehoshua ben perachya veyeshu laalekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim. ki hava shelama, shelach leh shimon ben shatach: minni yerushalayim ir hakkodesh lichi alekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim, achoti: baali sharuy betochech veanochi yoshevet shomema.
Kam, ata, veitremi leh hahu ushepiza. avadu leh yekara tuva. amar: kamma yafa achsanya zo! amar leh: rabbi, eneha terutot. amar leh: rasha! bechach atta osek? appek arba mea shippure veshammeteh.

Ata lekammeh kamma zimnin, amar leh: kabbelan! la have ka mashgach beh. yoma chad hava ka kare keriat shema, ata lekammeh. savar lekabbole, achvi leh bideh. hu savar: midcha dache li. azal zekaf leventa vehishtachava lah. amar leh: hadar bach! amar leh: kach mekubbelani mimmecha: kol hachote umachti et harabbim en maspikin beyado laasot teshuva. veamar mar: yeshu kishshef vehesit vehiddiach et yisrael.
Tanya: amar rabbi shimon ben elazar, yetzer, tinok, veishsha – tehe semol docha veyamin mekarevet.
Tanu rabbanan: shelosha cholaim chala elisha – echad sheggera dubbim battinokot, veechad sheddechafo legechazi bishte yadayim, veechad shemmet bo, [shenneemar: "veelisha chala et cholyo vego"].

Ad avraham lo haya zikna. kol dechaze leavraham amar: hay yitzchak. kol dechaze leyitzchak amar: hay avraham. bea avraham rachame delehve leh zikna, shenneemar: "veavraham zaken ba bayyamim". ad yaakov la hava chulesha, bea rachame vahava chulesha, shenneemar: "vayyomer leyosef hinne avicha chole". ad elisha la hava inish chalesh demittefach, vaata elisha uvea rachame veittefach, shenneemar: "veelisha chala et cholyo asher yamut bo".

Mishna dor hammabbul en lahem chelek laolam habba, veen omdin baddin, shenneemar: "lo yadon ruchi vaadam leolam" – lo din velo ruach. dor happelagga en lahem chelek laolam habba, shenneemar: "vayyafetz Adonai otam mishsham al pene chol haaretz", uchetiv: "umishsham hefitzam". "vayyafetz Adonai otam" – baolam hazze, "umishsham hefitzam Adonai" – laolam habba. anshe sedom en lahem chelek laolam habba, shenneemar: "veanshe sedom raim vechattaim laAdonai meod" – raim baolam hazze, vechattaim laolam habba. aval omdin baddin.
Rabbi nechemya omer: ellu vaellu en omdin baddin, shenneemar: "al ken lo yakumu

a: Reshaim bammishpat vechattaim baadat tzaddikim". "al ken lo yakumu reshaim bammishpat" – ze dor hammabbul. "vechattaim baadat tzaddikim" – ellu anshe sedom. amru lo: enam omdin baadat tzaddikim, aval omdin baadat reshaim.
Meraggelim en lahem chelek laolam habba, shenneemar: "vayyamutu haanashim motzie dibbat haaretz raa bammaggefa lifne Adonai". "vayyamutu" – baolam hazze, "bammaggefa" – laolam habba.

Dor hammidbar en lahem chelek laolam habba, veen omdin baddin, shenneemar: "bammidbar hazze yittammu vesham yamutu". divre rabbi akiva. rabbi eliezer omer, alehem hu omer: "isfu li chasiday korte veriti ale zavach".

Adat korach enah atida laalot, shenneemar: "vattechas alehem haaretz" – baolam hazze, "vayyovdu mittoch hakkahal" – laolam habba. divre rabbi akiva. rabbi eliezer omer, alehem hu omer: "Adonai memit umechayye morid sheol vayyaal".

Gemara tanu rabbanan: dor hammabbul en lahem chelek laolam habba, shenneemar: "vayyimach et kol hayekum asher al pene haadama". "vayyimach et kol hayyekum" – baolam hazze, "vayyimmachu min haaretz" – laolam habba, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi yehuda ben betera omer: lo chayyin velo niddonin, shenneemar: "lo yadon ruchi vaadam leolam" – lo din velo ruach. davar acher: "lo yadon ruchi" – shello tehe nishmatan chozeret lindanah.

Rabbi menachem berabbi yosef omer: afillu beshaa shehakkadosh baruch hu machazir neshamot lifgarim metim, nishmatan kasha lahem begehinnam, shenneemar: "taharu chashash teldu kash ruchachem esh tochalchem".

Tanu rabbanan: dor hammabbul lo nitgau ella bishvil tova shehishpia lahem hakkadosh baruch hu, uma ketiv bahem? "battehem shalom mippachad velo shevet eloah alehem", uchetiv: "shoro ibbar velo yagil tefallet parato velo teshakkel", uchetiv: "yeshallechu chatztzon avilehem veyaldehem yerakkedun", uchetiv: "yisu betof vechinnor veyismechu lekol ugav", uchetiv: "yechallu yemehem battov ushenehem banneimim", uchetiv: "uverega sheol yechattu".

Vehi garma sheamru lael: "sur mimmennu vedaat derachecha lo chafatznu. ma shadday ki naavdennu uma noil ki nifga bo". amru: kelum tzerichin anu lo ella letippa shel geshamim? yesh lanu neharot umaayanot sheanu mistappekin mehen. amar hakkadosh baruch hu: battova shehishpati lahen, bah machisin oti, uvah ani dan otam, shenneemar: "vaani hinni mevi et hammabbul mayim".

Rabbi yose amar: dor hammabbul lo nitgau ella bishvil galgal haayin sheddome lemayim, [shenneemar: "veyikchu lahem nashim mikkol asher bacharu"]. lefichach dan otan bemayim, sheddome legalgal haayin, shenneemar: "nivkeu kol mayenot tehom rabba vaarubbot hashshamayim niftachu".

Amar rabbi yochanan: dor hammabbul berabba kilkelu, uverabba niddonu. berabba kilkelu, shenneemar: "vayyar Adonai ki rabba raat haadam", uverabba niddonu, shenneemar: "kol mayenot tehom rabba". amar rabbi yochanan: shelosha nishtayyeyru mehem – belua degader, vechamme teverya, veena rabbati deveram.

"Ki hishchit kol basar et darko al haaretz", amar rabbi yochanan: melammed shehirbiu behema al chayya, vechayya al behema, vehakkol al adam, veadam al hakkol. amar rabbi abba bar kahana: vechullam chazru, chutz mittushelmi.

"Vayyomer Adonai lenoach ketz kol basar ba lefanay". amar rabbi yochanan: bo uree kamma gadol koach shel chamas, shehare dor hammabbul avru al hakkol, velo nechtam alehem gezar dinam ad sheppashtu yedehem begazel, shenneemar: "ki mala haaretz chamas mippenehem vehinni mashchitam et haaretz". uchetiv: "hechamas kam lematte resha, lo mehem velo mehamonam velo mehemehem velo noah bahem".
Amar rabbi elazar: melammed shezzakaf atzmo kemakkel, veamad lifne hakkadosh baruch hu, veamar lefanav, ribbono shel olam: "lo mehem velo mehamonam velo mehemehem velo noah bahem".

(Veaf al noach nechtam gezar din, shenneemar: "velo noach bahem"). tana deve rabbi yishmael: af al noach nechtach gezar din, ella shemmatza chen beene Adonai, shenneemar: "nichamti ki asitem venoach matza chen beene Adonai".

"Vayyinnachem Adonai ki asa et haadam baaretz". ki ata rav dimi amar: amar hakkadosh baruch hu, yafe asiti shettikkanti lahem kevarot baaretz. may mashma? ketiv hacha "vayyinnachem Adonai", uchetiv hatam "vaynachem otam vaydabber al libbam".
Veikka deamri: lo yafe asiti shettikkanti lahem kevarot baaretz. ketiv hacha "vayyinnachem", uchetiv hatam: "vayyinnachem Adonai al haraa asher dibber laasot leammo".
"Elle toldot noach [noach ish tzaddik tamim haya bedorotav]". amar rabbi yochanan: "bedorotav", velo bedorot acherim. veresh lakish amar: "bedorotav", kol shekken bedorot acherim.

Amar rabbi chanina: mashal derabbi yochanan, lema haddavar dome? lechavit shel yayin shehayta munnachat bemartef shel chometz. bimkomah – rechah nodef, shello bimkomah – en rechah nodef. amar rabbi oshaya: mashal deresh lakish, lema haddavar dome? litzlochit shel pilyayton shehayta munnachat bimkom hattinnofet. bimkomah – rechah nodef, vechol shekken bimkom habbosem.
"Vayyimach et kol hayekum asher al pene haadama". im adam chata, behema ma chata?

Tana mishshum rabbi yehoshua ben korcha: mashal leadam sheasa chuppa livno, vehitkin mikkol mine seuda. leyamim met beno. amad uvilbel et chuppato. amar: kelum asiti ella bishvil beni? achshav shemmet, chuppa lamma li? af hakkadosh baruch hu amar: kelum barati behema vechayya ella bishvil adam? achshav sheadam chote, behema vechayya lamma li?
"Mikkol asher becharava metu", velo dagim shebbayyam.

Daresh rabbi yose demin kesari: may dichtiv "kal hu al pene mayim tekullal chelkatam baaretz"? melammed shehaya noach hatztzaddik mochiach bahem veomer lahem: asu teshuva, veim lav hakkadosh baruch hu mevi alechem et hammabbul umakpe nivlatchem al hammayim kezikin, shenneemar: "kal hu al pene mayim". velo od, ella shellokchin mehem kelala lechol bae olam, shenneemar: "tekullal chelkatam baaretz
Lo yifne derech keramim", melammed shehayu mefannim derech keramim. amru lo: umi meakkev? amar lahem: pereda achat yesh li lehotzi mikkem.
b: Im ken, lo nefanne derech keramim.

Daresh rava: may dichtiv "lappid buz leashtut shaanan nachon lemoade ragel"? melammed shehaya noach hatztzaddik mochiach otam, veamar lahem devarim shehem kashim kelappidim, vehayu bozim oto. amru lo: zaken, teva zo lamma? amar lahem: hakkadosh baruch hu mevi alechem et hammabbul. amru: mabbul shel ma? im mabbul shel esh, yesh lanu davar echad vaalita shemah. veim shel mayim hu mevi, im min haaretz hu mevi, yesh lanu ashashiyyot shel barzel sheanu mechappin bahem et haaretz. veim min hashshamayim hu mevi, yesh lanu davar veakev shemo – veamri la: ikkesh shemo.

Amar lahem: hu mevi mibben ikkeve raglechem, shenneemar "nachon lemoade ragel". tanya: meme hammabbul kashim keshichvat zera, shenneemar "nachon lemoade ragel". amar rav chisda: berotchin kilkelu baavera, uverotchin niddonu. ketiv hacha: "vayyashokku hammayim", uchetiv hatam: "vachamat hammelech shachacha".
"Vayhi leshivat hayyamim ume hammabbul hayu al haaretz", ma tivam shel shivat hayyamim?

Amar rav: ellu yeme avelut shel metushelach, lelammedcha shehespedan shel tzaddikim meakkevin et happureanut lavo. davar acher: leshivat [hayyamim] sheshshinna alehem hakkadosh baruch hu seder bereshit, shehayta chamma yotzet mimmaarav veshokaat bammizrach. davar acher: shekkava lahem hakkadosh baruch hu zeman gadol, veachar kach zeman katan. davar acher: leshivat hayyamim shehitimam meen haolam habba, kede sheyyedu ma tova manu mehen.
"Mikkol habbehema hattehora tikkach lecha shiva shiva ish veishto", ishut livhema mi it la? amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: meotam shello neevda bahem avera.

Mena yeda? amar rav chisda: sheheeviran lifne hatteva, kol shehatteva kolatto – beyadua shello neevda bahem avera, vechol sheen hatteva kolatto – beyadua shenneevda bah avera. rabbi avahu amar: meotan habbain meelehen.
"Ase lecha tevat atze gofer", may gofer? amar rav adda: amri deve rabbi shela, zo mavliga. veamri la: gulemesh.
"Tzohar taase latteva" – amar rabbi yochanan: amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lenoach, keva bah avanim tovot umargaliyyot, kede sheyyihyu meirot lachem katztzohorayim.
"Veel amma techallenna milmala", divhachi [hu] dekayyma.
"Tachtiyyim sheniyyim ushelishim taaseha" – tana: tachtiyyim lezevel, emtzaiyyim labbehema, elyonim laadam.

"Vayshallach et haorev", amar resh lakish: teshuva nitztzachat heshivo orev lenoach. amar lo: rabbecha soneni veatta senetani. rabbecha soneni – min hattehorin shiva, min hattemeim shenayim, veatta senetani – sheatta manniach mimmin shiva vesholeach mimmin shenayim. im pogea bi sar chamma o sar tzinna, lo nimtza olam chaser beriyya achat? o shemma leishti atta tzarich?
Amar lo: rasha! bammuttar li neesar li, banneesar li lo kol shekken?

Umenalan deneesru? dichtiv: "uvata el hatteva atta uvanecha veishtecha uneshe vanecha ittach", uchetiv: "tze min hatteva atta veishtecha uvanecha uneshe vanecha ittach". veamar rabbi yochanan: mikkan (amru) shenneesru betashmish hammitta.
Tanu rabbanan: shelosha shimmeshu batteva, vechullam laku. kelev veorev vecham. kelev nikshar, orev rak, cham laka beoro.
"Vayshallach et hayyona meitto lirot hakallu hammayim". amar rabbi yirmeya: mikkan sheddiratan shel ofot tehorim im hatztzaddikim.

"Vehinne ale zayit taraf befiha". amar rabbi elazar: amra yona lifne hakkadosh baruch hu, ribbono shel olam, yihyu mezonotay merorim kezayit umesurim beyadcha, veal yihyu metukim kidvash umesurim beyad basar vadam. may mashma dehay "taraf" lishshana dimzone hu? dichtiv: "haterifeni lechem chukki".
"Lemishpechotehem yatzu min hatteva", amar rabbi yochanan: "lemishpechotam" velo "hem".

Amar rav chana bar bizna: amar leh eliezer leshem rabba, ketiv: "lemishpechotehem yatzu min hatteva". attun hechan havetun? amaru leh: tzaar gadol haya lanu batteva. beriyya sheddarkah lehaachilah bayyom – heechalnuha bayyom, sheddarkah lehaachilah ballayla – heechalnuha ballayla. hay zekita la hava yada abba ma achla. yoma chad hava yatev veka fale rimmona, nefal tolata minna achala. mikkan veelach hava gavel la chizra, ki matla achla.

Arya – eshshata zanteh, deamar rav: la betzir mishshitta vela tefe mitteresar zayna ishshata. ureshina – ashkecheh abba degane besafna detevota. amar leh: la baet mezone? amar leh: chazetaych dahavet teridat, amena la atzaarach. amar leh: yehe raava dela temut, shenneemar: "vaomar im kinni egva vechachol arbe yamim".

Amar rav chana bar levay: amar shem rabba leeliezer, ki ato alayychu malche mizrach umaarav, attun hechi avyditu? amar leh: ayyti hakkadosh baruch hu leavraham veotveh miyyammineh, vahava shadenan afra vehavu charve, gile vehavu gire, shenneemar: "mizmor ledavid neum Adonai ladoni shev limini ad ashit oyvecha hadom leraglecha", uchetiv: "mi heir mimmizrach tzedek yikraehu leraglo yitten lefanav goyim umelachim yard yitten keafar charbo kekash niddaf kashto".
Nachum ish gam zo hava regil, dechol dahava salka leh amar: "gam zo letova". yoma chad beo [yisrael] leshaddore doron lekesar. amri: bahade

a: Man neshaddar? neshaddar bahade nachum ish gam zo, dimlummad benissim hu.

Ki meta lehahu diyyura, bea lemevat. amri leh: may ikka bahadach? amar lehu: ka movelna keraga lekesar. kamu belelya, sheronhu lesifteh, ushekalu kol dahava gabbeh umallonhu afra. ki meta lehatam, ishtechach afra. amar: achoche ka mechayyeychi bi yehudae. appeku lemikteleh. amar: gam zo letova. ata eliyyahu veiddemi lehu kechad minnayyhu. amar lehu: dilma hay afra meafra deavraham avinu hu, dahava shade afra havu charve, gile havu gire. beduk veashkachu hachi.

Hava machoza dela havo ka yachli leh lemichbesheh. shedo mehahu afra aleh vechavshu. ayyeylu leve ginza, amri: shekol denicha lach. malleyeh lesifta dahava. ki hadar ata, amaru leh hanach dayyore: may amtet leve malka? amar lehu: may dishkali mehacha amtay lehatam. shakli inhu amto lehatam. katlinhu lehanach dayore.

Dor happelagga en lahem chelek laolam habba vechulei. may avud? amri deve rabbi shela: nivne migdal venaale larakia, venakke oto bekardummot kede sheyyazuvu memav. machachu ala bemareva: im ken, livno achad tura!

(Ella) amar rabbi yirmeya bar elazar: nechleku leshalosh kittot, achat omeret: naale veneshev sham, veachat omeret: naale venaavod avoda zara, veachat omeret: naale venaase milchama. zo sheomeret naale veneshev sham – "hefitzam Adonai", vezo sheomeret naale venaase milchama – naasu kofim veruchot veshedim velilin, vezo sheomeret naale venaavod avoda zara – "ki sham balal Adonai sefat kol haaretz".
Tanya, rabbi natan omer: kullam leshem avoda zara nitkavvevnu. ketiv hacha: "naase lanu shem", uchetiv hatam: "veshem elohim acherim lo tazkiru". ma lehallan avoda zara, af kan avoda zara.
Amar rabbi yochanan: migdal shelish nisraf, shelish nivla, shelish kayyaym. amar rav: avir migdal meshakkeach. amar rav yosef: bavel uvorsif siman ra lattora. may borsif? amar rabbi assi: bor shafe.

"Anshe sedom en lahem chelek laolam habba vechulei". tanu rabbanan: anshe sedom en lahen chelek laolam habba, shenneemar: "veanshe sedom raim vechattaim laAdonai meod". "raim" – baolam hazze, "vechattaim" – laolam habba.

Amar rav yehuda: raim begufan, vechattaim bemamonam. raim begufan – dichtiv: "veech eese haraa haggedola hazzot vechatati lelohim", vechattaim bemamonam – dichtiv: "vehaya vecha chet". "laAdonai" – zo birkat hashshem. "meod" – shemmitkavvevnim vechotim.

Bematnita tana: "raim" – bemamonam, "vechattaim" – begufan. raim bemamonam, dichtiv: "veraa encha beachicha haevyon". vechattaim begufan, dichtiv: "vechatati lelohim". "laAdonai" – zo birkat hashshem. "meod" – zo shefichut damim, shenneemar: "vegam dam naki shafach menashshe birushalayim harebe meod [vegomer]".

Tanu rabbanan: anshe sedom lo nitgau ella bishvil tova shehishpia lahem hakkadosh baruch hu, uma ketiv bahem? "eretz mimmenna yetze lachem vetachteha nehpach kemo esh. mekom sappir avaneha veafrot zahav lo. nativ lo yedao ayit velo shezafattu en ayya. lo hidrichuhu vene shachatz lo ada alav shachal".

Amru: vechi meachar sheeretz mimmenna yetze lachem veafrot zahav lo", lamma lanu ovre derachim? sheen baim elenu ella lechasserenu [mimmamonenu]. bou uneshakkach torat regel meartzenu! shenneemar: "paratz nachal meim gar hannishkachim minni ragel dallu meenosh nau".

Daresh rava: may dichtiv "ad ana tehottu al ish terotztzechu chullechem kekir natuy gader haddechuya"? melammed shehayu notnin enehen bevaale mamon, umoshivin oto etzel kir natuy, vedochin oto alav, uvaim venotlin et mamono.

Daresh rava: may dichtiv "chatar bachoshech battim yomam chittemu lamo lo yadu or"? melammed shehayu notnim enehem bevaale mamon, umafkidim etzlo afarsemon, umannichim oto bevet ginzehem. laerev baim umerichin oto kechelev, shenneemar: "yashuvu laerev yehemu chakkalev visovvu ir", uvaim vechotrim sham venotlin oto mamon.
"Arom yalinu mibbeli levush veen kesut bakkara", "chamor yetomim yinhagu yachbelu shor almana", "gevulot yassigu eder gazlu vayyiru", "vehu likvarot yuval veal gadish yishkod".

Daresh rabbi yose betzippori. ichatrayn hahi lelya telat mea machterata betzippori. ato veka metzaari leh. amaru leh: yehavyt orcheh legannave! amar lehu: mi hava yadana deattu gannave? ki ka nach nafsheh derabbi yose, shafi marzeve detzippori dema.
Amri: deit leh chad tora – mare chad yoma, delet leh – lire tere yome. hahu yatma bar armalta, yehavu leh tore lemire. azal, shaklinhu vekatlinhu. amar lehu:
b: Deit leh tora – nishkol chad mashka, delet leh tora – nishkol tere mashke. amaru leh: may hay? amar lehu: sof dina kitchillat dina. ma techillat dina? deit leh tora – mare chad yoma, delet leh tore – mare tere yome. af sof dina: deit leh chad tora – lishkol chad, delet leh tora – lishkol tere.

Deavar bemabbara – nittev chad zuza, dela avar bemabbara – nittev tere. dahava leh dara delivne, ate kol chad vechad shakel chada, amar leh: ana chada dishkali. dahava shade tume o shamche, ato kol chad vechad shakel chada, amar leh: ana chada dishkali.

Arba dayyayne hayu bisdom, shakray veshakroray zayyfay umatzle dina. demache leh leitteta dechavreh umappela (leh), amri leh: yahava nihaleh deniabbera nihalaych. defasek leh leudena dachamara dechavreh, amaru leh: hava nihaleh ad dekadcha. defada leh lechavreh, amri leh: hav leh agra dishkal lach dema.

Deavar bemabbara – yehev arbea zuze, deavar bemayya – yahev temanya zuze. zimna chada ata hahu koves, ikkela lehatam. amaru leh: hav arbea zuze. amar lehu: ana bemayya avari. amaru leh: im ken, hav temanya daavart bemayya. la yehav. padyu. ata lekammeh dedayyayna. amar leh: hav leh agra dishkal lach dema, utemanya zuze daavart bemayya.

Eliezer eved avraham itremi hatam, padyuhy. ata lekammeh dayyayna. amar leh: hav leh agra dishkal lach dema. shekal gelala, padyev ihu ledayyayna. amar: may hay? amar leh: agra dinfak li minnach, hav nihaleh lehay, vezuze didi kidkayymi kayymi.

Havya lehu pureyyta dahavo magni ala orchin. ki maarech – gayyzi leh, ki gutz – matchin leh. eliezer eved avraham ikkela lehatam. amaru leh: kum geni appureya. amar lehon: nidra nedari min yoma demitat imma la ganena appureya.
Ki hava mitreme lehu anya, yehavu leh kol chad vechad dinara, uchetiv shemeh aleh. verifta la havo mamte leh. ki hava mayet, ate kol chad vechad shakel dideh.

Hachi atno benayyhu: kol man demazmen gavra leve hillula, leshallach gelima. havi hay hillula, ikkela eliezer lehatam vela yehavu leh nahama. ki bae lemisad, ata eliezer vitev lesefa dechullehu. amaru leh: man azmenach lehacha? amar leh lehahu [deyatev]: at zammentan. [amar: dilma shami bi daana azmenteh umeshallechi leh maneh dehay gavra.] shekal gelimeh hahu deyatev gabbeh urehat levara. vechen avad lechullehu ad denafki kullehu veachla ihu lisudeta.

Haveya hahi ravita dahavat ka mappeka rifta leanya bechatzba. iggallay milleta, shafyuha duvesha, veokmuha al iggar shura. ato zibbure veachluha. vehayeynu dichtiv: "vayyomer Adonai zaakat sedom vaamora ki rabba". veamar rav yehuda amar rav: al iske riva.
Meraggelim en lahem chelek laolam habba, shenneemar: "vayyamutu haanashim motzie dibbat haaretz raa bammaggefa". "vayyamutu" – baolam hazze, "bammaggefa" – laolam habba.

Adat korach en lahem chelek laolam habba, shenneemar: "vattechas alehem haaretz" – baolam hazze, "vayyovdu mittoch hakkahal" – laolam habba. divre rabbi akiva. rabbi eliezer omer: alehem amar hakkatuv "Adonai memit umechayye morid sheol vayyaal".

Tanu rabbanan: adat korach en lahem chelek laolam habba, shenneemar: "vattechas alehem haaretz" – baolam hazze, "vayyovdu mittoch hakkahal" – laolam habba. divre rabbi akiva. rabbi yehuda ben betira omer: hare hen kaaveda hammitbakkeshet, shenneemar: "taiti kese oved bakkesh avdecha ki mitzvotecha lo shachachti".

"Vayyikkach [korach]" – amar resh lakish: shellakach mikkach ra leatzmo. "korach" – shennaasa korcha beyisrael. "ben yitzhar" – ben shehirtiach alav et kol haolam katztzohorayim. "ben kehat" – ben shehikha shinne molidav. "ben levi" – ben shennaasa levaya begehinnam.

Velichshov name ben yaakov, ben sheakav atzmo legehinnam? amar rav shemuel bar rav yitzchak: yaakov bikkesh rachamim al atzmo, shenneemar "besodam al tavo nafshi bikhalam al techad kevodi". "besodam al tavo nafshi" – ellu meraggelim. "bikhalam al techad kevodi" – ze adat korach.
"Datan" – sheavar al dat el, "aviram" – sheibber atzmo measot teshuva, "veon" – sheyyashav baaninut, "pelet" – shennaasu lo pelaot, "ben reuven" – ben sheraa vehevin.
