Amar rav: "on ben pelet ishto hitztzilattu. amara leh: may nafka lach minna? i mar rabba – ant talmida, vei mar rabba – ant talmida. amar la: may eeved? havay beetza veishtevai li bahadayyhu. amara leh: yadana dechulla kenishta kaddishta ninhu, dichtiv: "ki chol haeda kullam kedoshim". amara leh: tuv, daana matztzelna lach. ashkiteh chamra vearviteh veagniteh gavvay. vitiva al bava,

a: Usetarte lemazzeya, kol daata chazya hadar. addehachi vehachi, ibbelau lehu.

Itteteh dekorach amara leh: chazi may kaaved moshe. ihu hava malka, laachu shavvevye kahana rabba, livne achohi shavvinhu segane dechahana. i atya teruma amar "tehve lechahen", i atu maaser deshaklitu attun amar "havu chad measra lechahen". veod degayez leh lemazayychu umittallal bechu ki chufeta, ena yehav bemazayychu. amar la: ha ihu name ka aved! amara leh: kevan dechullehu revuta dideh, amar ihu name "tamot nafshi im pelishtim".

Veod, dekaamar lechu avditu techelta. i salka datach techelta chashiva [mitzva], appek gelime ditchelta vechassinhu lechullehu metivtach. hayeynu dichtiv: "chochmot nashim banta vetah" – zo ishto shel on ben pelet, "veivvelet beyadah tehersenna" – zo ishto shel korach.

"Vayyakumu lifne moshe vaanashim mibbene yisrael chamishshim umatayim [nesie eda]" – meyuchadim shebbaeda, "kerie moed" – shehayu yodim leabber shanim velikboa chodashim, "anshe shem" – shehaya lahem shem bechol haolam.

"Vayyishma moshe vayyippol al panav". ma shemua shema? amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: shechashaduhu meeshet ish, shenneemar "vaykanu lemoshe bammachane". amar rabbi shemuel bar yitzchak: melammed shekkol echad veechad kinne et ishto mimmoshe, shenneemar "umoshe yikkach et haohel venata lo michutz lammachane".
"Vayyakom moshe vayyelech el datan vaaviram". amar resh lakish: mikkan sheen machzikin bemachloket, deamar rav: kol hammachzik bemachloket over belav, shenneemar: "velo yihye chekorach vechaadato".
Rav ashe amar: "rauy litztarea". ketiv hacha: "beyad moshe lo", uchetiv hatam: "vayyomer Adonai lo od have na yadcha bechekecha".
Amar rabbi yose: kol hacholek al malchut bet david rauy lehakkisho nachash. ketiv hacha: "vayyizbach adoniyyahu tzon uvakar umeri im even hazzochelet", uchetiv hatam: "im chamat zochale afar".

Amar rav chisda: kol hacholek al rabbo kecholek al hashshechina, shenneemar: "behatztzotam al Adonai". amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: kol haose meriva im rabbo keose im shechina, shenneemar: "hemma me meriva asher ravu vene yisrael et Adonai".

Amar rabbi chanina bar pappa: kol hammitraem al rabbo keillu mitraem al hashshechina, shenneemar: "lo alenu telunnotechem ki im al Adonai". amar rabbi avahu: kol hameharher achar rabbo keillu mehareher achar shechina, shenneemar: "vaydabber haam belohim uvemoshe".

"Osher shamur livalav leraato". amar resh lakish: ze oshro shel korach. "veet kol hayekum asher beraglehem" – amar rabbi elazar: ze mamono shel adam shemmaamido al raglav. veamar rabbi levi: massoy shelosh meot peradot levanot hayu maftechot shel bet genazav shel korach, vechullehu aklide vekilfe degilda.
Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: shalosh matmoniyyot hitmin yosef bemitzrayim. achat nitgalleta lekorach, veachat nitgalleta leantoninus ben asvirus, veachat genuza letzaddikim leatid lavo.

Veamar rabbi yochanan: korach lo min habbeluim velo min hasserufin. lo min habbeluin, dichtiv: "veet kol haadam asher lekorach" – velo korach. velo min hasserufim, dichtiv: "baachol haesh et chamishshim umatayim ish" – velo korach.

Bematnita tana: korach min hasserufin umin habbeluin. min habbeluim, dichtiv: "vattivla otam veet korach". min hasserufin, dichtiv: "vattetze esh millifne Adonai [veesh yatza meet Adonai] vattochal et hachamishshim umatayim ish", vekorach bahadayyhu.

Amar rava: may dichtiv "shemesh yareach amad zevula leor chitztzecha yehallechu"? melammed shealu shemesh veyareach lizvul. amru lefanav: ribbono shel olam, im atta ose din leven amram netze, veim lav lo netze. ad shezzarak bahem chitztzim. amar lahen: bichvodi lo mechitem, bichvod basar vadam mechitem? vehaiddana la nafki ad demachu lehu.

Daresh rava: may dichtiv "veim beria yivra Adonai ufatzta haadama et piha"? amar moshe lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: "im beria" gehinnam – mutav, veim lav – "yivra Adonai". lemay? ilema lemivreya mammash? veha "en kol chadash tachat hashshamesh"! ella lekarove pitcha.

"Uvene korach lo metu". tana mishshum rabbenu amru: makom nitbatztzer lahem begehinnam veyashvu alav veamru shira. amar rabba bar bar chana: zimna chada hava kaazelna beorcha, amar li hahu tayyaya: ta veachve lach belue dekorach. azali chazay tere bize dahava ka nafek kitra minnayyhu. shekal gevava deamra, amsheyeh mayya, veotveh beresh rumecheh, veachlefeh hatam. icharach. amar li: atztzet ma shamat. ushemait dahavo kaamri hachi: "moshe vetorato emet, vehen baddaim".
b: Amar leh: kol telatin yomin mehaddera lehu gehinnam kevasar betoch kallachat, veamri hachi: "moshe vetorato emet, vehen baddaim".

Dor hammidbar en lahem chelek laolam habba vechulei. tanu rabbanan: dor hammidbar en lahem chelek laolam habba, shenneemar: "bammidbar hazze yittammu vesham yamutu". "yittammu" – baolam hazze, "vesham yamutu" – baolam habba. veamar: "asher nishbati veappi im yevoun el menuchati". divre rabbi akiva.
Rabbi eliezer omer: hen bain laolam habba, shenneemar: "isfu li chasiday korte veriti ale zavach". ella ma ani mekayyem "asher nishbati veappi"? beappi nishbati, vechozrani bi.

Rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: lo neemar pasuk ze ella keneged dorot habbaim. "isfu li chasiday" – ellu tzaddikim shebbechol dor vador. "korte veriti ale zavach" – ellu chananya, mishael vaazarya shemmasru atzman letoch kivshan haesh. "ale zavach" – [ellu] rabbi akiva vachaverav shemmasru atzman lishchita al divre tora.

Rabbi shimon ben menasya omer: baim hen laolam habba, shenneemar: "ufeduye Adonai yeshuvun uvau tziyyon berinna". amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: shavka rabbi akiva lachasiduteh, shenneemar: "haloch vekarata veozne yerushalaym lemor zacharti lach chesed neurayich ahavat kelulotayich lechtech acharay bammidbar beeretz lo zerua". uma acherim baim bizchutam, hem atzman lo kol shekken?

Mishna aseret hashshevatim enan atidin lachazor, shenneemar: "vayyashlichem el eretz acheret kayyom hazze". ma hayyom holech veeno chozer – af hem holchim veenan chozrim, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi eliezer omer: "kayyom hazze" – ma yom maafil umeir, af aseret hashshevatim sheafela lahen kach atida lehair lahem.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: aseret hashshevatim en lahem chelek laolam habba, shenneemar: "vayyitteshem Adonai meal admatam beaf uvechema uveketzef gadol". "vayyitteshem Adonai meal admatam" – beolam hazze, "vayyashlichem el eretz acheret" – laolam habba, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi shimon ben yehuda ish kefar akko omer mishshum rabbi shimon: im maasehem kayyom hazze – enan chozrin, veim lav – chozrin.

Rabbi omer: baim hem laolam habba, shenneemar: "bayyom hahu yittaka beshofar gadol vegomer". amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: shavka rabbi akiva lachasiduteh, shenneemar: "haloch vekarata et haddevarim haelle tzafona veamarta shuva meshuva yisrael neum Adonai lo appil panay bachem ki chasid ani neum Adonai lo ettor leolam".

May chasiduteh? detanya: ketanne bene rishe yisrael en bain laolam habba, shenneemar: "ki hinne hayyom ba boer kattannur vehayu chol zedim vechol ose risha kash velihat otam hayyom habba amar Adonai tzevaot asher lo yaazov lahem shoresh veanaf". "shoresh" – baolam hazze, "veanaf" – laolam habba; divre rabban gamliel.

Rabbi akiva omer: baim hem laolam habba, shenneemar: "shomer petaim Adonai", shekken korin bichrakke hayyam leyanoka patya. veomer: "goddu ilana vechabbeluhi beram ikkar shorshohi beara shevuku". veella ma ani mekayyem "lo yaazov lahem shoresh veanaf"? shello yanniach lahem lo mitzva velo shiyyure mitzva. davar acher: "shoresh" – zo neshama, "veanaf" – ze hagguf.
Aval ketanne bene rishe ummot haolam, divre hakkol, en bain laolam habba. verabban gamliel nafka leh mivvatteabbed kol zecher lamo".

Ittemar: katan, meematay ba laolam habba? rabbi chiyyay verabbi shimon bar rabbi – chad amar: mishshaa shennolad, vechad amar: mishshaa shessipper. man deamar mishshaa shennolad – shenneemar: "yavou veyaggidu tzidkato leam nolad ki asa". uman deamar mishshaa shessipper – dichtiv: "zera yaavdennu yesuppar laAdonai laddor".
Ittemar: ravina amar, mishshaa shennizra, dichtiv: "zera yaavdennu". rabbi nachman bar yitzchak amar, mishshaa shennimmol, dichtiv: "ani ani vegovea minnoar nasati emecha afuna".
Tana mishshum rabbi meir: mishshaa sheyyomar "amen", shenneemar: "pitchu shearim veyavo goy tzaddik shomer emunim". al tikre "shomer emunim", ella "sheomer amen".

a: May "amen"? amar rabbi chanina: "el melech neeman".

"Lachen hirchiva sheol nafshah ufaara fiha livli chok". amar resh lakish: lemi shemmeshayyer afillu chok echad. amar rabbi yochanan: la nicha lemarayyhu deamrat lehu hachi, ella afillu lo lamad ella chok echad.

(Shenneemar) "vehaya vechol haaretz neum Adonai pi shenayim bah yikkartu yigvau vehashshelishit yivvater bah". amar resh lakish: shelishi shel shem. amar leh rabbi yochanan: la nicha lemarayyhu deamrat lehu hachi, ella afillu shelishi shel noach.

"Ki anochi baalti vachem velakachti etchem echad meir ushenayim mimmishpacha". amar resh lakish: devarim kichtavan. amar leh rabbi yochanan: la nicha leh lemarayyhu deamrat lehu hachi, ella echad meir mezakke kol hair kullah, ushenayim mimmishpacha mezakkin kol hammishpacha kullah. yatev rav kahana kammeh derav veyatev vekaamar: devarim kichtavan. amar leh rav: la nicha leh lemarayyhu deamrat lehu hachi, ella echad meir mezakke kol hair, ushenayim mimmishpacha mezakkin kol hammishpacha.

Chazyeh dahava ka chayef resheh vesalek veyatev kammeh derav. amar leh: "velo timmatze beeretz hachayyim". amar leh: melat ka layytat li? amar leh: kera kaamena, lo timmatze tora bemi shemmechayye atzmo aleha.

Tanya: rav simay omer, neemar: "velakachti etchem li leam", veneemar: "veheveti etchem". makkish yetziatan mimmitzrayim leviatan laaretz. ma biatan laaretz – shenayim mishshishshim ribbo, af yetziatan mimmitzrayim – shenayim mishshishshim ribbo. amar rava: vechen limot hammashiach, shenneemar: "veanta shamma kime neureha ucheyom alotah meeretz mitzrayim".

Tanya: amar rabbi elazar berabbi yose, paam achat nichnasti laalekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim. matzati zaken echad veamar li: bo vearekka ma asu avotay laavotecha. mehem tibbeu bayyam, mehem hargu bacherev, mehem maachu bevinyan. veal davar ze neenash moshe rabbenu, shenneemar: "umeaz bati el paro ledabber bishmecha hera laam hazze".

Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: chaval al deavdin vela mishtachchin. hare kamma peamim nigleti al avraham yitzchak veyaakov beel shadday, velo hirharu al middotay, velo amru li "ma shemecha". amarti leavraham "kum hithallech baaretz leorkah ulerochbah ki lecha ettenenna". bikkesh makom likbor et sara velo matza, ad shekkana bearba meot shekel kesef, velo hirher al middotay.

Amarti leyitzchak: "gur baaretz hazzot veehye immecha vaavarchekka". bikkeshu avadav mayim lishtot velo matzu, ad sheasu meriva, shenneemar: "vayyarivu roe gerar im roe yitzchak lemor lanu hammayim". velo hirher achar middotay.

Amarti leyaakov: "haaretz asher atta shochev aleha lecha ettenenna". bikkesh makom lintoa oholo, velo matza, ad shekkana bemea kesita, velo hirher achar middotay, velo amru li: "ma shemecha", veatta amrat li: "ma shemecha" battechilla, veachshav atta omer li: "vehatztzel lo hitztzalta et ammecha". "atta tire et asher eese lefaro". bemilchemet paro atta roe, vei atta roe bemilchemet sheloshim veechad melachim.
"Vaymaher moshe vayyikkod artza vayyishtachu". ma raa moshe?

Rabbi chanina ben gamla amar: "erech appayim" raa, verabbanan amri: "emet" raa. tanya keman deamar "erech appayim" raa, detanya: kesheala moshe lemarom metzao lehakkadosh baruch hu sheyyoshev vechotev "erech appayim". amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, "erech appayim" latztzaddikim? amar lo: "af larshaim". amar leh: reshaim yovedu! amar leh: hasheta chazet (may) demibbee lach.
Keshechatu yisrael, amar lo: lo kach amarta li "erech appayim latztzaddikim"?
b: Amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, velo kach amarta li: "af larshaim"? vehayeynu dichtiv: "veatta yigdal na koach Adonai kaasher dibbarta lemor".

Rabbi chagga hava salek veazel bedarga deve rabba bar shela. shameh lehahu yanoka deamar: "edotecha neemnu meod levetcha naava kodesh Adonai leorech yamim", usemich leh "tefilla lemoshe vegomer". amar: shema minna erech appayim raa.

Amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina: atid hakkadosh baruch hu lihyot atara berosh kol tzaddik vetzaddik, shenneemar: "bayyom hahu yihye Adonai tzevaot laateret tzevi velitzfirat tifara lishar ammo vegomer". may "laateret tzevi velitzfirat tifara"? laosim retzono umetzappim lishuato. yachol lakkol? talmud lomar: "lishar ammo" – lemi shemmesim atzmo keshirayim.

"Uleruach mishpat layyoshev al hammishpat veligvura meshive milchama shara". "uleruach mishpat" – ze harode et yitzro, "velayyoshev al hammishpat" – ze haddan din emet laamitto, "veligvura" – ze hammitgabber beyitzro, "meshive milchama" – ze shennose venoten bemilchamtah shel tora, "shara" – ellu shemmashkimin umaarivin bevatte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot.

Amra middat haddin lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, ma nishtannu ellu meellu? amar lah: "vegam elle bayyayin shagu uvashshechar tau [vegomer] paku peliliyya". veen puka ella gehinnam, shenneemar: "lo tihye zot lecha lefuka". veen pelila ella dayyaynin, shenneemar: "venatan biflilim".

Mishna anshe ir hanniddachat en lahem chelek laolam habba, shenneemar: "yatzu anashim bene veliyyaal mikkirbecha vayyaddichu et yoshve iram lemor". veenan neheragim ad sheyyihyu maddicheha meotah hair umeoto hashshevet, vead sheyyudach rubbah, vead sheyyaddichuha anashim. hiddichuha nashim uketannim, o shehuddach miutah, o shehayu maddicheha chutza lah – hare ellu kichidim, utzerichin shene edim vehateraa lechol echad veechad.
Ze chomer baychidim mibbamrubbim, shehayyechidim biskila; lefichach mamonam palet, vehamerubbin besayif; lefichach mamonam aved.
"Hakke takke et yoshve hair hazzot lefi cherev". hachammeret vehaggammelet haoveret mimmakom lemakom, hare ellu matztzilin otah.

Shenneemar "hacharem otah veet kol asher bah veet behemtah lefi charev", mikkan amru: nichse tzaddikim shebbetochah – ovdin, shebbechutza lah – peletin. veshel reshaim, ben shebbetochah ben shebbechutza lah – hare ellu ovdin.
Shenneemar, "veet kol shelalah tikbotz el toch rechovah vegomer", im en lah rechov, osin lah rechov. hayta rechovah chutza lah, konsin otah letochah.

Shenneemar "vesarafta vaesh et hair veet kol shelalah kalil laAdonai elohecha", shelalah, velo shelal shamayim. mikkan amru: hahekdeshot shebbah yippadu, uterumot yerakvu, maaser sheni vechitve hakkodesh yigganzu.
"Kalil laAdonai elohecha", amar rabbi shimon: amar hakkadosh baruch hu, im attem osin din beir hanniddachat, maale ani alechem keillu attem maalim ola kalil lefanay.

"Vehayta tel olam" – lo tease gannot ufardesim, divre rabbi yose haggelili. rabbi akiva omer: "lo tibbane od" – lichmot shehayta enah nivnet, aval naaset hi gannot ufardesim. "velo yidbak beyadcha meuma min hacherem" – shekkol zeman sheharshaim baolam, charon af baolam; avdu reshaim min haolam, nistallek charon af min haolam.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "yatzu" – hen, velo sheluchin. "anashim" – en anashim pachot mishshenayim. davar acher: "anashim" – velo nashim, "anashim" – velo ketannim.

"Bene beliyyaal" – banim shepparku ol shamayim mitztzavverehem. "mikkirbecha" – velo min hassefar. "yoshve iram" – velo yoshve ir acheret. "lemor" – shetztzerichin edim vehateraa lechol echad veechad.

Ittemar, rabbi yochanan amar: cholkin ir achat lishne shevatim; veresh lakish amar: en cholkin ir achat lishne shevatim. etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: ad sheyyehu maddicheha meotah hair umeoto shevet – may lav, af al gav demaddicheha meotah hair, i ikka meoto shevet – in, i la – la? shema minna: cholkin ir achat lishne shevatim!
La, dinfala leh birusha. i name, deyahavuha nihaleh bemattana.
Etiveh: "arim tesha meet shene hashshevatim haelle". may lav: arba ufalga mehay, vearba ufalga mehay? ushema minna: cholkin ir achat lishne shevatim! la, arba mehay vechamesh mehay.
I hachi, lifrosh paroshe!
